We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

Reports to the Sr. Director of Program Management. The Account Management team owns Reserv's customer relationships beginning in onboarding: we are the customer's single point of contact, the people who make sure claims service matches what was promised, and the reason customers renew and grow.

This role carries multi-stakeholder customer relationships and resolves the most complex problems in the book. That includes the executive relationship at each customer, the cross-functional work that a single fix won't solve, and coaching that helps the team grow.

You will be an excellent fit if you can sit across from a customer executive without a script, take a complex failure from start to finish without handing it up, and you get as much satisfaction from developing a teammate as from closing out a problem yourself.

We hire owners. You see the whole outcome through, go to the details yourself, and keep a customer's confidence by being candid and keeping your word. You use sound judgment and look past today's fix to what would make the program better.

What you'll do

Executive Relationships: Own the health of complex customer relationships, including the executive relationship at each customer. Speak to the program's performance at an executive level, with or without preparation.

Complex Issue Resolution: Resolve complex and cross-program failures without escalating them. When a defect keeps coming back, route it for prevention so it gets fixed at the root rather than case by case.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Own and run cross-functional workstreams with our claims, operations, finance, and data science teams. Lead onboarding for complex new customers and the customer-facing change management that comes with it.

Forecasting: Own volume and revenue projections for the portfolio you hold, and keep them current. Translate portfolio data into valuable insights for customer executives. Identify growth opportunities, bring them to our commercial team, and support the effort to win them.

Mentorship: Onboard, train, and mentor Account Managers, and lead internal sessions that build the team's knowledge of our customers. Raise the standard of the work across the team, not only in your own book.

Industry Presence: Represent Reserv at internal executive forums and at industry conferences and panels.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in claims, program management, or account management, including ownership of complex customer relationships
  • Command of business reviews, claim reviews, and volume forecasting
  • Executive-level communication, written and live, with polished first-pass work
  • A track record of carrying complex problems to resolution without escalation
  • Deep working knowledge of claims operations: the claim lifecycle and reporting
  • Experience mentoring or training others
  • Data fluent: able to translate data into valuable insights for a customer executive
  • A record of owning outcomes end to end and delivering on your commitments
  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance paired with frequent, regular corporate retreats to build team cohesion, reinforce culture, and have fun
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

As a Senior Solution Architect you will be the senior technical and design authority, for Lineos Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) programmes in the UK, reporting into the Global VP of Professional Services, Lineos (FP&CC) You will design, govern and assure end-to-end Lineos solutions that span Financial Planning, Consolidation & Close, Disclosure Management, Account Reconciliation & Tax, that integrate cleanly with the customer's ERP and data landscape.

Lineos EPM solution architecture

  • Define and govern end-to-end Lineos EPM architectures across the Lineos modules: Financial Planning, Close & Consolidate, Disclosure Management, Account Reconciliation and Tax.

Customer advisory and commercial support

  • A track record of designing and governing multi-module EPM programmes (planning, consolidation and close, disclosure, reconciliation and tax) at enterprise scale.
  • Experience overseeing several delivery teams or engagements at once, ideally in a Design Authority or lead architect role.

EPM and finance knowledge

What success looks like

jobs.description:
Job Description

This is a remote position.

Contract Type: Permanent, Full-time
Stage: Post-Seed / Early Scale-up
Location: Remote
Working Hours: UK Hours

About the Role
The client is a sustainable technology company transforming propulsion across Air, Sea, and Sport. With a protected IP portfolio of over 30 patents, they have already launched a UK D2C brand in the Sport sector and are in the process of globalising D2C sales.

They are now seeking their first in-house finance hire. This individual will be a strategic partner to the CEO & Finance Director, and will be responsible for building a global, world-class finance function from the ground up to support our trajectory toward the projected revenue target by 2030.

What will make you a great fit for this role?
We are looking for a commercially minded Finance Manager who is excited by the opportunity to take ownership of the day-to-day finance function within a growing, ambitious international business.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of scope to make an impact. You'll be responsible for managing the core finance function, including accounting, reporting, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow, while also helping to improve and automate processes as the business scales.

You'll work closely with an experienced Finance Director, who will provide strategic and board-level guidance, giving you the opportunity to take real ownership of the finance function while developing your experience across a broader commercial and strategic remit.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who has built a strong foundation in finance and is ready to take the next step in their career – gaining greater ownership, commercial exposure and experience within a fast-growing international business.

And this isn't just a finance role. You'll be joining a company making a genuine environmental impact – from reducing underwater noise for marine life to making aviation quieter and paddle sports more accessible.

What you'll do

Own the Day-to-Day Finance Function

  • Take ownership of the day-to-day finance function, including AP, AR, payroll, reconciliations and month-end processes.
  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting and maintain strong financial controls.
  • Manage relationships with external accountants, tax advisers and other finance providers where required.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow

  • Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process.
  • Prepare regular cash flow forecasts and monitor working capital.
  • Provide financial insight to help the leadership team understand performance, risks and opportunities.
  • Build financial models and "what-if" scenarios to support commercial and investment decisions.

Finance Transformation & Process Improvement

  • Help transition the finance function from its current outsourced model towards a more efficient and scalable internal function.
  • Identify opportunities to improve, automate and streamline finance processes as transaction volumes increase.
  • Support the implementation and optimisation of finance systems, including the future move to a scalable ERP.
  • Improve the integration between e-commerce, inventory, manufacturing and finance systems.

International Growth

  • Support the financial management of the company's international operations and multi-entity structure.
  • Assist with consolidation, foreign exchange and international tax compliance across the UK, US, EU and Japan.
  • Support the implementation of automated tax solutions for North American sales.

Business Partnering

  • Work closely with the founders and leadership team, providing commercially focused financial insight and guidance.
  • Partner with the company's Technology and Product teams, helping them understand the financial implications of projects and investments without stifling innovation.
  • Support the Finance Director with board reporting, strategic planning and financial governance.

Support Business Growth

  • Provide financial analysis to support new products, markets and investment decisions.
  • Support funding rounds and the preparation of financial information and investment materials.
  • Help establish the financial processes, controls and reporting needed to support the company's transition from a lean startup to an international scale-up.

Requirements

  • Qualified or nearly qualified: ACA, ACCA or CIMA, with relevant post-qualification experience preferred.
  • Commercial finance experience: Experience within a product-based SME, scale-up or similarly fast-paced environment.
  • Strong accounting foundation: Confident managing the day-to-day finance function, month-end, reporting, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow.
  • International exposure: Experience working with multiple entities, currencies and/or international operations would be highly beneficial.
  • Technical capability: Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls and audit requirements.
  • Systems & automation: Comfortable working with finance systems, e-commerce platforms and technology, with an interest in improving and automating finance processes.
  • Analytical mindset: Able to turn financial data into clear commercial insight and support decision-making.
  • Remote Work: Fully set up to work remotely and within UK business hours.

Personal Attributes

  • The "Builder" Mindset: You enjoy taking ownership, improving things and building processes rather than simply maintaining the status quo.
  • Commercially Focused: You understand that finance should support the business and enable growth, not just report on what has already happened.
  • Hands-On: You're happy getting into the detail when needed, while also being able to step back and look at the bigger picture.
  • Growth Mindset: You're looking for an opportunity to broaden your experience and take on increasing responsibility as the company grows.
  • Stakeholder Savvy: You're confident working with founders, senior leaders, technical teams and external advisers.
  • Collaborative: You'll work closely with an experienced Finance Director who will provide strategic guidance, while giving you significant ownership of the day-to-day finance function.

jobs.title: Contractbeheerder onderhoudscontracten
jobs.excerpt: Grip op contracten, oog voor verbetering Zorg jij graag dat afspraken kloppen, informatie op orde is en processen steeds slimmer worden ingericht?
jobs.description:
Grip op contracten, oog voor verbetering

Zorg jij graag dat afspraken kloppen, informatie op orde is en processen steeds slimmer worden ingericht? Als contractbeheerder onderhoudscontracten bij Woonzorg Nederland combineer je jouw analytische blik met een belangrijke rol in het beheer en de verbetering van onze vastgoedcontracten.

Jij maakt het verschil doordat je...

  • zorgt dat onze onderhoudscontracten en contractinformatie goed beheerd zijn en het contractbeheersysteem actueel en betrouwbaar blijft.

  • afwijkingen, prestaties en financiële informatie analyseert en vertaalt naar heldere adviezen en verbetervoorstellen.

  • actief meedenkt over betere processen en systemen en daarmee bijdraagt aan de verdere professionalisering van ons contractbeheer.

Jouw impact als contractbeheerder onderhoudscontracten

Goed onderhoud van ons vastgoed begint bij duidelijke afspraken en contracten die op orde zijn. Als contractbeheerder zorg jij ervoor dat onze onderhoudscontracten goed zijn ingericht en beheerd. Je analyseert lopende contracten, onderzoekt afwijkingen en adviseert over de gevolgen daarvan. Ook beoordeel je operationele en financiële contractinformatie en zorg je dat het contractbeheersysteem actueel en betrouwbaar blijft.

Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse administratie. Je toetst zelfstandig KPI’s, analyseert resultaten en levert managementinformatie aan. Zie je dat iets beter of slimmer kan? Dan kom je met verbetervoorstellen voor bestaande processen, systemen en werkwijzen. Ook beoordeel je offertes, pas je opdrachten aan, controleer je facturen en houd je de administratie bij.

Je bent bovendien een vraagbaak voor collega’s en begeleidt waar nodig externe deskundigen en medewerkers bij de uitvoering van hun werk. Je denkt mee over de samenwerking met bewonersconsulenten, technisch managers en hoofdaannemers. En als het nodig is, ondersteun en vervang je de contractmanager. Zo zorg je samen met je collega’s voor grip op de contractportefeuille en een professionele samenwerking met onze aannemers.

Wat maakt deze functie extra mooi?

  • Je hebt zichtbare invloed op de kwaliteit. Met jouw analyses en verbetervoorstellen help je contracten, informatie en processen steeds verder te verbeteren.

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Je signaleert kansen, denkt mee over vernieuwing en helpt verbeteringen daadwerkelijk realiseren.

  • Je werkt met veel verschillende collega's en partners. Je verbindt informatie, afspraken en mensen en bent een belangrijke inhoudelijke gesprekspartner.

.

Wat je verder krijgt
Uiteraard krijg je daar ook veel voor terug. Zoals de ruimte om zelf mee te denken en te experimenteren met nieuwe werkwijzen. Persoonlijke aandacht, tijdens je inwerkperiode én daarna. En ruime mogelijkheden – inclusief scholingsbudget – voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, ook buiten de gebaande paden. Er is oog voor jouw werkgeluk en een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Want als je werkt met plezier, kun je meer betekenen voor een ander. Daarnaast bieden we je:

  • Een brutomaandsalaris tussen € 3.631,- en € 4.563,- bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur. Deze functie valt binnen schaal G van de cao Woondiensten.

  • De mogelijkheid om (bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur) 4 x 9 uur per week te werken.

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een contract voor onbepaalde tijd

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling.

  • Kilometervergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer of afspraken. Daarnaast krijg je een mobiliteitspas voor alle vormen van openbaar vervoer.

  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding, faciliteiten om een fijn thuiskantoor in te richten én de vrijheid om in overleg zelf te bepalen waar en wanneer je werkt.

  • Een mooi opleidingsbudget van € 900,- per jaar (gebaseerd op een fulltime dienstverband) en volop mogelijkheden om opleidingen en trainingen te volgen.

  • Een laptop en een nieuw model telefoon.

  • 189,8 vakantie-uren bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur.

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw werkgeluk en een goede balans tussen werk, privé en vitaliteit. Want als je werkt met plezier, kun je meer betekenen voor een ander.

  • Een sport-en-beweegvergoeding van € 128,­- netto per jaar en elke twee jaar een Health Check (preventief medisch onderzoek).

En dat is nog niet alles. In december kies je zelf van welke extra voorwaarden je het volgende jaar gebruik wilt maken. Denk aan extra verlofuren. 

Lees op meer over werken bij onze organisatie >>

Een warm team waarin je wordt gezien en gehoord

Je werkt samen met de teamleider contractmanager DO/Manager onderhoud en realisatie en de collega's binnen het team. In je functie heb je daarnaast contact met onder anderen contractmanagers, technisch managers, bewonersconsulenten en hoofdaannemers.

Requirements

Zo vul jij ons aan

Je bent iemand die graag structuur aanbrengt en zorgvuldig werkt. Je houdt overzicht, duikt graag in informatie en vindt het belangrijk dat afspraken en gegevens kloppen. Tegelijkertijd kijk je kritisch naar bestaande werkwijzen en zie je waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, werkt zelfstandig en zoekt actief de samenwerking op. Collega's kunnen op je rekenen: je communiceert helder, denkt mee en zorgt voor een goede terugkoppeling.

Verder heb je:

  • Mbo+-werk- en -denkniveau.

  • Kennis van en ervaring met bouw- en installatiecontracten en het beheren van contracten.

  • Kennis van huurrecht.

Zet jouw kennis in voor goed vastgoedbeheer

Past deze functie bij jou? Upload dan uiterlijk 13 december 2026 je motivatie en cv. Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie? Bel of app dan even met Saiida Bosse, Manager Programmering & Evaluatie 06-57410058

jobs.description:
About Athennian

Athennian delivers Governance Ops™ software that aligns legal, finance, tax and fund teams through a secure, integrated source of truth for entity and ownership data. The platform enables organizations managing complex corporate and investment structures to automate governance workflows, maintain audit-ready records and collaborate across functions with confidence.

More than 500,000 entities across over 150 countries are managed on Athennian, helping organizations modernize entity management and transform governance operations into a strategic advantage.

We are a fast-moving, solutions-driven team using an AI-forward approach to solve complex operational challenges. If you are passionate about building technology that transforms traditional industries, we’d love to have you join us.

About the role

With the rapid evolution of AI-driven cyberattacks and sophisticated threat vectors, traditional, reactive vulnerability management is no longer sufficient. We are looking for a hands-on Security Engineer who can proactively identify security gaps, investigate emerging threats, build advanced defenses, and continuously improve Athennian's security posture in line with global enterprise security standards.

In this role, you will partner closely with Information Security, Engineering, Product, and DevOps to embed security by design into how we build, scale, and operate our platform. We are looking for a naturally curious builder who thrives on technical challenges, experiments with emerging technology, and takes end-to-end ownership from vulnerability identification to technical remediation.

What you'll do

  • Proactive Threat Hunting: Conduct advanced threat analysis, continuous posture assessments, and offensive evaluations across our multi-tenant cloud environment to uncover security gaps.
  • Security Architecture & Solution Engineering: Partner with product managers, software architects and engineering teams during the design phase to build and implement scalable, automated security controls with secure coding, and zero-trust principles.
  • AI & Advanced Threat Defense:Research, model, and mitigate emerging AI-accelerated attack vectors, API abuse patterns, and cloud-native infrastructure risks leveraging frameworks such as OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud.
  • Security Posture Optimization: Continuously tune security telemetry, automated testing pipelines (SAST/DAST/SCA), and detection engineering systems to maximize signal-to-noise ratio and drive continuous cyber defensive improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Security Enablement:Champion a culture of security excellence by coaching engineers, establishing lightweight security playbooks, and bridging the gap between product velocity and high-compliance rigor.
  • Threat Intelligence Integration: Collect, analyze, and disseminate actionable threat intelligence from diverse sources (e.g., vendor updates, public databases, industry advisories) to proactively identify emerging attack vectors and mitigate potential security risks.
  • Vulnerability Triage, Remediation: Triage, prioritize, and remediate security findings by writing or fixing production code directly to close vulnerabilities with defined SLAs.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in application security, product security, or security engineering within a fast-paced software development environment.
  • Code-Level Remediation: Strong software engineering fundamentals with the ability to read, write, and debug production code (e.g., GraphQL, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript/Node.js) to fix vulnerabilities directly rather than just handing off tickets.
  • Vulnerability Management: Proven track record triaging and resolving findings from automated security testing tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning) and managing high-volume alert pipelines.
  • Threat Modeling & Architecture:Demonstrated expertise in conducting threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE) and security architecture reviews across distributed, multi-tenant cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Modern Threat Landscape:Deep understanding of contemporary attack vectors, API security vulnerabilities, cloud-native risks, and secure software development lifecycles (SDLC).
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with product managers and developers, translating complex security risks into practical business and engineering tradeoffs.

Nice to Haves

  • Industry Experience: Prior background navigating high-risk, regulated environments that manage sensitive personal information, particularly within legal tech, fintech, healthcare, or banking.
  • Certifications such as:
    • OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
    • Any AI Security or AI Red-Teaming certifications
    • Relevant Web Application Penetration Tester or Secure Software Programmer certifications
    • AWS Certified Security - Specialty

Location

We have embraced a distributed model of working to reach the best talent in the world. While some roles may require proximity to our Toronto, Calgary and Vancouver offices, roles based outside our office locations can be remote in Canada. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full-time in Canada.

Our Culture

We thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where every team member plays a critical role in our success. We value ambitious, results-driven people who spot opportunities, take initiative and go the extra mile. Collaboration fuels our growth as we take on new challenges, learn constantly and move quickly. If you're a go-getter who thrives on impact, you'll fit right in. Our values are:

  • Outcome Driven: We focus on setting ambitious goals and achieving measurable results, valuing success by the outcomes we deliver.
  • Wide Responsibility: Our team is empowered to shape success, taking ownership from problem identification to solution implementation.
  • Learning Mindset: We embrace curiosity, rejecting the status quo and encouraging continuous learning and agility.
  • Strategic Speed: We make fast, effective decisions and embrace a bias for action to seize opportunities quickly.

Benefits at Athennian

We keep things simple and invest in the perks that matter — your wellbeing, growth and flexibility.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, equity and performance-based bonus structure.
  • Work-Life Balance: A minimum of 3 weeks vacation, 5 sick days and 6 personal/flex days, plus a company-wide winter holiday shutdown.
  • Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, vision, long-term disability and a Health Spending Account (HSA).
  • Family Support: Flexible parental leave, including top-ups.
  • Remote Setup: A work-from-home allowance to get you set up for success.

Program Director – Civil Society Partnership Fund

Classification: Fixed-term, full-time, project-funded employment with an anticipated term of 4.5 years

Reports to: Australia Representative

Supervisory Responsibility: Direct line management of the CSPF Hub team

Location: Accepting applications from those living in and authorized to work in Australia and the Asia-Pacific Region. The role may be performed on a fully remote basis and requires regular travel across Southeast Asia, the Pacific, and Australia.

About The Asia Foundation

The Asia Foundation (TAF) is an international nonprofit organization working to solve the toughest social and economic challenges in Asia and the Pacific. For more than 70 years, we have been helping people in more than 20 countries navigate complexity and change to realize their aspirations. Our vision is a peaceful, just and thriving Asia and Pacific.

We root our work in local insight, on-the-ground presence, and trust. We operate as a committed and locally grounded partner, with most of our people coming from the places in which we work. This enables us to respond nimbly to evolving challenges, catalyze contextually relevant and effective solutions, and sustain relationships long enough to see systemic change take hold.

The Civil Society Partnership Fund: In 2024 the Australian Government committed AUD 35 million over four years to establish the Civil Society Partnership Fund (CSPF) to address the challenges of shrinking civic space across the Indo-Pacific. The Asia Foundation (TAF) is implementing the CSPF in partnership with the Australian Council for International Development (ACFID) and the Pacific Islands Association of Non-Governmental Organizations (PIANGO). CSPF will be implemented utilizing a virtual Hub team, with country-based personnel located in TAF's offices across the two regions.

Position Summary

The Program Director will provide high-level strategic, technical and operational leadership for CSPF and will be accountable for the overall quality, coherence and performance of the program. The Program Director will lead the program through mobilization and inception, establish its management, grants, MEL, risk and safeguarding systems, and steer a portfolio of partnerships and grants across Southeast Asia and the Pacific.

The Program Director will ensure that CSPF remains aligned with the program objective, Australia’s Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) requirements, the needs of local partners and the evolving context in each country. The Program Director will represent CSPF at senior meetings, engage strategically with DFAT Canberra and Posts, ACFID, PIANGO, TAF country offices, regional institutions and civil society partners, and lead the CSPF Hub team.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Program Leadership and Strategic Direction

  • Provide high-level strategic leadership and oversight of CSPF, ensuring activities align with the program logic and end-of-program outcomes, Australian Government priorities, partner needs, and DFAT guidelines and requirements.
  • Lead mobilisation and the nine-month inception phase, including establishing the Hub, developing the Inception Plan, Inception Phase Report and annual work plans.
  • Work closely with DFAT, TAF’s Country Offices and partners in the management of the program and provide timely, evidence-based advice on key decisions, risks and opportunities.
  • Lead and manage the CSPF Hub team.
  • Represent TAF and CSPF at relevant meetings, forums, events and senior stakeholder engagements.

Grant Making and Partnership Portfolio

  • Provide strategic oversight of CSPF's grant making activities.
  • Oversee CSPF’s partnership portfolio, embedding equitable partnership practice, working with local partners to shape priorities, resource allocation and program direction, while maintaining TAF’s fiduciary oversight and safeguarding.

Program Management, Performance and Reporting

  • Provide oversight and strategic input across financial management, grants management, procurement, contracting and administration, working closely with TAF's grants management, finance and compliance teams.
  • Provide high-level oversight of annual budget planning and execution, ensuring expenditure is aligned with approved work plans and that disbursement targets and payment milestones are met.
  • Oversee the preparation of work plans, budgets, annual reports and other deliverables.

Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning & GEDSI

  • Oversee the development and implementation of the program-wide MEL Framework and ensure ongoing alignment with DFAT's Design and Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Standards.
  • Oversee the development and implementation of the GEDSI Action Plan, ensuring gender equality and disability equity are embedded across grant making, partnerships, MEL and governance.

Qualifications, Experience and Competencies

Essential

  • Advanced qualification in international development, political science, public policy, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Substantial senior leadership experience managing complex, multi-country and/or regional donor-funded programs, including responsibility for strategy, delivery, supervision, budgets, risk, governance and donor relationships.
  • Strong understanding of civic space, civil society and governance dynamics in Southeast Asia and/or the Pacific, and experience working in politically sensitive or constrained operating environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply political economy analysis and thinking and working politically approaches to program strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior government and donor stakeholders, and to build trusted relationships with civil society, regional institutions and development partners.
  • Demonstrated experience managing fiduciary, safeguarding, child protection, PSEAH and do no harm requirements in programs that fund local partners.
  • Excellent strategic judgement, written communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to GEDSI, locally led development, equitable partnerships and inclusive leadership.

Highly Desirable

  • Direct experience working with DFAT, including knowledge of DFAT program management, MEL standards, risk, value for money and reporting requirements.
  • Experience working across Southeast Asia and/or the Pacific.
  • Experience establishing or leading a program through inception, including setting up grants, MEL, risk and safeguarding systems.
  • Experience with leadership development or cohort-based capability and coalition building programs for civic actors.

Location and Employment Terms

Australian-based candidates with unrestricted work rights in Australia are strongly preferred. Given the position's substantial engagement with DFAT and other Canberra-based stakeholders, preference will be given to applicants who are based in Australia and eligible to work in Australia without current or future visa sponsorship.

The Asia Foundation also welcomes applications from highly qualified candidates based across Asia and the Pacific. All applicants must have legal authorization to work in their country of residence and must not require visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Candidates hired in Australia will be employed through The Asia Foundation's designated Employer of Record (EOR) partner, which will serve as the legal employer for payroll, benefits administration, and employment compliance purposes.

This is a full-time, fixed-term employment position with an anticipated term of 4.5 years.

Compensation and Benefits

Compensation and benefits will be determined in accordance with the policies, salary structure, and benefit programs of the employing entity and applicable local law. The final compensation package will reflect the selected candidate's qualifications, experience, work location, and internal equity considerations.

This is a locally engaged position and not an international assignment. As such, the position is not eligible for expatriate or assignment-related benefits, including relocation assistance, housing, education, or post allowances. Employment terms and benefits will be administered in accordance with local laws and The Asia Foundation's policies in the country of employment.

How to Apply: Visit us at Careers | The Asia Foundation Your application must include a CV, cover letter, and three (3) professional references. Receipt of all applications will be acknowledged. Due to the volume of applications received, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding next steps in the selection process.

Application Deadline: December 23, 2026

All employees are expected to uphold the Foundation’s safeguarding, child protection, anti-harassment, anti-discrimination, and code of conduct policies. Any offer of employment will be subject to satisfactory, role-appropriate reference checks and background checks conducted in accordance with applicable law, organizational policy, and any applicable funder requirements. See Our Safeguarding Commitments for more details.

The Asia Foundation is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any status protected by applicable law. Qualified applicants with disabilities may request reasonable accommodations during the application and selection process and, if hired, to perform the essential functions of the position.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: Senior Product Manager Location: Remote (any location or time zone) Team: Product Reports to: Ben Dowling (Founder / Co-CEO) About IPinfo At IPinfo, we're building the world's best understanding of the internet.
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager

Location: Remote (any location or time zone)

Team: Product

Reports to: Ben Dowling (Founder / Co-CEO)

About IPinfo

At IPinfo, we're building the world's best understanding of the internet.

We're an independent, profitable, fast-growing internet data company whose products help thousands of developers and businesses understand internet connections and make better decisions. Our data powers products and decisions across cybersecurity, fraud prevention, payments, advertising, gaming and other industries.

We've spent years building sophisticated proprietary datasets, technology for understanding how the internet works, and a global measurement network of more than 1,400 points of presence in over 170 countries. Our products span geolocation, network intelligence, privacy detection and more, delivered through APIs, databases and integrations.

We believe there's an enormous opportunity to turn these capabilities into even more valuable products.

The opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who loves discovering opportunities, understanding customers and turning ideas into successful products.

Ideas come from everywhere at IPinfo. Our founder has plenty. Our engineering and data teams regularly uncover new possibilities. Customers bring us interesting problems, and our commercial teams see opportunities in the market.

You'll help us figure out which opportunities are worth pursuing, develop the most promising ones, and turn them into successful products. That means understanding how customers actually use our data, investigating underlying problems, exploring technical possibilities, assessing commercial potential, shaping products, and working with our teams to bring them to market.

Your initial focus will be our emerging data products, working with customers and technical teams to identify valuable use cases, shape compelling products, and bring them to market.

Some opportunities will start with a clear vision that needs validation, refinement and execution. Others will start with a technical discovery, an unmet customer need or something nobody has thought of yet. We want someone who enjoys both.

You'll work directly with IPinfo's founder and with talented engineers, data scientists, sales and solutions engineering colleagues. You'll have genuine autonomy and influence on product direction, while helping establish the product discipline that turns discovery into action and learning.

What the role looks like in practice

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. Your initial focus is personally investigating opportunities, shaping emerging data products, and driving them toward meaningful customer adoption.

  • Interview customers to understand their problems, how they use IPinfo data today, and where we could deliver more value.
  • Meet with engineering and data leaders to explore emerging capabilities, technical constraints and promising product directions.
  • Review and triage feedback from solutions engineering, sales and support, alongside customer usage and market signals, to identify patterns worth investigating.
  • Bring evidence-backed product proposals and recommendations to the founder, discussing priorities, tradeoffs and consequential investment decisions.
  • Work with technical, product marketing and commercial colleagues to move agreed products toward launch, adoption and learning from results.

You'll work closely with both Co-CEOs, our engineering and data leaders, solutions engineering, sales and our existing product marketing function. You won't personally do every part of product development or go-to-market; you'll bring the right people together, clarify decisions and ensure momentum.

What you'll do

  • Understand customers and uncover opportunities. Go beyond feature requests to understand how customers use our data, what problems they're trying to solve, how they solve them today, and which outcomes matter. Talk directly to customers, identify patterns and discover opportunities we might otherwise miss.
  • Connect technical capabilities to customer value. Work with engineering and data teams to understand what's possible and what our evidence can reliably support. Find the use cases and value propositions that connect those capabilities to real decisions customers need to make.
  • Validate and recommend. Investigate demand, commercial potential, strategic fit, tradeoffs and uncertainties. Develop clear, well-evidenced recommendations on what to pursue, test, defer or stop. Work closely with the founder on consequential product investment choices.
  • Drive products from idea to impact. Help define, prioritize, develop, launch and refine products in partnership with technical and commercial owners. Keep momentum, make decisions within agreed scope, and stay accountable for customer value and adoption, not just releases.
  • Own a lightweight feedback loop. Bring together insights from customers, sales, solutions engineering, support and the technical team. Make sure signals reach decisions, colleagues understand the reasoning, and learning from launched products feeds back into future work.
  • Measure and improve value delivery. Work with commercial colleagues on positioning, delivery, packaging and pricing experiments. Use adoption, customer outcomes and business results to improve our products and how customers access them.

About you

  • Customer discovery is a demonstrated strength. You can get beyond feature requests to actual problems, existing alternatives, decision-makers, constraints and evidence of value. You learn directly from customers.
  • You have strong product judgment. You can connect ambiguous technical capabilities with customer outcomes, distinguish evidence from assumption and make thoughtful recommendations about where to invest.
  • You take ownership. You have driven opportunities through meaningful decisions, product delivery and learning, with the judgment to follow through and to stop weak ideas.
  • You're technically fluent and curious. You can reason about data, APIs, evidence, delivery formats and technical constraints with engineers and data scientists. Experience with B2B data, developer tools, cybersecurity or internet infrastructure is especially useful.
  • You're commercially thoughtful and collaborative. You care about the full journey from useful data to value realized by a customer. You communicate clearly, challenge constructively and work effectively across teams without formal authority.
  • You use process pragmatically. You can create the minimum structure needed to learn, make decisions and ship, without confusing documents or activity with progress.

We're more interested in what you've built, how you think and the impact you've had than a rigid years-of-experience requirement or a particular career path.

Standard Job Description

Data Engineer Sr - Product Lifecycle Enablement

The Product Lifecycle Enablement organization is responsible for Enterprise PLM capabilities and processes, Engineering data strategy and implementation, and establishing common ontology & interfaces that enable 1LMX Digital Thread and embedded Al solutions.​

What You Will Be Doing:

In this role, you will be accountable for defining the MBE and engineering data strategy. Primary responsibilities include the following:

  • Defining engineer data stewardship roles and responsibilities
  • Acting as a data design authority for the model based enterprise
  • Documenting analytics architectures, strategies and metrics for a variety of audiences, including the executive level
  • Enforcing data integration and data access control best practices
  • Supporting Lockheed Martin data governance business rhythms and processes
  • Working closely with both functional and technical leads to ensure that analytics requirements are well understood, organized, and documented

Further Information About This Opportunity:
This role is fully remote. US Citizenship is required due to program requirements.

Delivers full-stack data solutions across the entire data processing pipeline. This relies on systems engineering principles to design and implement solutions that span the data lifecycle to: collect, ingest, process, store, persist, access, and deliver data at scale and at speed. It includes knowledge of local, distributed, and cloud-based technologies; data virtualization and smart caching; and all security and authentication mechanisms required to protect the data.Build data pipelines that clean, transform, and aggregate unorganized data into databases or data sources that are ready for analysis; Design and implement data solutions by defining functional capabilities, security, back-up, and recovery specifications; Work through all stages of a data solution lifecycle, e.g., analyze / profile data, create conceptual, logical and physical data model designs, architect and design ETL, reporting and analytics; Maintain data systems performance by identifying and resolving production and application development problems; calculating optimum values for parameters; evaluating, integrating, and installing new releases; Define standards, best practices, and certification processes for data objects

Basic Qualifications

  • Demonstrated knowledge of data stewardship, data ontology, and master data governance
  • Demonstrated knowledge of product lifecycle management tools and other engineering data repositories
  • Experience with data warehouses such as Oracle or DataBricks
  • Demonstrated knowledge of model-based engineering and data models
  • Experience supporting enterprise data systems or digital transformation
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience
  • US Citizenship is required due to program requirements

Desired Skills

  • Demonstrated success in developing data ontologies
  • Ability to abstract, summarize and explain data and analytics concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to work across organization boundaries to leverage best practices and share assets
  • Experience in data engineering, data architecture, or data governance functions
  • Ability to manage ambiguous or competing requirements, collaborating with project teams to align on solutions.

About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

- VINELAND/VABS Administration Experience Required

  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MA/MS in Psychology or equivalent
  • ≥25 administrations of study scales or similar semi-structured clinical interviews
  • Experience working with pediatric populations with neurodevelopmental delays

Working with internationally recognised standards such as FSC Forest Management, FSC and PEFC Chain of Custody, SBP and Preferred by Nature’s own certification, you will lead audits, review the work of other auditors, manage a client portfolio and drive sales and market development.   • Get to know your assigned client portfolio in Indonesia and establish working relationships with the Asia Pacific team.

Would also be great, but not necessary, if you:

  • Have experience as a quality reviewer or task manager in a certification body.

  • Have worked in an international, multicultural team.

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

Reports to the Sr. Director of Program Management. The Account Management team owns Reserv's customer relationships beginning in onboarding: we are the customer's single point of contact, the people who make sure claims service matches what was promised, and the reason customers renew and grow.

Our customer base has grown fast. This role owns a portfolio of roughly 30 MGA, carrier, and self-insured customers and is their reliable, responsive partner at Reserv. The work is high volume and hands-on: lots of inbound, lots of follow-through, and full attention for every customer in the book.

You will be an excellent fit if you are the most organized person on most teams you join, you answer fast and close the loop every time, and you like building the systems that let one person run a big book well. If you have helped a young company go from a handful of clients to dozens -- and built the process to support it -- we especially want to talk to you.

We hire owners. You see the whole outcome through, go to the details yourself, and keep a customer's confidence by being candid and keeping your word. You use sound judgment and look past today's fix to what would make the program better.

What you'll do

Book Ownership: Own the relationship for a portfolio of about 30 customers as their primary point of contact. Keep context across every account -- open issues, key contacts, recent claims activity -- so customers never have to repeat themselves.

Issue Resolution and Follow-Through: Drive inbound questions, service issues, and escalations to resolution, working with our claims, operations, finance, and data science teams to get answers. Close the loop with the customer every time, and spot repeat issues so they get fixed at the root.

Retention at Scale: Maintain a consistent touchpoint cadence across the book, monitor account health, and raise risk early. Make sure every customer gets the same quality of response and attention.

Systems and Scalability: Build and maintain the infrastructure that lets a high-volume book run well -- CRM hygiene, templates, cadences, and playbooks. Find the manual work that slows the book down and fix it, so the book can grow without anything getting missed.

Data and Insight: Be data fluent. Pull and explain claims data, and translate it into valuable insights for each customer. Spot trends across your accounts and flag risks and growth opportunities to leadership.

  • 3+ years in account management, customer success, or client services, ideally carrying a book of 20+ accounts at once
  • Highly organized: you run many accounts in parallel without dropping threads, and you can show us how you do it
  • Fast, professional communicator -- in writing and live -- who keeps customers informed before they have to ask
  • A problem solver who works across teams to get issues closed, not just passed along
  • Data fluent: able to translate data into valuable insights for a customer
  • Working knowledge of P&C insurance or claims; deep specialization in a single line of business is not required
  • Startup experience growing a client base (say, from 2 clients to 50) and building the processes behind it is a strong plus
  • A record of owning outcomes end to end and delivering on your commitments
  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance paired with frequent, regular corporate retreats to build team cohesion, reinforce culture, and have fun
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. The successful candidate will own features end to end, working across backend services, frontend applications, database architecture, third-party integrations, and cloud infrastructure.

The ideal candidate is someone who combines strong technical expertise with independent problem-solving skills, takes ownership of their work, and is comfortable leveraging AI coding agents as part of their daily development workflow.

Backend Development

  • Collaborate with the engineering team on CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.

  • Monitor application performance and help identify and resolve production issues.

  • Apply independent technical judgment to validate AI-generated code and ensure its quality, security, and reliability.

  • Build and maintain automated QA processes, including end-to-end test suites using Playwright.

Technical Skills

Backend:

Frontend:

  • TypeScript

  • Angular (preferred)

Database:

Additional Technologies:

Job Description

Trileaf Corporation is a nationwide environmental, architecture, and engineering consulting firm that assists clients with environmental due diligence, regulatory compliance, and engineering and architectural design. Location: Remote

Job Summary:

As a Sr. Architectural Project Designer, you would be responsible for initiating and overseeing a subset of Trileaf’s architectural and MEP projects from conception to completion. You would leverage your experience in field conditions, building materials, specifications, construction techniques, as well as building codes and permitting to successfully execute Construction Documents, including coordination with other disciplines.

Trileaf’s project designers manage their own projects individually, with feedback and input from Trileaf’s Project Managers and Architects. As such, Trileaf’s project designers must be experienced enough to understand the permitting requirements of various states, identify and correct potential building code compliance issues, and complete CDs to the satisfaction of the Architect of Record as well as the local Authority Having Jurisdiction, with limited oversight and direction.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Manage a subset of Trileaf’s projects:
    • Perform a cursory overview of the project upon receipt, to identify any potential issues with the Design Intent, on-site conditions, and any additional services that might be necessary for the completion of the project (e.g. Structural engineering, civil engineering, Site Plans, etc)
    • Schedule a complete a kickoff meeting with the Architect of Record, during which you will go over the above, and your proposed solutions to each
    • Within 2-3 business days, complete a Background Drawing and provide to Trileaf’s internal MEP department, alongside a timeline for completion. As the project lead on this project, the overall timeline is your responsibility – as such, it is also your responsibility to hold the MEP department accountable to their timelines (within your authority to do so)
    • Over the course of the next 10-15 business days (dependent on the client and prototype), complete a full set of Architectural Construction Documents
    • Complete your own self-QA/QC to identify any errors
    • You will be working on multiple projects at a time

Additionally, you will have responsibility to work directly with the Client on your delegated projects:

    • Diplomatically ask questions, and talk clients through the costs and benefits of certain decisions
    • Provide periodic updates to the status of reports (typically once/week)

Finally, as part of your responsibilities, you will also be responsible for performing Permitting Assistance on some of the CDs you have produced:

    • Fill out Permit Applications, in coordination with the Client
    • Submit the CDs to the jurisdiction in the manner requested
    • Coordinate any Plan Review fees with the client, and work through the requirements for Trileaf to be reimbursed
    • Periodically follow up with the jurisdiction for updates, and provide those updates to the Client
    • Work through any redlines and/or demonstrations requested from the AHJ
    • Upon approval, pull the AHJ-stamped CDs and submit to the Client (if applicable)

Basic Qualifications:

To be considered, the resume of the applicant must demonstrate the following qualifications/skills:

  • 3+ years of experience completing Construction Documents
    • Experience specific to retail, convenience stores, and/or restaurants strongly preferred
  • Intermediate knowledge of Building Codes, including Accessibility Compliance
  • Strong drafting ability in AutoCAD; REVIT a plus
  • AIA/NCARB registration is desired but not required

Education:

  • BA/BS in Architecture, Interior Design, 5 years (or more) experience in CD development

the role

role responsibilities

You will be:

  • Leading and conducting four half-day ADHD titration clinics per week (two days weekly), managing complex adult physical and mental health comorbidities across NHS and Right to Choose (RTC) pathways.

  • Carrying out structured psychiatric assessments for complex ADHD presentations, confirming diagnoses using standardised tools, and communicating outcomes clearly and compassionately with clients and families.

  • Providing clinical leadership, supervision, clear medical advice, and teaching to our multidisciplinary prescribing team, which includes pharmacists, nurses, non-medical prescribers, and psychiatrists.

  • Taking responsibility for the overall safe running of the service and leading clinical compliance and preparation for upcoming CQC inspections (comprehensive handover and regulatory onboarding provided).

  • Clinical & Titration Expertise: Substantial, demonstrable experience in ADHD medication titration—ideally within the NHS or with complex Right to Choose (RTC) patient groups—with confidence in managing complex physical and psychiatric comorbidities without unwarranted clinical caution.

  • Diagnostic Assessment Skills: Proven experience conducting comprehensive psychiatric assessments for ADHD using recognised diagnostic frameworks and standardised tools (e.g., DIVA, ACE).

jobs.description:
Position Purpose:
Performs regulatory oversight of delegated vendors supporting assigned markets, independently managing a portfolio that includes complex, high-risk, or multi-function delegation arrangements. Applies advanced knowledge of delegation oversight to analyze delegate performance and compliance with contractual obligations and applicable CMS, NCQA, federal, and state requirements; plans and conducts audits and monitoring reviews; supports the development and tracking of corrective action plans; escalates significant risks to leadership; and serves as a resource to less experienced team members.


Key Details: Applicants for this job have the flexibility to work remote from home anywhere in the Continental United States.


  • Serves as the senior market-level point of contact for regulatory oversight of assigned delegated vendors and delegated functions, including complex, high-risk, or multi-market delegation arrangements.
  • Monitors and analyzes delegate performance against contractual requirements, service-level expectations, regulatory standards, and market-specific obligations, including applicable CMS, NCQA, federal, and state requirements; identify trends, root causes, and systemic risks across delegates and markets.
  • Reviews delegate policies, procedures, reports, operational evidence, and documented processes to assess alignment with contractual and regulatory requirements.
  • Plans and conducts oversight activities, including desktop and onsite audits, file reviews, sample selection, monitoring reviews, and validation of submitted evidence and performance data; determine audit scope based on risk.
  • Identifies, assess the severity of, and communicate compliance gaps, performance deficiencies, emerging risks, and overdue deliverables; recommend risk-based mitigation strategies to delegates, internal stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Reports compliance issues and assist with development and management of corrective action plans and quality improvement activities through completion; evaluate the sustainability of remediation; and recommend escalation, enhanced monitoring, or sanctions, up to and including de-delegation, for unresolved or recurring issues in line with established governance processes.
  • Partners with market Compliance, Operations, Quality, Legal, Procurement, and business owners to coordinate oversight activities; serve as a subject matter expert advising on delegation requirements, contract language, and consistent vendor management practices.
  • Prepares and presents clear, accurate, and timely oversight documentation and analyses, including monitoring results, risk summaries, trend reports, and dashboards, for leadership and compliance committees.
  • Leads Joint Oversight Committee and other delegate governance meetings; present findings and recommendations, document decisions, assign action items, and hold delegates accountable for commitments through closure.
  • Coordinates delegate oversight deliverables for regulatory examinations, accreditation surveys, internal and external audits, and readiness reviews; serve as a primary point of contact for auditors and regulators on assigned delegates.
  • Maintains complete and audit-ready records in designated systems and lead continuous improvement of oversight tools, audit templates, controls, and standard work.
  • Monitors regulatory, contractual, and accreditation changes; assess their impact on delegated functions; and recommend updates to oversight policies, procedures, audit tools, and delegation agreements.
  • Provides guidance, training, and mentorship to Delegation Oversight Specialists and other team members; review work products for quality, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Compliance, Quality, or related field; or equivalent experience required
  • 4+ years Healthcare compliance, regulatory operations, quality management, delegated entity oversight, vendor oversight, auditing, or related experience required
  • Experience independently leading audits or oversight reviews, interpreting complex requirements, analyzing performance data and trends, managing corrective actions, and presenting findings to leadership required
  • Experience with CMS, NCQA, federal, state, or market-specific delegation requirements; regulatory examinations or accreditation surveys; and mentoring or guiding team members preferred

Licenses/Certifications:
Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC), Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ), Certified Healthcare Internal Audit Professional (CHIAP), or related certification preferred

Pay Range: $56,200.00 - $101,000.00 per year

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

Preferred by Nature is looking for a Senior Forestry & Sustainability Specialist based in Cameroon, Gabon, the Republic of the Congo, the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Côte d'Ivoire. As one of our key representatives in Central Africa, you will deliver high-quality forestry certification services under schemes such as FSC, PAFC and Preferred by Nature's own certification, support stakeholder engagement and business development, and contribute to sustainability projects in the region. Most of your time will be spent on certification and assurance work, with the rest focused on regional engagement, training and project development.

Working with us is never routine, so in your first year you can expect the following areas to be central to your work.

  • Conduct FSC, PAFC, Preferred by Nature certification and related audits and assessments, in line with our internal quality procedures and accreditation requirements.

  • Prepare and review audit reports to a high technical standard.

  • Manage audit schedules and your certification client portfolio, and provide technical support to clients.

  • Promote Preferred by Nature's services and support our regional strategy and commercial objectives.

  • Build relationships with stakeholders and institutions, and represent Preferred by Nature at relevant events.

  • Facilitate training courses and workshops.

  • Support proposal development and donor engagement, and contribute to sustainability projects beyond certification.

Your first year with us:

Within three months, you will:

  • Build a strong understanding of Preferred by Nature's forestry certification services, internal systems and quality procedures.

  • Get to know your client portfolio and key stakeholders in Central Africa.

  • Take part in audits and begin the qualification process for our schemes.

Within six months, you will:

  • Lead audits and prepare audit reports independently, and manage audit schedules for your portfolio.

  • Represent Preferred by Nature in meetings with clients, stakeholders and institutions.

  • Contribute to proposals and training activities in the region.

Within twelve months, you will:

  • Manage a stable certification portfolio with consistent audit quality and strong client satisfaction.

  • Review the reports of other auditors and act as a technical reference in the region.

  • Actively contribute to business development, partnerships and new sustainability projects in Central Africa.

Important that you:

  • Hold a bachelor's degree or higher in forestry, environmental sciences, natural resource management or a related field.

  • Bring at least three years of relevant experience in forestry, certification, sustainability or auditing.

  • Are qualified as an auditor under FSC, PAFC or a similar forest certification scheme.

  • Are professionally fluent in English and French.

  • Are available to travel regularly, nationally and internationally, mainly within Central Africa and Côte d'Ivoire.

  • Have strong analytical and report-writing skills.

  • Communicate well with clients and stakeholders, and are comfortable representing an organisation.

  • Have strong self-management skills and follow through on commitments.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you!

  • Global work culture

  • High degree of flexibility - remote work, work from home.

  • An in-depth onboarding and professional training that prepares you with the right skills and knowledge to thrive in this role.

  • Excellent opportunities for growth and professional development

jobs.title: Lead Roblox Developer | Pod E
jobs.excerpt: Join Cinnamon to make the Roblox games you want to build.
jobs.description:
Join Cinnamon to make the Roblox games you want to build. Once you’re on the team, you’ll pitch your own ideas through our greenlight process. If your game is approved, we’ll fund development, hire the team with you and back the launch. You’ll lead the creative direction.

The Role

We’re looking for a game maker to lead Pod E. You’ll lead development from the first playable prototype through launch and live updates. You’ll stay hands-on in your discipline, whether that’s art, programming or game design. You’ll decide which skills the game needs and help choose who joins your team. Cinnamon handles recruitment, contracts and studio operations so you can focus on making the game and leading the people building it. Our marketing team will work with you on the launch and help the game reach its audience.

About Cinnamon

Cinnamon is an independent Roblox studio behind LifeTogether (4+ billion visits), BlockSpin (1.3+ billion) and BayView (600+ million). We built these games from scratch, own them outright and use their success to fund what we make next. No investors. Our main Roblox community has 1.4M+ members. Our other Roblox groups include Cinnamon Go! (414.1K+), Cinnamon Cars (238.5K+) and Cinnamon X (46.6K+).

What You’ll Do

  • Pitch original game concepts and turn them into playable prototypes.

  • Work hands-on in your discipline and lead decisions on gameplay, presentation, progression and monetisation.

  • Define the roles your game needs, help select the team and set development priorities.

  • Use playtesting, player feedback and game data to decide what to improve.

  • Lead the game through launch and ongoing updates.

What We’re Looking For

  • Playable examples of games you’ve made, with a clear explanation of what you personally created, designed or led.

  • Hands-on experience in art, programming or game design and the judgement to make decisions about the whole game.

  • The ability to take a game from prototype to release, lead a small team and give feedback people can act on.

We want to see games with a clear creative identity. Show us a clever mechanic, a distinctive world or a fresh take on a familiar genre. Please leave brainrot clones out of your submission.

Roblox experience is highly valued. We also welcome game makers from other engines who want to build in Roblox Studio.

Working Arrangements and Compensation

This is a full-time, fully remote role. We’re open to permanent employees based in the UK who already have the right to work here and contractors based anywhere in the world. We’ll discuss time zone overlap during recruitment. Eligible UK permanent employees receive a company pension. We don’t offer visa sponsorship.

Compensation combines a base salary or contractor rate with a share of the game’s profits. We’ll agree the balance during recruitment. You can choose lower base pay with a higher profit share or higher base pay with a smaller profit share.

Recruitment Process

  1. Application review.Send us links to games you’ve made and tell us what you personally contributed to each.

  2. Recruiter interview.If shortlisted, you’ll meet with our recruiter to talk about your experience, the games you’ve made and what you’d like to build next.

  3. 48-hour creative task.You choose the concept. Build a Roblox game from scratch or add something playable to a Roblox game you’ve already made, such as a new level, mechanic or feature. If you build on an existing game, tell us what you added during the 48 hours. Submit a playable Roblox experience link. Roblox Studio files are ineligible. We’ll play your game and assess the idea, how it feels and what you built. AI tools are welcome. Be ready to explain your decisions and contribution.

  4. Final discussion.Meet our Operations Manager and relevant team members to discuss what you’d like to build, who you’d need on your team and how you’d structure your compensation. If there’s a strong fit on both sides, we’ll move to a formal offer or contractor agreement.

🎉 If there’s a strong fit on both sides, we’ll move to a formal offer.

You will lead the development of compelling business cases and comprehensive financial models including P&L projections, ROI analysis, and budget forecasting that are critical to client success.

This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S

We are standing up a product-led, agile-based operating model for Infrastructure, and we are looking for a Release Train Engineer and Portfolio Delivery Lead to run delivery across the organization. This person works across five agile teams (platform areas), carries portfolio-level visibility, and helps define and own the operating model as we build it. It is a foundational role: you will not inherit a mature train, you will help stand one up.

About the role

Infrastructure & Cloud is moving from a project-based structure to a product-led model built on five agile teams (platform areas) spanning cloud, network, reliability, developer experience, and data. The Release Train Engineer is the connective tissue across those teams: the person who makes cross-team delivery predictable, keeps dependencies and risks visible, and gives leadership a clear line of sight into flow and progress. You will partner closely with the product director, who owns product direction and the roadmap, while you own the cadence, the flow, and how the teams execute together.

What you will do

Run the train

  • Facilitate PSI planning and the planning cadence across the five teams, including readiness, cross-team syncs, demos, and retrospectives.
  • Establish and hold a consistent delivery rhythm across teams that do not run on the same clock today.

Manage flow, dependencies, and risk

  • Surface and manage cross-team dependencies, bottlenecks, and risks before they slow delivery.
  • Keep work moving across team boundaries, and escalate what needs leadership attention.

Portfolio and Quarterly Planning

  • Partner with Product Management, Business Teams, and Engineering leadership to facilitate quarterly planning, roadmap reviews, prioritization discussions, and portfolio planning activities.
  • Facilitate quarterly planning, capacity planning, and commitment management across the portfolio, ensuring priorities, staffing, and delivery commitments remain aligned.

Own portfolio visibility and governance

  • Own portfolio-level rollup and reporting across the teams: intake, status, and progress against priorities. Set the reporting standards and requirements, and work with ADO administrators who build the views.
  • Prepare and facilitate executive-level portfolio reviews, including delivery status, dependency management, capacity planning, risks, and commitment tracking.
  • Give leadership a single, reliable view of what is in flight, what is at risk, and what is landing.
  • Partner with the product director and product owners on prioritization and sequencing.

Coach and build the practice

  • Coach product owners, delivery managers, scrum masters, and delivery leaders on ways of working across the teams.
  • Raise the agile maturity of a newly formed organization.

Help define the operating model

  • Help design, stand up, and take ownership of the operating model itself, including the playbook, ADO standard, and PSI cadence developed with external partners: cadences, decision rights, intake, and the standards the teams work to.
  • Be at the forefront of a new organization as it forms.

Measure and improve

  • Define and track delivery metrics, and drive continuous improvement across the train.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience leading delivery, portfolio or program management, agile transformations, release trains, or large cross-functional programs.
  • Portfolio or program leadership: managing dependencies, flow, and reporting across a set of teams, not a single team.
  • Proven ability to coordinate delivery across geographically distributed teams, multiple leaders, and competing stakeholder groups.
  • Strong facilitation, and the ability to hold a cadence across teams and personalities.
  • Change-management and stakeholder-management skill, with comfort influencing without direct authority.
  • Fluency with agile tooling and portfolio rollup, for example Azure DevOps.

Preferred

  • Experience leading operating model transformations, organizational change initiatives, or product operating model implementations.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps, including experience establishing standards, portfolio reporting, dependency tracking, and executive dashboards.
  • Background in infrastructure, cloud, or platform engineering environments.
  • Coaching or mentoring experience with agile roles.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to help make the Home Details Page (HDP) materially better—clearer, more useful, more trustworthy, and more connected to the decisions shoppers are trying to make. You’ll combine strong interaction and visual design with systems thinking to improve how people find, understand, compare, and act on information about a home.


You’ll work across the HDP’s core experience: page structure and information hierarchy, listing facts and content, media and exploration, relevant neighborhood context, and the pathways that help shoppers save, share, compare, ask questions, tour, or rule out a home. You’ll identify high-confidence opportunities to improve the experience now while helping establish durable patterns that make future work better and more consistent.


Personalization is an important part of this role.
