jobs.description:
CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:

The Manager, Lending Solutions & Scenario Support is responsible for the strategic leadership and oversight of CrossCountry Mortgage's scenario support and alternate lending solutions functions. This role oversees the Regional Agency Scenario Team Lead and provides leadership to a team focused on identifying viable alternative lending solutions for loans that cannot proceed under the product, program, investor, or structure originally submitted. The Manager, Lending Solutions & Scenario Support maintains knowledge of CCM's available mortgage products, programs, investors, and lending guidelines and uses that knowledge to help identify responsible solutions for complex or challenging loan scenarios. This role serves as a senior escalation resource and works closely with Credit Policy, Underwriting, Product, Sales, Operations, Training, Compliance, and other business partners to improve loan-level outcomes, increase product awareness, identify emerging trends, and strengthen lending support across CrossCountry Mortgage.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the Regional Agency Scenario function and Alternate Lending Solutions function.
  • Directly manage and develop the Regional Agency Scenario Team Lead, establishing clear expectations for service, quality, productivity, employee development, and operational performance.
  • Assist in developing the new Alternate Lending Solutions team, including defining workflows, referral criteria, responsibilities, service-level expectations, quality standards, and performance measures.
  • Ensure both teams maintain the level of mortgage lending and underwriting knowledge necessary to provide accurate, reliable guidance.
  • Develop reporting that demonstrates the impact of the Scenario and Alternate Lending Solutions functions, including referral volume, turn times, outcomes, quality trends, and identified lending opportunities.
  • Establish consistent processes for escalating complex lending scenarios and loans requiring further review for alternative solutions.
  • Monitor operational results and trends to identify opportunities for process improvement, employee development, staffing, and enhanced support for Sales and Operations.
  • Promote collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and exceptional internal customer service across both functions.
  • Serve as a senior escalation resource on complex, sensitive, or high-priority lending scenarios.
  • Maintain knowledge of CCM's available mortgage products and programs, investor guidelines, eligibility requirements, and alternative lending solutions.
  • Establish and oversee a referral process for loans that cannot proceed under the product, program, investor, or structure originally submitted.
  • Review referrals from the Scenario Team to determine whether an alternative CCM product, program, investor, or loan structure may provide a viable lending solution.
  • Oversee the review of loans being recommended for denial, as applicable, to determine whether an appropriate alternative lending solution is available before the loan reaches an outcome.
  • Evaluate complex borrower and loan characteristics against available lending programs to identify potential alternative solutions.
  • Provide clear, actionable recommendations when an alternative product, program, investor, or structure is identified.
  • Ensure recommendations are appropriately documented and communicated to applicable business partners.
  • Establish appropriate handoffs to Underwriting and other decision-making functions, preserving established underwriting and credit authority.
  • Track referral volumes, outcomes, and reasons loans could not proceed as originally structured.
  • Identify recurring borrower or loan profiles for which CCM does not currently have a viable lending solution and provide feedback to Product and Credit Policy leadership regarding potential opportunities or product gaps.
  • Measure successful alternative-solution identification and use those results to evaluate the effectiveness of the function.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree and/or equivalent combination of education and relevant mortgage industry experience.
  • Extensive mortgage lending, underwriting, credit policy, product, or related experience, preferably across multiple agency, government, jumbo, non-agency, and/or non-QM programs.
  • Leadership or management experience, including experience developing employees and leading teams or functions.
  • Advanced knowledge of mortgage product eligibility, underwriting guidelines, income analysis, loan structuring, and investor requirements.
  • Commitment to accuracy, regulatory compliance, responsible lending, customer service, and continuous improvement.

Global University Systems is an international education group that empowers students to transform their lives through education. Role Overview

The Academic Partnerships Manager is a business development role. The postholder will source new academic partnerships for one of our brands within Global University Systems and turn them into revenue.

They include TNE arrangements, 2+2 and 3+1 programmes, articulation agreements, progression routes and feeder relationships. They link universities and institutions internationally with our university partners, mainly in the US and UK.

Most of the role is new business. The postholder will find and approach institutions, open conversations with senior leaders, build the case for each partnership and negotiate terms through to signature. They will then manage each partnership into delivery, making sure it produces enrolled students and income, and look for further commercial opportunities with each partner.

This role needs someone who has already built TNE and academic partnerships and can work independently from the start.

Key Responsibilities

Business development and new partnerships

  • Source new academic partnerships internationally, identifying universities, colleges, high schools and education groups with the potential to become academic partners or feeder institutions for GUS institutions.

  • Approach senior leaders at prospective institutions, including vice-chancellors, provosts, deans and heads of international, and secure meetings.

  • Build and manage a pipeline of new partnership opportunities, tracking each through to contract in the CRM.

  • Lead initial calls with prospective institutions to assess their programmes, student profile and fit with our university partners.

  • Work with our university partners to understand their academic portfolio, priorities and interest in new types of partnership.

  • Develop proposals and business cases for new partnerships, setting out the academic model, projected student numbers and revenue to GUS.

  • Deliver against agreed targets for new partnerships signed, student enrolments and revenue.

Partnership structuring and agreements

  • Design partnership models suited to each opportunity, including TNE delivery, dual and joint degrees, 2+2 and 3+1 programmes, articulation and credit transfer arrangements, and pathway and progression routes.

  • Work with university partners on curriculum mapping, credit recognition, admissions criteria and progression requirements.

  • Negotiate commercial and academic terms, including fee, revenue share and commission structures, and coordinate the drafting of MOUs, articulation agreements and partnership contracts with internal and partner legal teams.

Partnership management and delivery

Wider opportunities for GUS

  • Identify opportunities beyond the original agreement, including new programmes, additional markets, recruitment services, short courses and summer schools, and institutional consultancy.

jobs.description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. Understand better who we are by visiting www.systracanada.com.

Context

Reports To

BIM Coordinator / BIM Manager / Lead Engineer

Job Purpose

The BIM Modeller is responsible for developing, managing, and coordinating detailed 3D models for the light rail project. The role supports design development, multidisciplinary coordination, drawing production, and data compliance in accordance with project BIM standards, client requirements, and delivery milestones.

Missions/Main Duties

  • Civil 3D Modeling: Develop comprehensive 3D models for underground dry and wet utility networks (storm drainage, sanitary sewers, water distribution, culverts, tanks, and catch basins), as well as roadways, grading, surfaces, pavements, alignments, profiles, assemblies, and corridors.
  • Data Management: Create and manage data shortcuts and drawing references across multi-user environments using Autodesk Construction Cloud and Autodesk Desktop Connector.
  • Design Collaboration: Coordinate with civil, utility, and roadway engineers to model existing, staged, and proposed site servicing, grading, and drainage designs.
  • Documentation & Deliverables: Generate accurate plan, profile, and cross-section model and sheet files for design, construction, and regulatory submissions.
  • Customization & Standards: Set up and customize object styles, label styles, pipe network styles, part lists, and sheet sets to meet project-specific requirements.
  • Interdisciplinary Coordination: Conduct clash detection and coordination reviews across disciplines (utilities, drainage, grading, pavements, subgrade conditions, foundations, and electrical duct banks).
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure models adhere to municipal infrastructure standards, provincial guidelines, Transport Canada, ICAO Annex 14, OPSD, and other applicable codes.
  • Model Integrity: Maintain up-to-date models reflecting design revisions, construction phasing, and final turnover, including accurate representation of as-built conditions.
  • Workflow Optimization: Implement and improve BIM workflows, leveraging automation and scripting tools where appropriate.

Profile/Skills

  • Required Qualifications

    • Diploma or Degree in Civil Engineering Technology, Geomatics, or a related field.
    • Minimum 5 years of experience in civil modeling (minimum 3 years of Civil 3D specifically), with proven expertise in both underground utilities and road/surface design.
    • Mandatory proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D (utilities, alignments, corridors, assemblies, surfaces, and data shortcuts), AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Autodesk Desktop Connector, and Bluebeam Revu.
    • Experience with advanced tools such as Dynamo for Civil 3D, InfraWorks, Navisworks Manage, Python scripting for automation, Bentley InRoads/OpenRoads, and Autodesk Inventor is a strong asset.
    • Demonstrated experience in modeling stormwater management systems, pressure and gravity-fed networks, and large-scale roadway and pavement infrastructure.
    • Skilled in integrating data from multiple sources (GIS, survey, as-built drawings) into coordinated BIM/CAD environments.
    • Knowledge of hydraulic and hydrologic modeling, stormwater and surface drainage, detention systems, and flood control compliance is an advantage.
    • Strong understanding of applicable Ontario and Canadian civil, road, and utility standards (OPSD, OTM Book 7, MOE/MTO guidelines, Transport Canada, ICAO).
    • Excellent coordination, documentation, and version control practices.
    • Self-directed, detail-oriented, and capable of managing priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
    • Strong communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Invitation Homes is the nation's largest single-family home rental company. Our product teams build the customer-facing experiences and the proptech systems that residents, prospects, and associates rely on every day. When we ship, people feel it.


We've built a product culture that takes that responsibility seriously: collaborative teams, high standards, and a genuine investment in the people around you. Great products are built by people who are supported, growing, and proud of what they ship.


This role combines strategic depth and cross-organizational influence. You will work on the company's most complex initiatives, the ones that cross business units, span customer-facing and operational software, and cannot be solved inside a single team. You will work directly with executive and senior leadership to support them in defining the outcomes that matter, then break the work down across the business to expose complexity, dependencies, and risk before they slow delivery.


You define the product strategy and approach, shape the work, and bring a clear recommendation when direction is unclear. Your reach spans the entire organization, not a single team or vertical. You partner with product leads, who bring domain and product depth, and with designated business leads, who bring business ownership and context, so planning and shipping teams have clear direction and what you define gets executed well across teams.

What You'll Do


  • Work directly with senior leadership to identify target outcomes, translate business goals into clear product objectives, and define how success will be measured.
  • Define the product strategy and cross-functional approach for the initiatives you support. The business owns the decisions and the outcomes, product leads and delivery teams own planning and shipping, and you own the clarity and quality of the approach that connects them.
  • Break down large initiatives across business units to surface complexity, dependencies, sequencing constraints, and technical and customer experience considerations early.
  • Set the approach for initiatives that scale across customer-facing and enterprise property technology, connecting the resident and associate experience to the systems and workflows behind it so decisions in one domain account for their effect on the other.
  • Frame trade-off decisions, bring a clear recommendation to business leaders, and give teams the clarity to move forward once a decision is made.
  • Maintain a working understanding of technical architecture and delivery constraints so you can weigh trade-offs credibly with engineering.
  • Apply sound product principles to unfamiliar domains and adapt quickly to new business areas and technologies.
  • Embed with teams as a focused strategic resource help unblock decisions and resolve cross-team conflicts, keep work moving with a bias to action, and build momentum without creating dependency on you.
  • Transition out once the work is stable, leaving behind durable artifacts such as approach definitions, dependency maps, decision records, and playbooks.
  • Identify shared needs across product areas and set the frameworks, standards, and guidance for strategy, discovery, prioritization, and outcome measurement that solve them at scale.
  • Present and align stakeholders on strategy and approach, translating risk, dependency, and technical trade-offs into clear choices for audiences from executives to individual contributors. Facilitate strategy reviews and working sessions, drive conversations toward decisions, and help everyone commit once direction is set.
  • Coach product leads and product managers at multiple levels in framing outcomes, managing dependencies, and communicating strategy, helping them grow in depth and expand their reach.


What You Bring


  • 10+ years of product management experience, with a demonstrated record of impact beyond a single team or product area.
  • Experience defining the product approach for complex, cross-functional initiatives that span multiple business units and technical systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with executive leadership to help define outcomes, shape strategy, and secure alignment.
  • Experience across both consumer-facing and internal or operational software, or a clear ability to bridge them.
  • Strong technical fluency: you can engage with engineers on architecture, integrations, and trade-offs, and understand the constraints that shape what is possible.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including proposals that have influenced direction at a department or company level.
  • A track record of coaching and developing product managers and cross-functional partners.
  • A drive to raise the bar for yourself, the standards you champion, and the people you develop.
  • A degree or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job Title: QA Automation Analyst

Location: Remote | USA, Canada
Reports to: Team Lead, Quality Assurance

Employment Type: Full-time

This is a new vacancy

About the Role:

As a QA Engineer, you will own quality for features and services end to end - designing test strategy, building automation, and validating behavior across web, API, and data layers. You will partner with engineers, product managers, and other QA engineers to deliver releases that meet JD Power's quality bar.

This is a fully independent delivery role: you will take features from requirements to release-ready with minimal supervision, make sound judgment calls about risk and coverage, and contribute meaningfully to the team's automation suite and quality practices.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the test approach for assigned features; decide what to automate, what to test manually, and what to defer
  • Translate requirements and acceptance criteria into complete, risk-based test coverage
  • Design tests across functional, regression, integration, API, and data validation layers
  • Identify gaps in requirements and edge cases during refinement, before code is written
  • Assess release risk for your features and communicate it clearly
  • Build and maintain automated tests independently in the team's frameworks (UI, API, and data)
  • Write maintainable, well-structured test code; apply the same engineering standards expected of product code
  • Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines; keep suites fast, stable, and trustworthy
  • Diagnose and fix flaky tests; drive down noise in the pipeline
  • Contribute reusable utilities, fixtures, and test data helpers to the shared framework
  • Investigate defects to a root-cause hypothesis before filing; include logs, traces, and reproduction steps
  • Triage and prioritize defects with engineering and product partners
  • Track defect trends in your area; surface patterns that point to systemic quality issues
  • Verify fixes and confirm regression coverage is added where appropriate
  • Partner with developers throughout the sprint; shift testing left rather than validating at the end
  • Participate in code reviews and design discussions from a testability and quality perspective
  • Support release activities, including smoke testing, validation, and post-release verification
  • Mentor QA engineers earlier in their career on test design and tooling
  • Track and report test coverage, pass rates, defect escape rate, and automation stability for your area
  • Use data to argue for where testing investment should go next
  • Report transparently on quality risks, blockers, and coverage gaps

Required Qualifications:

  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years developing automated tests with modern web and API frameworks such as Playwright, Pytest, Postman/Newman/Bruno/Insomnia, or REST client libraries, in TypeScript or JavaScript
  • 5+ years integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, with hands-on GitLab CI experience (pipeline configuration, stages, runners, artifacts, and quality gates on merge requests)
  • Experience testing cloud-native services and REST APIs built on Node.js/NestJS or equivalent, including contract testing and service virtualization or mocking
  • Experience validating data: writing SQL against relational databases (PostgreSQL) and cloud data platforms (Snowflake), and testing data pipelines for completeness, accuracy, and freshness
  • Experience testing React front ends, including component-level testing and accessibility validation
  • Experience with Git-based workflows, code review, and trunk-based or feature-branch delivery models in GitLab
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent), containerized environments, and API gateway patterns
  • Experience with observability and diagnostics tooling (Datadog, or equivalent logging, metrics, and tracing platforms) to investigate failures across application, data, and infrastructure boundaries
  • Detailed knowledge of all phases of the Software Testing Lifecycle, and of shift-left practices that move quality ownership into the development team
  • Experience designing and executing test suites across unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, and acceptance levels, including performance and resilience testing
  • Proven technical leadership of multidisciplinary teams, including distributed onshore and offshore partners
  • Familiarity with service-oriented and microservice architecture, API design principles, and relational and non-relational data modeling
  • Working knowledge of secure development and testing practices, including authentication and authorization flows and common application security risks

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on use of AI coding and testing assistants in daily work; experience applying LLMs to test generation, test data creation, or failure triage
  • Experience building or evaluating automated quality signals for AI-enabled features — evaluation harnesses, regression suites for non-deterministic outputs, and guardrail testing
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence for test management, traceability, and defect workflow
  • Experience with DORA metrics and using delivery data to target quality investment

Compensation and Benefits

This position has a starting salary range of $80,000 - $100,000 CAD / $100,000 - $120,000 USD per year. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

· We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

· We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

· We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

· We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

· We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.


Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact for accommodation request.


Data Privacy

JD Power does not disclose your personal data to unauthorized third parties. However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. You agree to the fact that to the extent necessary your personal data may be transferred and/or disclosed to any company within JD Power group of companies as well as to third parties acting on JD Power’s behalf, including also transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided JD Power with your personal data. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America. If you are a California or United Kingdom resident, additional disclosures about the information we collect and how we use that information can be found by clicking here.

Applications

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where employment is offered. JD Power does not provide employment sponsorship for this position.

This position is posted exclusively on and select trusted job boards such as LinkedIn or Indeed. All official communication comes from email addresses ending in @jdpower.com or @jdpa.com. We will never ask for payment, equipment purchases, or upfront fees. We may take additional steps to verify candidate information to protect the integrity of our recruitment process.

Go-to-Market Project Manager | Marketing Strategy & Execution

In this role, you will own the go-to-market process end to end - coordinating cross-functional teams, launching campaigns, and turning strategy into measurable results.

We are accepting applications over the next two months and will fill the position as soon as we find the right fit.

As the Go-to-Market Project Manager, you'll be the engine that drives our marketing strategies and execution across various channels. You’ll oversee the go-to-market process, ensuring our content resonates with target audiences and fuels lead generation efforts. From SEO-driven content creation to campaign management, you’ll act as the linchpin between marketing and sales, translating business goals into impactful, market-facing strategies.

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations.   • A passionate and fun-loving team that thrives on collaboration.

  • A startup mindset with ample opportunities for personal and professional growth.

  • Regular team activities and collaborative sessions.

  • A comprehensive onboarding process, with a ramp-up period to set you up for success.

  • A supportive team that values open communication, direct feedback, and your contributions.

  • The chance to shape the future of software escrow and make a direct impact on the business.

  • Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with a focus on creating compelling marketing content.

  • Ability to pragmatically use tools like ChatGPT to generate unique and high-quality content efficiently.

  • Deep knowledge of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in marketing and content management.

  • Proven project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.


Required Experience:

  • Experience with HubSpot and Figma is a plus.

To apply, use the Apply button on this listing. In your application, tell us how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Show us your role in our company’s future and our role in yours, address some of the work we do, and introduce yourself as a colleague.

jobs.description:
your mission

About the role


AI didn't kill the SDR role. It killed the average one. The ones who survive — and win — are the ones who figured out how to use AI as a force multiplier rather than a shortcut.

This is not a high-volume, spray-and-pray prospecting role. Timefold sells a technical platform into companies where scheduling, routing, and optimization are commercially important. Good outbound therefore starts with understanding the account, identifying the right trigger, and creating a relevant reason for the right person to speak with us.

You will work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Solutions Engineering to create qualified conversations in target accounts. You will focus on software vendors, OEMs, and technically mature organisations with complex planning problems.

The SDR owns the work before the opportunity: account research, outreach, early qualification, and a clean handoff to Sales. The Account Executive owns the opportunity and commercial process once it is qualified.

This role reports to the Head of Sales.

What the role looks like

Build qualified outbound demand
  • You dig into target accounts and prioritize them based on ICP fit, relevant use cases, company context, product or open-source adoption signals, and commercial potential — no spray-and-pray here.
  • You catch the signals that actually matter: hiring sprees, funding rounds, product launches, tech stack changes, content engagement, or operational complexity that screams "we need this."
  • You map accounts like a detective, pinpointing the technical, operational, and executive stakeholders who actually move the deal.
  • You run outreach that doesn't feel like outreach — tailored messages across email, phone, LinkedIn, and the communities where our audience actually hangs out.
  • You turn conversations into qualified meetings and Sales-accepted leads that AEs are genuinely excited to pick up.
  • You keep HubSpot squeaky clean — contacts, activity, source, lead status, and qualification data, all accurate, all the time.
  • You share the playbook, openly: what messaging lands, what objections keep popping up, which personas and signals convert, and which account segments are worth chasing.
  • You team up with Marketing, trading campaign feedback, outbound insights, and content ideas that actually make prospects lean in.
  • You help shape Timefold's outbound motion as we scale — this isn't a role where you follow a script, it's one where you help write it.
Craft outreach for technical buyers

We are targeting developers, architects, engineering leaders, product leaders, and data teams — that means you'll touch upon genuinely complex planning and optimization problems, not just the buzzwords around them.

  • You engage operational and executive stakeholders with messaging tied to business outcomes: service quality, operational efficiency, scheduling complexity, growth, and build-versus-buy decisions.
  • You know the difference between a technical evaluator, a champion, an operational stakeholder, and the economic buyer — and you flex your approach accordingly, because one-size-fits-all pitches don't work on people who solve hard problems for a living.
  • You treat open-source and community signals as a research starting point, not a shortcut — you validate relevance before ever mistaking interest for intent.

Convert & engagement

Success is not measured only by emails sent or meetings booked.

  • Meaningful engagement in target accounts — not just opens and clicks, but real conversations.
  • Meetings that actually show up and get accepted by Sales.
  • Sales-qualified leads with credible fit, real intent, and a clear next step — no mystery leads.
  • Opportunities sourced from the right accounts and segments, not just whoever answered the phone.
  • Sharp insight on which messages, personas, and triggers actually convert — so the whole team gets smarter, not just you.

your profile

You're probably a fit if

  • Start-up energy doesn't scare you - it motivates you.
  • 3+ years of SDR, BDR, or outbound sales experience in a B2B technology company.
  • A track record of creating qualified pipeline or Sales-accepted opportunities not only booking meetings.
  • Experience prospecting into mid-market or enterprise accounts.
  • Experience engaging technical buyers such as developers, architects, engineering leaders, product leaders, or IT teams.
  • You've used AI outreach tools hands-on and have strong opinions about what actually works
  • You think in workflows, not tasks — you automate the repetitive so you can focus on the creative
  • You've prospected into technical buyers and know that developers delete lazy sequences on sight
  • You measure yourself on pipeline generated, not activity logged
  • Curiosity about technology. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be able to hold a credible conversation about technical platforms, developer tools, and enterprise software.
  • Data-driven and rigorous with HubSpot and CRM hygiene.

why us?

This is Timefold -We’re building the future of intelligent planning—join us on the journey.


We are an AI planning optimization platform built on powerful, field-proven open-source solver technology. Simply put: we enable software builders to tackle some of the world's most complex, high-impact operational planning problems. From optimizing vehicle routing and employee scheduling to streamlining maintenance planning and field service logistics, our tech delivers massive economic value where it matters most.

We are on a relentless mission to free the world from wasteful scheduling! Founded in 2023, we represent the exciting next chapter of OptaPlanner—the legendary, field-proven open-source project that laid the foundation for everything we build today.

Today, we are a technically sharp, deeply passionate team of over 40 people. While our headquarters are nestled in the iconic Wintercircus building in Ghent, Belgium, we operate as a remote-first team with vibrant hubs across Belgium, the Czech Republic, Brazil and the US.

We're hiring a Senior Sales Development Representativeto help build Timefold’s outbound motion in the EMEA region.

What You'll Learn

Joining Timefold provides a unique opportunity for continuous learning and growth. In this role you will learn:

  • How to build an outbound motion from zero inside a technical product company — the kind of experience most SDRs never get because they inherit someone else's playbook
  • How enterprise developers and engineering leaders actually buy software — and why that changes everything about how you sell
  • How to use AI as a genuine commercial advantage, not just a tool to send more emails
  • What it takes to convert open-source community traction into enterprise pipeline — a motion that is becoming one of the most valuable in B2B GTM

What do we offer


Culture & Environment

At Timefold, we offer more than just a paycheck; we offer a culture where you can thrive. We promise an open and authentic workplace where you will be trusted to act, trusted to ask, and supported as you seek to grow. In return, we look for people who are ready to own and deliver impactful results.

Standard Perks

  • A Full Time position in a fast growing start up environment
  • A competitive salary package complemented by a range of local benefits

How we work & connect

  • Flexibility : our focus is on your talents, not your location. Choose the working arrangement that suits you best, whether it is remote, hybrid or on-site
  • Our dedication to creating an inclusive environment, where diversity is celebrated and everyone is treated with fairness and respect <3
  • Regular team building activities and gatherings to enhance (international) team spirit and cooperation (this requires a willingness to travel once or twice a year)

At Lumeris, we believe that our greatest achievements are made possible by the talent and commitment of our team members. Position:

Director, Customer Success

Position Summary:

Own ongoing operations within customer accounts measured in account expansion, adoption, satisfaction and success through strategic leadership. In a player/coach role, directly lead key accounts and build a high-performing Customer Success team to ensure long-term customer satisfaction and retention. Partner closely with the Product, Enablement, and Technical teams to ensure customers are effectively onboarded and continuously derive value from Tom.

Job Description:

Customer Success Management

  • Ownership of Customer Accounts: Take full accountability for the success of customer accounts post-implementation, ensuring ongoing satisfaction and success with Tom.
  • Team Leadership: Document, build, and scale the structure for Customer Success Managers (CSMs), leading and mentoring them to ensure they deliver exceptional service and achieve customer goals.
  • Customer Expansion: Own the customer accounts and work to identify opportunities for expansion, ensuring customers derive maximum value from Tom’s AI-powered healthcare solutions.
  • First Client Leadership: Serve as the lead Customer Success Manager for the first clients, ensuring their onboarding, utilization, and satisfaction with the product. Your leadership will set the standard for customer success across the company.
  • Player-Coach Role: Actively engage with customers and lead by example, while also building a team that will take over ongoing customer management, ultimately transitioning into a leadership role for the customer success function.

Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams

  • Partnership with Product: Collaborate closely with the Product team to define success metrics, reporting structures, and data visualizations that accurately reflect customer outcomes, engagement, and satisfaction.
  • VBC Product Collaboration: Partner with the Value-Based Care (VBC) Product Manager to align customer success goals with VBC initiatives, ensuring Tom’s integration drives measurable impact in value-based care settings.
  • Best Practices Implementation: Drive the adoption of best practices within the Customer Success team, ensuring consistent and high-quality service delivery across customer accounts.
  • Enablement & Activation Collaboration: Work alongside the Enablement and Technical Implementation teams to ensure successful customer activation and ensure customers are up-to-date on all relevant product and service offerings, including new Tom-like services.

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

  • Tracking & Reporting: Track, report, and follow up on the adoption, value, utilization, and engagement of Tom services with customers. Use data-driven insights to optimize customer experience and outcomes.
  • Customer Health Monitoring: Continuously monitor and assess customer health, utilizing success metrics and feedback loops to identify risks and opportunities for proactive engagement and account growth.
  • Lead and grow the Customer Success Manager team, ensuring they have the tools, resources, and support needed to succeed. Foster a high-performance culture centered around customer satisfaction and business impact.
  • Training & Development: Ensure that the Customer Success team is well-equipped with the knowledge and training to handle new product offerings, updates, and services, keeping customers informed and engaged.

  • 12+ years of relevant experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related field, with at least 5 years in a leadership or team-building role within the healthcare technology space.

  • Strong player-coach mindset, with the ability to mentor and develop a team while also actively managing key customer accounts.
  • Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentorship skills, with a focus on building a high-performing team that can deliver exceptional results across customer accounts.
  • Deep understanding of customer success principles, with a proven track record of driving customer retention, engagement, and expansion.
  • Experience in managing complex customer accounts and navigating the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding to long-term relationship management.
  • Solid understanding of AI-driven healthcare platforms, SaaS products, and the healthcare technology landscape.
  • Ability to quickly become an expert on Tom and similar services, with a passion for educating both internal teams and customers on new product features and best practices.
  • Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to partner with internal teams such as Product, Enablement, and Technical Implementation to drive customer success outcomes.

  • Expertise in using data-driven insights to track customer success metrics, measure adoption, and assess overall product utilization.

Our Story

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here.

The Opportunity

TopDog Law is a growing, multi-state personal injury firm. The Director of Pre Litigation Strategy is a licensed attorney who leads our national pre-litigation operation, including case management and supports the field provider team. The role is executive operational leadership and does not carry a caseload.

This leader brings a practicing attorney's perspective to how pre-litigation excellence in every state we serve. They guide our standards, training and growth into new markets, build and develop the leaders who run the team, and partner closely with managing attorneys, compliance and the teams that support our clients through treatment and toward resolution.

What You Will Own

PRELITIGATION STRATEGY AND LEGAL PERSPECTIVE

  • Bring an attorney’s perspective to the development and ongoing improvement of national case management standards.
  • Partner with operating leaders across teams to shape training, documentation, workflows and client communication.
  • Review proposed operational changes and updates before launch, providing legal insight and practical recommendations.
  • Provide ongoing oversight and guidance to operating leaders as standards and practices are implemented across teams.
  • Partner with managing attorneys and the firm’s compliance attorney on decisions involving legal or regulatory considerations, while recognizing that the compliance attorney leads compliance and regulatory matters.

GROWTH AND NEW MARKETS

  • Lead the pre-litigation side of new state launches, including readiness, staffing and training including capacity and position management ensuring staffing across the states for Case Management and Operational Management support.
  • Advise leadership on market differences as the firm grows.

LEADERSHIP AND TEAM DEVELOPMENT

  • Support and develop the case management leadership team and the field provider team.
  • Build a bench of future leaders and set consistent standards for coaching and performance management.
  • Help recruit and assess leaders across markets.

OPERATIONS AND PERFORMANCE

  • Keep staffing and capacity aligned with case volume.
  • Maintain one consistent, scalable pre-litigation process across states.
  • Use scorecards and dashboards to drive quality, client experience and timely case progression.
  • Partner with technology and analytics teams on the tools the team uses.

What You Bring

Required:

  • Juris Doctor from an ABA-accredited law school.
  • Active license to practice law, in good standing, in at least one state.
  • 5+ years practicing plaintiff personal injury law, with substantial pre-litigation experience.
  • 5+ years leading people, including leaders of other leaders, across multiple locations or states.
  • Understands how pre-litigation practice differs by state and can turn those differences into clear standards and training.
  • Comfortable working with data, including scorecards, dashboards and capacity planning.
  • Has led large operational change without losing quality.
  • Strong partner across attorneys, operations and compliance.

Instead, we’re looking for someone who can translate their existing experience and rapidly come up to speed on our product approach. This means that depending on where you are on your journey, this role could range from Product Manager to Senior Product Manager or Staff Product Manager. What You'll Do

Patient Access Specialist 2

DISCLOSURES

The specific statements shown in each section of this job description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria necessary to perform the job successfully. Job responsibilities may be modified or expanded over time, and the company will inform the contractor of any such changes.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Freedom Health Systems, LLC (FHS) is a mission-driven healthcare advisory and management consulting firm that partners with behavioral health and human services organizations to improve access, equity, and operational excellence. While we do not provide direct healthcare services, we support providers through program development, accreditation, compliance, and the implementation of clinical and operational best practices, strengthening organizational infrastructure and enabling sustainable service expansion. Our expertise includes revenue cycle management, prior authorization, virtual front office support, medical billing and coding, human resources, and compliance consulting. FHS is deeply committed to breaking down barriers in behavioral health, with a strong focus on serving marginalized and underserved communities, and we foster a collaborative, forward-thinking environment rooted in innovation, integrity, and community impact.

COMPANY WEBSITE:

COMPANY PHONE NUMBER: (667) 239-9572

HR DEPARTMENT PHONE NUMBER: (667) 400-6206 EXT 10

HR DEPARTMENT EMAIL ADDRESS:

POSITION TITLE: Patient Access Specialist 2

ALTERNATE TITLE(S): Admissions Coordinator, Intake Specialist, Access Services Associate

COMPANY: Freedom Health Systems, LLC

DIVISION: Operations

DEPARTMENT: Patient Access

UNIT: N/A

ACCOUNTABLE TO: Patient Access Department Manager (Operations Manager 11, in absence of Patient Access Department Manager)

ACCOUNTABLE FOR: Managing the intake, enrollment, and service coordination process for clients entering behavioral health and care management programs; ensuring accurate data collection, regulatory compliance, and efficient communication with internal teams and external referral sources.

CLASSIFICATION: Exempt – Independent Contractor (Non-U.S., W-8BEN)

WORK SCHEDULE: This schedule reflects 8 working hours per day, totaling 40 hours per week, across five (5) scheduled workdays, with two (2) days off as indicated in the assigned weekly schedule. Scheduling needs may vary based on business demands, and adjustments may be required as reasonably assigned.

COMPENSATION RANGE: $6 - $8 USD per hour, commensurate with experience and qualifications

ANTICIPATED TRAVEL: N/A

SUMMARY OF POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

The Patient Access Specialist serves as the first point of contact for prospective clients entering any of Freedom Health Systems’ programs. This role is critical to ensuring timely, compassionate, and efficient intake services for outpatient behavioral health, psychiatric rehabilitation (PRP), substance use treatment, health home, and entitlements case management services.

This role involves receiving referrals, conducting intake screenings, verifying insurance or funding eligibility, coordinating appointments for initial assessments, and supporting internal transfers or discharges across contracted service lines. The Patient Access Specialist supports access to care while ensuring compliance with COMAR, HIPAA, and payer guidelines.

SCHEDULED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Receive and log incoming referrals from internal and external sources (providers, MCOs, hospitals, DSS, families).
  • Conduct initial outreach to referred individuals and/or guardians to complete intake screenings.
  • Collect and verify required demographic information, insurance details, and consent forms prior to service initiation.
  • Schedule intake assessments with the appropriate clinician or provider.
  • Track, monitor, and follow up on pending or incomplete intake files and documentation.
  • Verify Medicaid and/or insurance eligibility for all referred individuals.
  • Confirm program-specific eligibility criteria for PRP, OMHC, HH, SUD, and ECM services.
  • Coordinate with billing and credentialing staff to ensure active coverage prior to service start.
  • Assist clients with benefits navigation and redetermination referrals as needed.
  • Facilitate internal transfers between programs (e.g., PRP to OMHC, HH to SUD).
  • Update electronic health records (EHR) and internal tracking systems to reflect transfers and discharges.
  • Notify program leads, supervisors, and administrative staff of transfers and discharges in real time.
  • Support re-engagement efforts for clients lost to follow-up.
  • Ensure all intake documentation is collected, uploaded, and verified in the EHR system (e.g., ICANotes).
  • Maintain accurate logs of referrals, admissions, discharges, and eligibility statuses.
  • Ensure HIPAA-compliant communication and recordkeeping at all times.
  • Assist with data entry and submission of required documentation for audits, surveys, and regulatory reviews.

UNSCHEDULED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide front desk coverage or phone reception support as needed
  • Assist with appointment reminder calls or patient follow-ups
  • Collaborate with clinical and administrative teams to resolve access barriers
  • Participate in quality improvement and performance tracking meetings

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer and frequent meetings via video or phone; occasional in-person site visits

WORK CONDITIONS

  • Remote
  • Fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with collaborative teams

COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS

  • Working knowledge of COMAR, Medicaid, HIPAA, and behavioral health program eligibility criteria
  • Proficiency in electronic health record systems (e.g., ICANotes, Credible, or similar)
  • Strong leadership, time management, and communication skills

LEVEL OF EDUCATION / TRAINING / QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Associate’s Degree in Nursing or Bachelor of Science in Nursing from an accredited program (required)

Licenses/Certifications

  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in good standing

Experience

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in admissions, intake, or access management in a behavioral health or healthcare setting
  • Experience with Medicaid/MCO systems (e.g., ePREP, CRISP)
  • Prior experience in behavioral health or case management programs is preferred
Salary: $6 - $8 per hour

Notre marketing génère aujourd'hui un flux important de leads très qualifiés de chefs d'entreprise. Notre priorité : les rappeler le plus vite possible.

En tant que Setter Minute, ta mission principale est de rappeler chaque nouveau lead dans les minutes qui suivent son inscription, de faire un premier tri rapide, puis de l'orienter vers un Setter ou un Closer.

Tu interviendras exclusivement sur des leads entrants, sur des créneaux définis, en lien direct avec les Setters et Closers de l'équipe.

Tu seras en charge de :

  • Appeler les nouveaux leads dans la minute qui suit leur inscription ou le téléchargement d'un contenu (e-book, conférence gratuite, etc.).

  • Mener un appel de tri court, d'environ 5 minutes, pour comprendre la situation du prospect.

  • Transformer un maximum de leads en rendez-vous planifiés, grâce à une communication fluide, empathique et engageante.

  • Renseigner le CRM (HubSpot) après chaque appel, pour que le Setter ou le Closer dispose de tout le contexte.

  • Partager tes retours terrain pour améliorer le process en continu.

💼 Expérience

  • Tu as une première expérience au téléphone : vente, service client, centre d'appels ou prise de rendez-vous.

  • Une expérience de qualification de leads entrants ou une connaissance de HubSpot et d'Aircall est un plus.

  • Tu es à l'aise au téléphone et tu sais cadrer un appel court tout en restant à l'écoute.

  • Tu sais identifier rapidement le besoin d'un prospect pour bien l'orienter.

  • Tu es rigoureux(se) dans la saisie des informations dans le CRM.

  • Tu parles parfaitement français, avec une excellente expression orale.

🤝🏻 Qualités personnelles

  • Tu es ultra-réactif(ve) : appeler dans la minute ne te fait pas peur.

  • Tu as de l'énergie et de la régularité : passer un grand volume d'appels t'enthousiasme.

  • Tu es ponctuel(le) et fiable : on peut compter sur toi sur tes créneaux, y compris le week-end si c'est ton poste.

  • Tu as l'esprit d'équipe et tu aimes contribuer au succès collectif.

  • Tu as envie de progresser et le développement personnel t'intéresse.

❌Ce poste n'est pas pour toi si :

  • Tu as besoin de beaucoup de souplesse sur tes horaires : ce poste demande une vraie présence sur tes créneaux.

  • Les appels courts et répétés te découragent.

  • Le développement personnel et l'entrepreneuriat ne t'intéressent pas.


📅 Modalités & avantages :

  • Statut :Freelance, collaboration long terme, forte disponibilité attendue.

  • Localisation :100 % remote.

  • Rémunération :fixe de 2500€ par mois et bonus sur objectifs.

  3. Entretien final avec la Direction Commerciale

Business Systems Administrator

User Tracking & Engagement · Full Time

Join Us at Pura—Reimagining Fragrance for the Future

At Pura, we believe life is better when it smells good. Fragrance has the unique power to transform spaces, elevate moods, and create lasting memories. But we know it can do even more. That’s why we’re pioneering the future of fragrance, combining cutting-edge smart home technology with premium, clean scents to create personalized, meaningful experiences in every home.

We’re not just a fragrance company, we’re on a mission to change the way people experience scent.

Why Join Pura?

Our journey began with two innovators, Richie Stapler and Bruno Lima, and their shared vision of revolutionizing how we experience fragrance. Since then, Pura has grown into a company that sells a fragrance every 3.7 seconds, partnering with iconic brands like Curio, Anthropologie, and Disney. We’ve been recognized as the Fastest Growing Company in Utah, and we are passionate about making scent a core part of life’s most memorable moments.

Your Role at Pura:

At Pura, our technology stack is the engine that powers our customer experience. To help keep that engine running, we’re looking for a curious, hands-on Business Systems Administrator to support the configuration and day-to-day operation of our core business tools.

This is a high-impact, technical role. You’ll work alongside our senior systems and product/engineering teams to support the business application ecosystem used by Customer Care, Marketing, Advertising, and Product/Engineering. Your work will focus on executing configuration changes, supporting stakeholder requests, and learning the architecture of an interconnected SaaS stack from the ground up.

You’ll spend most of your time in the systems making changes, troubleshooting issues, validating data, and documenting how things work, with senior team members available to guide you on the more complex or higher-risk work.

What You’ll Own:

  • System configuration: Execute configuration changes and enhancements across our core business applications, translating well-scoped requirements into system changes, with senior guidance on complex or cross-system work
  • Request triage and support: Help manage the inbound queue of change requests. Handle straightforward requests independently and partner with senior team members on higher-risk or multi-system changes
  • System maintenance: Monitor dashboards, flag anomalies, and run routine maintenance. Contribute to projects that reduce technical debt, improve data cleanliness, and increase automation
  • Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve common issues, escalate complex problems with clear context, and learn root causes so you can handle similar issues on your own
  • Stakeholder support: Build working relationships with Customer Care, Lifecycle & Marketing, and Product/Engineering. Gather requirements, communicate timelines, and keep partners updated
  • Documentation: Create and maintain documentation of system configurations, workflows, and processes

Essential Functions:

  • Partner with senior systems and product/engineering team members, escalating higher-risk or cross-system changes appropriately.
  • Lead and participate in special projects and assignments as required.
  • Maintain a working understanding of how Pura’s systems connect and how data flows between them to ensure accurate data and reliable customer experiences.

What Success Looks Like in This Role:

  • Daily: You’re hands-on in the systems, working through support tickets and configuration changes. You’re asking good questions, checking your work before shipping it, and getting familiar with how data flows between our tools.
  • Monthly: You’re independently handling a growing share of incoming requests and have started owning small improvement projects end-to-end. You’re contributing to documentation and building a working mental model of the stack.
  • Quarterly: You’ve become the go-to person for a specific area or tool. You’re identifying improvement opportunities on your own, scoping them with stakeholders, and executing with limited oversight. Your work is visibly improving team efficiency and data quality.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in a technical role involving SaaS configuration, systems administration, technical support, business operations, analytics engineering, or a similar function.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn a business request into a working technical change, even if small in scope.

jobs.description:
Invenergy is North America’s largest privately held developer, owner, and operator of power infrastructure. With 25 years of trusted execution, we deliver reliable, affordable energy through a diverse portfolio that includes natural gas, solar, land-based wind, energy storage, transmission, and domestic manufacturing. Headquartered in Chicago, we develop, own, and operate large scale projects that power communities and support the energy future.

This position will be open for application for at least 3 calendar days from the posting date. This position will remain open for application based on business need, which may be before or after the 3-day posting window.

Job Description

Cybersecurity Architect

Position Overview

The Cybersecurity Architect provides enterprise-level technical and architectural leadership to advance the organization’s cybersecurity strategy and long-term technology direction. This role translates business and technology strategy into comprehensive, executable cybersecurity architecture and roadmaps that address current and emerging risks while supporting the organization’s broader enterprise technology objectives.

Operating across infrastructure, applications, networks, cloud, operational technology, data, and security platforms, the Cybersecurity Architect works closely with senior technology leaders and other architectural disciplines to establish enterprise standards, evaluate emerging technologies, and guide technology decisions with an 18–36 month outlook.

The role serves as a senior technical leader and individual contributor, focusing on architectural direction and influence rather than formal personnel management. The Cybersecurity Architect also develops organizational capability through technical mentorship, knowledge sharing, training, and the introduction and advancement of new cybersecurity concepts and practices.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Cybersecurity Architecture & Strategy

  • Translate organizational and technology strategy into comprehensive cybersecurity architectures, standards, and executable technology roadmaps.
  • Develop and maintain an 18–36 month cybersecurity architecture roadmap aligned with enterprise technology direction, business priorities, and evolving risk.
  • Serve as a key contributor to enterprise-level technology strategy and architecture discussions with senior technology leadership.
  • Define and advance enterprise cybersecurity architecture across applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud, operational technology, data, identity, and security platforms.
  • Establish architectural principles, patterns, reference architectures, and technical standards that provide consistency and long-term stability across the enterprise.
  • Evaluate emerging cybersecurity technologies, architectural approaches, and industry developments and determine their applicability to the organization.
  • Translate new or emerging technical concepts into practical architectural standards and solutions that can be adopted across business and technology domains.
  • Partner with application, infrastructure, network, cloud, data, and other technology architects to develop secure, resilient, scalable, and cost-effective enterprise solutions.

Architecture Governance & Risk

  • Provide architectural review and guidance for significant technology initiatives to ensure alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards and strategy.
  • Review and approve security architecture and security design for applications, platforms, infrastructure, and enterprise technology solutions.
  • Identify current and emerging cybersecurity risks and translate those risks into architectural requirements and longer-term technology strategies.
  • Establish security architecture patterns for common enterprise use cases, including corporate offices, generation facilities, cloud environments, applications, and operational technology.
  • Guide the architectural use and integration of security technologies including identity and access management, firewalls, VPNs, network security, endpoint security, intrusion detection and prevention, and other cybersecurity platforms.
  • Develop architectural solutions that appropriately balance cybersecurity, operational, business, financial, and technology requirements.
  • Ensure cybersecurity architecture supports applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and organizational policies.
  • Provide architectural guidance for significant cybersecurity events or operational issues when they have material enterprise-level impact.

Enterprise Technology Leadership & Influence

  • Serve as a senior technical authority for cybersecurity architecture and enterprise security technology decisions.
  • Influence enterprise technology decisions across multiple platforms and technical domains without relying on direct organizational authority.
  • Work closely with senior technology leadership to evaluate strategic technology investments, architectural direction, technology lifecycle decisions, and enterprise cybersecurity priorities.
  • Provide deep technical and architectural guidance to engineering, operations, application, infrastructure, security, and business teams.
  • Introduce, formalize, and advance new cybersecurity concepts, technologies, and architectural practices across the organization.
  • Mentor and develop technical staff through architectural guidance, knowledge sharing, training, and technical leadership.
  • Communicate complex cybersecurity concepts and architectural decisions effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Promote continuous improvement of enterprise cybersecurity architecture, standards, engineering practices, and technical capabilities.

Technology Innovation & External Engagement

  • Maintain awareness of evolving cybersecurity threats, technologies, architecture practices, and industry trends and assess their potential enterprise impact.
  • Conduct strategic evaluations and proof-of-concept activities for emerging technologies and cybersecurity capabilities.
  • Build productive relationships with technology vendors and strategic partners to evaluate, enhance, and, where appropriate, develop solutions that address enterprise requirements.
  • Participate in relevant industry organizations, professional communities, conferences, working groups, or other forums to maintain current knowledge and contribute to the advancement of cybersecurity practices.
  • Represent the organization in technical discussions with customers, vendors, partners, and other external stakeholders when appropriate.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent industry or military experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience across cybersecurity, technology architecture, engineering, infrastructure, or related enterprise technology disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience developing enterprise cybersecurity architectures and translating technology strategy into executable roadmaps.
  • Demonstrated experience working across multiple technology domains such as applications, infrastructure, cloud, networks, databases, operational technology, identity, and cybersecurity platforms.
  • Experience influencing significant technology decisions and establishing technical standards across multiple teams or business areas.
  • Demonstrated ability to move between strategic architecture discussions and the technical detail necessary to translate concepts into executable solutions.
  • Experience working effectively with senior technology leaders, architects, engineers, business stakeholders, vendors, and strategic partners.
  • Eligible to work in the United States without the need for employer visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of advanced education and significant industry or military experience.
  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, SABSA, TOGAF, or comparable cybersecurity or enterprise architecture credentials.
  • Experience developing security architecture for Operational Technology (OT), industrial control systems, or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Demonstrated participation or leadership in cybersecurity or technology professional organizations.
  • Experience presenting, publishing, teaching, or otherwise contributing technical expertise to professional or industry communities.
  • Experience partnering with technology vendors to evaluate, modify, or develop solutions for complex enterprise requirements.

Base Pay

$180,000.00 - $225,000.00 USD Annual

Bonus: 30% - 40%

The base pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target salary for the position. Invenergy considers a number of factors when determining base pay offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education and skills.

In addition to base pay, the total annual compensation package may also include eligibility to participate in our bonus program(s) which are designed to reward individual and company performance. Your recruiter can share more about bonus eligibility for this position during the hiring process.

Invenergy offers a variety of other benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401k, paid time off, etc.

Invenergy LLC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability.

For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Invenergy will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

Position Type: Fractional, Remote
Function: Creative / Social Media Design

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Social Content Designer with strong visual taste who can transform an existing library of photography, brand assets, and creative direction into polished, ready-to-publish social content.

This is a fractional, execution-focused creative role, not a social media strategy or management position. We provide the direction and assets; you turn them into high-quality Instagram and LinkedIn posts, graphics, and carousels while helping maintain a consistent backlog of finished content ready to publish.

What You’ll Own

Social Content Design

  • Create single-image posts, graphics, and multi-slide carousels

  • Translate provided creative direction into finished designs
  • Maintain consistent visual quality across social content

Brand & Visual Consistency

  • Maintain consistency across typography, layout, imagery, and visual hierarchy
  • Use strong design judgment to elevate existing assets
  • Ensure every piece of content feels cohesive with the broader brand
  • Create premium, intentional designs rather than generic or template-driven content

Content Production & Backlog

  • Maintain a consistent pipeline of completed social creative
  • Build and maintain a backlog of finished content ready to publish
  • Manage multiple creative requests efficiently
  • Incorporate feedback accurately and quickly
  • Keep design files and creative assets organized
  • Deliver finished assets in appropriate formats for publishing

Requirements

  • Professional experience in graphic design, social media design, content design, or a similar creative role
  • Strong visual taste and attention to detail
  • Portfolio demonstrating polished social or digital design work
  • Experience designing for Instagram and/or LinkedIn
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy
  • Ability to work effectively from existing brand assets and creative direction
  • Comfortable producing content consistently and efficiently
  • Strong organizational and file-management skills
  • Ability to receive feedback and translate it into polished creative
  • Comfortable working in a fractional, remote capacity

Preferred Skills

  • Strong experience with Figma
  • Experience with Adobe Illustrator
  • Experience with Adobe Photoshop
  • Strong carousel design experience
  • Experience designing for both Instagram and LinkedIn
  • Experience working within established brand systems
  • Ability to work efficiently with large photography and creative asset libraries

Tools & Technology

Figma | Adobe Illustrator | Adobe Photoshop | Instagram | LinkedIn | Creative Asset Libraries | Social Media Design Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a naturally strong eye for design
  • Can make existing assets feel polished and intentional
  • Understand what makes social content visually engaging
  • Are particularly strong at designing clean, compelling carousels
  • Can follow established creative direction without requiring detailed instructions for every asset

What a Typical Project Looks Like

You’ll receive photography, brand assets, and creative direction for upcoming content. From there, you’ll turn those materials into polished Instagram or LinkedIn posts and carousels, incorporate feedback, prepare final assets, and organize completed creative for publishing.

In short: we provide the direction and assets; you turn them into premium social content and keep the content pipeline full.

Apply Now
