jobs.excerpt: Agentify — це міжнародний аутсорсинговий sales сервіс, якийз 2013 року задає тренди на ринку клієнтського сервісу та продажів.
jobs.description:
Agentify — це міжнародний аутсорсинговий sales сервіс, якийз 2013 року задає тренди на ринку клієнтського сервісу та продажів. За понад 13 років роботи ми виросли з локального стартапу до потужного міжнародного хабу. Сьогодні Agentify — це сотні однодумців, які працюють як у наших сучасних технологічних офісах, так і в зручному віддаленому форматі (Remote) з будь-якої точки світу. Ми обслуговуємо провідні світові бренди, спілкуємося 5 мовами та щодня допомагаємо тисячам людей. Ми працюємо на перетині технологій та комунікацій, а кожен наш співробітник стає мультифункціональним експертом, опановуючи ключові напрямки сучасного бізнесу.

Наші Core-ніші та експертиза:

  • 🔹 E-commerce & Retail — повний супровід клієнтів інтернет-магазинів: від оформлення замовлень до координації міжнародної логістики та повернень.

  • 🔹 Активні продажі — робота з теплими лідами, телемаркетинг, cross-sell/up-sell та повернення клієнтів до покинутих кошиків.

  • 🔹 Омніканальний Customer Care — клієнтська та технічна підтримка користувачів у режимі 24/7/365.

  • 🔹 Цифрові чати — спілкування з клієнтами без голосу через Live-чати на сайтах, Email та популярні месенджери (Viber, Telegram, WhatsApp).

  • 🔹 Інтелектуальна телефонія — робота з сучасним програмним забезпеченням, професійними CRM-системами та AI-інструментами автоматизації.

В свою команду зараз ми шукаємо Sales Specialistа!

🌟Чому кандидати обирають Agentify?

  • Стабільність з 2013 року —прозорі виплати та впевненістьу завтрашньому дні.

  • Власна Академія —безкоштовне навчання з нуля(ділова комунікація, техніки продажів, робота з програмами та сервісами). Ми інвестуємо в розвиток співробітників і підтримуємо їх на всіх етапах адаптації.

  • Дохід без обмежень —погодинна ставка + відсоток від викупуза виконання KPI. У продажах твій заробіток залежить насамперед від твоїх результатів.

  • Реальний кар'єрний ліфт — більшість наших Team Lead, Supervisor та QA-менеджерів виросли всередині компанії.

  • Абсолютна інклюзивність— ми вільні від стереотипів. Для нас важливі лише твої навички, енергія та бажання розвиватися.

Ми пропонуємо:

  • Своєчасна оплата праці,що складається зфіксованої ставки 3,25 євро/год + % від викупу товарів.Середній дохід 400-700 євро на місяць.

  • Повністю віддалена робота.

  • Зручний позмінний графік :8.00−15.00 та з 15.00−22.00. 2 плаваючі вихідні на тиждень.

  • Кар'єрний ріст: можливість вирости до Team Lead, Тренера чи Менеджера QI

  • Постійне навчання за рахунок компанії та підвищення кваліфікації

  • Бонус за успішне проходження навчання

  • Дружній колектив і наставники, які завжди допоможуть.

  • Подарунки на річницю роботи та дітям співробітників на свята.

  • Спеціальні бонуси для менеджерів з найвищими показниками: індивідуальний графік, оплата спортивних абонементів або оплата курсів з іноземної мови, оплата розваг та інші привілеї.

  • Акція «Бонус за новачка» (ти отримуєш приємний бонус за кожного працівника, що прийшов по твоїй рекомендації)

Наші бізнес-цінності:

Відкритість—ми цінуємо вміння говорити прямо, чути інших і шукати нові підходи.

Надійність— для нас важливо, щоб на кожного члена команди можна було покластися, і ми створюємо умови для відповідальної роботи.

Безперервний розвиток—ми не чекаємо досконалості, але очікуємо бажання вчитися та вдосконалюватися.

Націленість на результат— ми працюємо, щоб досягати реальних результатів, а не для виконання формальних планів.

Клієнтоорієнтованість— ми ставимо потреби клієнтів у центр уваги та працюємо над тим, щоб забезпечувати якісний сервіс та пропонувати рішення, які створюють реальну цінність

Твої майбутні обов’язки:

  • Здійснювати дзвінки по теплій базі клієнтів.

  • Виявляти потреби клієнтів, презентувати товари та працювати з запереченнями (активні продажі).

  • Продавати продукцію компанії за скриптами.

  • Фіксувати замовлення в CRM-системі.

Що потрібно, щоб до нас приєднатись:

  • ПК/ноутбук, дротова гарнітура та стабільний інтернет.

  • Базове володіння ПК і офісними програмами.

  • Уміння продавати або бажання навчитися це робити.

Що для нас важливо?

Щоб ви бачили сенс у тому, що робите, були чесними з собою та колегами й не боялися вийти за межі звичного, коли це потрібно.

Якщо ви шукаєте місце, де ваші дії справді впливають на результат, ми будемо раді познайомитися!

jobs.description:
Job Summary/Highlight

The Director of Consulting Services leads and scales strategic consulting engagements across a portfolio of enterprise clients, overseeing a high-performing team of Microsoft technologists. This role is pivotal in shaping and executing full lifecycle Microsoft services—from pre-sales strategy through implementation and long-term client success.

As a senior leader, the Director drives operational excellence, influences product and service innovation, and ensures alignment with corporate growth objectives. Acting as both a strategic advisor and operational leader, this individual will champion service quality, client satisfaction, and sustainable revenue expansion while cultivating a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability.

Core Responsibilities

Leadership Management Accountability (LMA)

  • Lead and mentor a team of consultants and engineers to deliver high-quality Microsoft solutions.

  • Orchestrate daily team workload, ensuring optimal resource allocation based on skill, availability, and client need.

  • Champion a high-performance, inclusive culture that attracts, develops, and retains top consulting talent.

  • “Re-recruit” team members through engagement, recognition, and transparent career development.

  • Align team goals with company strategy, reinforcing accountability, ownership, and shared success.

  • Promote a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the consulting organization.

Client Engagement and Advisory

  • Serve as executive sponsor for strategic accounts, guiding clients through complex transformation initiatives.

  • Lead solution architecture and delivery strategies for high-value engagements aligned with business outcomes.

  • Translate client needs into scalable, actionable solutions leveraging deep domain and industry expertise.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to influence go-to-market strategies.

  • Represent the consulting function in executive and client forums, acting as a trusted advisor and thought leader.

Ready to be a Titan?

We are looking for a Sr Manager of Marketing Strategy (lead) to own ServiceTitan's largest cross-company marketing initiatives. This role is ideal for a strategy or program leader with strong analytical rigor, a builder's mindset and the ability to align many teams around one plan and carry it through to delivery. You will sit in Integrated Marketing and partner with leaders across ServiceTitan.

This is a program owner role: you will decide how large initiatives are scoped, sequenced and governed and where we can work faster.


What you'll do:

  • Enterprise programs: own end-to-end delivery of company-wide marketing initiatives. Define scope, workstreams, owners, dependencies, budget and success measures, and coordinate across the company through rollout and adoption.
  • Program governance: set the cadence, track milestones and risks, escalate early and drive decisions so programs do not stall between teams.
  • Brand pilots: own brand pilots as we test and learn. Define the hypothesis, scope and success measures for each pilot, coordinate the teams involved, and turn the results into recommendations on what to scale, adjust or stop.
  • Marketing planning support: partner with marketing leaders and FinOps to run a planning cycle, including pre-work, plans and quarterly themes. Bring together inputs, surface synergies and dependencies, and keep plans aligned to priorities.
  • Act as a trusted thought partner on strategic initiatives. Prepare briefing materials, executive memos and leadership meeting agendas, and keep leaders aligned on priorities, decisions and communications.
  • Executive reporting: deliver regular, decision-ready updates on program status, risks and efficiency gains for senior leadership, and recommend next steps.
  • Data-driven operator: define the KPIs that show whether programs and efficiency work are delivering, in partnership with go-to-market leaders, and report on impact.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: build and maintain trust with Marketing, Sales, Enablement, PeopleOps, Finance and Product teams.

What you'll need:

  • 8+ years of experience in marketing strategy, program management, marketing operations, consulting or a related field, including leading complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • A track record of owning a large, multi-team program from plan to delivery, such as a rebrand, major launch, reorganization or platform migration.
  • Experience finding and delivering efficiency gains in process and spend.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to build a business case, size an opportunity and measure results.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to write and present to senior leaders and influence without direct authority.
  • Working knowledge of how AI and automation can improve marketing workflows, with sound judgment on where they help and where they create risk.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity through operational excellence.
  • Bonus: experience in B2B SaaS or a multi-brand, multi-audience go-to-market; direct experience leading or supporting a rebrand; familiarity with the home services and trades industries.

Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.

These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

The Executive Director will actively cultivate new collaborations, licensing agreements, and strategic alliances to expand the company’s product portfolio and market research.

jobs.description:
Client Services Specialist

Also known as: “Client Services Executive, Client Relationship Specialist, Account Support Specialist, Service Delivery Specialist”

Salary: Up to £40,000 p/a dependent on experience

Plus: Access to annual bonus

Location: Home-based, North of England or Midlands, with regular travel to client sites

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8.30am to 5.00pm

Job role
Our clients rely on responsive, well-coordinated service every day. As a Client Services Specialist, you'll be at the centre of that relationship, helping clients get the information, support and outcomes they need while connecting them with teams across Medica.

Supporting the client portfolios of two Business Development Managers, you'll build trusted relationships with your allocated clients, understand their services and priorities, and coordinate enquiries, service reviews, reporting and improvement activity.

You'll also use service performance information and client feedback to identify emerging needs, risks and opportunities, working closely with operational, clinical, technical and commercial colleagues to achieve effective outcomes. Contractual negotiations, commercial decisions and account growth will continue to be led by the appropriate Business Development Manager.

As this role supports clients across the North of England, you'll need to be based within the region or within practical travelling distance of our Northern client locations.

Who we are

Medica is the UK’s leading telemedicine provider, supporting over 50% of NHS trusts with specialist reporting services across the globe. With over 240 head office staff and continued growth, now is a great time to become part of our journey.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and communities to help us build inclusive teams and a diverse workforce. We offer flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance and encourage everyone to be themselves at work.

What you’ll do

  • Build strong working relationships with allocated clients, acting as their day-to-day operational contact and coordinating enquiries, requests and service issues.

  • Plan and support client service reviews, bringing together performance information, client feedback and service insights, and ensuring actions are recorded and progressed.

  • Monitor service performance, feedback, incidents and complaints, identifying recurring themes, emerging risks and opportunities for service improvement.

  • Coordinate the resolution of client issues across operational, clinical, technical and commercial teams, maintaining clear communication and appropriate escalation through to an agreed outcome.

  • Support client onboarding, mobilisation, service changes and improvement initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, actions and dependencies.

  • Maintain accurate and complete CRM records, client documentation, correspondence, risks and actions.

  • Understand changing client needs and identify potential opportunities, referring commercial, contractual and growth matters to the appropriate Business Development Manager.

Requirements

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in client services, account support, customer success or service delivery, with confidence managing day-to-day client requirements.

  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with clients and colleagues at different levels.

  • Experience coordinating client enquiries, service issues or complaints and taking ownership of follow-up actions through to resolution or escalation.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing clear client correspondence, reports or meeting materials.

  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage competing requirements across multiple clients or workstreams.

  • Confidence interpreting service performance and client feedback and translating information into clear insights and actions.

  • Commercial awareness, with the confidence to recognise changing client needs, risks and potential opportunities and refer them appropriately.

  • Good attention to detail and experience maintaining accurate CRM records and client information.

  • Confidence using Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Teams.

You may be qualified through relevant professional experience or hold A-levels or an equivalent qualification. A relevant qualification in customer service, business administration or project management would be an advantage but isn't essential.

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience within the NHS, healthcare, radiology, pathology, telemedicine or another regulated service environment.

  • Experience supporting client service reviews, governance meetings or contract performance discussions.

  • Knowledge of service level agreements, contract administration or client governance.

  • Experience supporting client mobilisation, implementation, service change or continuous improvement.

  • Experience using Power BI or similar reporting and data-visualisation tools.

Experience within healthcare is valuable, but it isn't essential. We welcome applications from people who can demonstrate relevant experience gained in other complex, service-led or regulated environments.

What success looks like

You'll build trusted client relationships, keep commitments and actions moving and ensure clients receive clear, timely and professional communication. You'll maintain accurate client information and help resolve service issues effectively, while using performance information and client feedback to identify emerging risks, changing needs and opportunities to continually improve the service we provide.

Location and travel

This is a home-based role within the North of England, with regular travel to client sites across the region for service reviews, relationship meetings and other business requirements.

Occasional UK travel to Medica locations, including the Hastings headquarters and London office, will also be required for meetings, training and team activities.

We therefore ask applicants to be based within the North of England, or within practical travelling distance of our Northern client locations, and comfortable travelling as required by the role.

Core benefits for you:

  • 🕘 Flexible and hybrid working

  • ⚖️ A company culture that promotes work life balance

  • 🌱 Commitment from employers to continued learning and development

  • 🧠 Access to Employee Assistance Programme

  • 💸 Annual bonus

  • 🌍 Enhanced holiday allowance + bank holidays

  • 🕊️ Group life assurance

  • 👵 Pension

  • 🎉 Social events

  • 🤒 Sick pay

  • 🚲 Cycle to work scheme

  • 🌳 Access to free and regular personal development & wellbeing events

We request all applicants to complete a confidential equalities monitoring form to help us identify recruitment trends and address any concerns.

Learn more about Medica and the work we do:

We are a Circle Back Initiative Employer – we commit to respond to every applicant.

jobs.title: Ingénieur.e Développement Produits POI
jobs.excerpt: Présentation de Soitec et contexte du poste Soitec est une société cotée à l'indice SBF 120 de la Bourse de Paris qui intervient en amont de la chaîne de valeur de la microélectronique.
jobs.description:
Présentation de Soitec et contexte du poste

Soitec est une société cotée à l'indice SBF 120 de la Bourse de Paris qui intervient en amont de la chaîne de valeur de la microélectronique. Nos matériaux semi-conducteurs innovants sont indispensables au fonctionnement des smartphones et au déploiement de la 5G. Ils offrent également de nombreuses opportunités pour l’automobile connectée, les véhicules électriques et autonomes et l’intelligence embarquée dans les objets connectés.

Cette place nous confère une incroyable responsabilité, qui nous inspire au quotidien : rendre possible l’adoption massive d’innovations technologiques tout en limitant considérablement leur impact environnemental, dans une logique d’innovation responsable et de développement durable.

En quoi consiste le job?

Au sein du Département Innovation, le service Développement Produits définit les procédés de fabrication des nouveaux produits : des équipements et séquences de fabrication nécessaires jusqu’à la fabrication des premiers prototypes.

Aujourd'hui, l'équipe de Luciana gère les nouvelles générations de nos produits POI (Piezoelectric-on-insulator) qu’on retrouve dans tous les téléphones portables et les objets connectés.

Dans le poste d’ingénieur développement produit, votre objectif est de mettre au point chaque étape de fabrication une à une puis les assembler pour définir le procédé complet de fabrication du engineered substrate.

En milieu industriel, faire du développement implique de comprendre les effets physiques des procédés sur la qualité du produit et également leurs interactions avec les outils de production.

Le travail est itératif : on mène un plan d’expérience, on analyse les résultats et on rectifie ou on ajuste le procédé.

Vous rejoignez un groupe où se reflète parfaitement la dynamique bouillonnante d’innovation de Soitec. Vous pouvez compter sur le support opérationnel des technicien·nes et sur l’esprit d’équipe de vos pairs. Dans ce poste vous avez l’occasion de toucher à toutes les techniques de production de l’entreprise (nettoyage de surface, collage moléculaire, implantation ionique, traitement thermique, métrologies, épitaxie, fracture des matériaux…)

L’organisation Innovation vous permet d’être au service de la satisfaction client, de travailler en mode projet avec les autres équipes (Pilot engineering, Expertise, Intégration Produit, Soitec Lab, Recherche…) et également avec les autres organisations : Opérations industrielles, business unit...

Ce poste répondra à votre projet si vous êtes…

….en possession d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou équivalent avec à minima 5 ans d’expérience (thèse et/ou expérience industrielle) dans l’un de ces 3 domaines : la microélectronique, la physique des matériaux semiconducteurs ou le génie des procédés.

Vous êtes à l'aise dans une organisation en mode projet et vous êtes rompu à l'utilisation des plans d’expérience.

Votre état d’esprit positif et votre envie de vous investir dans notre aventure motivent votre candidature.

Vous savez prendre en compte les diverses contraintes de vos interfaces pour développer la meilleure des solutions. Vous êtes rigoureux.se et le travail en équipe vous stimule.

Votre maîtrise de l’anglais vous permet d’être à l’aise dans les échanges avec nos équipementiers et/ou partenaires et nos équipes de Singapour

Si ce profil vous ressemble, n’attendez plus et venez rejoindre notre équipe !

Information complémentaire:- Ce poste est identifié comme un « poste sensible » au regard de la législation douanière européenne applicable à Soitec SA dans le cadre de sa certification en tant qu’« Opérateur Economique Agréé » - Ce poste est identifié comme un « poste sensible » et nécessite des contrôles spécifiques pour répondre au cadre ZRR (Zone à régime restrictif) auquel il est soumis- Ce poste nécessite des déplacements réguliers à l'international

Position:

Sales Director – Cloud (North America)


Job Description:

Why You'll Love This Role:

Innovation happens when the right people, ideas, and technology come together. At Arrow, our Sales teams connect customers with the expertise, solutions, and global capabilities they need to move faster, solve complex challenges, and stay ahead of what's next. Working across functions and technologies, you'll build lasting partnerships, deliver value beyond products, and help customers transform ideas into real-world solutions while growing your own career in a global technology organization.

What You'll Do:

Arrow is seeking a high-impact Director, Sales - Cloud, North America to lead the strategy, execution, and performance of a cloud-focused sales organization responsible for driving growth, profitability, and market expansion across North America. This role serves as a critical leader in aligning Arrow's cloud business strategy with key supplier objectives, customer needs, and evolving market opportunities.


The Director will be accountable for building and leading a high-performing sales team, establishing rigorous sales processes and operational excellence, and driving measurable business outcomes through strong execution, analytics, and partner engagement. Success in this role requires a proven sales leader who has demonstrated the ability to develop talent, scale revenue, implement disciplined sales methodologies, and create strong alignment between suppliers, partners, and internal stakeholders.


The ideal candidate brings deep experience in technology sales leadership, strong knowledge of the Cloud & ISV ecosystem, and distribution industry expertise, along with a track record of delivering consistent growth through indirect sales channels and strategic partnerships.

Sales Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and execute the strategic vision for the North America Cloud sales organization, ensuring alignment with business objectives, supplier priorities, and growth initiatives.
  • Lead the achievement of revenue, margin, profitability, and growth targets across the cloud portfolio.
  • Drive sales rigor through disciplined pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, opportunity inspection, and performance management processes.
  • Establish and optimize sales processes, tools, metrics, and SLAs to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and customer outcomes.
  • Leverage analytics, market intelligence, and performance data to identify growth opportunities and address gaps in performance.
  • Build scalable sales programs that accelerate cloud adoption and drive partner success.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Recruit, hire, coach, and retain top cloud and sales management talent.
  • Create a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer success, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop future leaders by implementing succession planning, career development, and mentorship programs.
  • Provide clear direction, performance expectations, feedback, and coaching to managers and individual contributors.
  • Foster employee engagement and professional development while maintaining strong organizational health.

Supplier, Partner & Customer Engagement

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships with strategic suppliers, channel partners, and key customers.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and advocate for supplier strategies across the organization.
  • Drive alignment between vendor priorities and Arrow sales execution to maximize mutually beneficial outcomes.
  • Collaborate with supplier leadership teams to identify market opportunities, growth initiatives, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Represent Arrow at executive business reviews, industry events, and strategic customer engagements.

Business & Operational Excellence

  • Oversee business performance through KPI management, forecasting, pipeline reviews, and business planning processes.
  • Ensure operational excellence, process consistency, and delivery against established service-level agreements.
  • Monitor competitive trends, market dynamics, cloud adoption trends, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.
  • Develop and execute strategic initiatives that strengthen Arrow's market position and accelerate growth.

Who We're Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in technology sales leadership, channel sales, business development, or related roles.
  • Proven experience leading sales organizations with responsibility for revenue growth, profitability, and team performance.
  • Demonstrated success building, developing, and leading high-performing sales teams.
  • Strong executive presence with experience influencing and partnering with senior leaders, suppliers, and customers.
  • Experience implementing structured sales methodologies, forecasting processes, and performance management disciplines.
  • Track record of consistent achievement of sales and business growth objectives.
  • Significant Technology Sales Leadership experience.
  • Deep expertise within the Hyperscaler & ISV ecosystem, including cloud solutions, programs, and partner engagement.
  • Experience within a technology distribution organization or distribution-led go-to-market model.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading cloud, SaaS, AI, or digital transformation-focused sales organizations.
  • Strong understanding of cloud technologies, such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot, Modern Work, Security, and AI solutions.
  • Experience working with indirect sales channels, partner ecosystems, and supplier-led business models.
  • Knowledge of cloud marketplace strategies, partner incentives, and recurring revenue models.
  • Proven ability to translate business strategy into executable sales plans that drive measurable results.

What's In It For You:

At Arrow, we're committed to helping our employees thrive, both at work and beyond. Along with competitive compensation, we offer a range of benefits that support your health, financial well-being, work-life balance, and professional growth. Your benefits may include:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
  • 401k, With Matching Contributions
  • Short-Term/Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)/Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Options
  • Paid Time Off (including sick, holiday, vacation, etc.)
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Growth Opportunities

Work Arrangement:

Fully Remote: Must be able to travel to an Arrow office location as requested by Arrow leadership.

About Arrow

We believe new technologies have the power to make life not only different, but better. At Arrow, we're helping make that future possible. We enable customers and suppliers to design and distribute technology around the world, connecting people, ideas, and innovation to solve real-world challenges. Guided by our purpose of making the benefits of technology accessible to all, we provide expertise, solutions, and connections that help shape what's next. As a global technology solutions provider, Arrow offers opportunities to learn, collaborate, and build a meaningful career while making an impact around the world.

Life at Arrow

At Arrow, we believe innovation starts with people. We create an environment where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning help our employees grow and make a meaningful impact every day. From your first day, you'll have opportunities to build new skills, work alongside talented teams around the world, and contribute to technology that helps shape a better future. Because when our people grow, innovation moves forward.

Annual Hiring Range/Hourly Rate:

$191,300.00 - $298,577.40

Actual compensation offer to candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level. The pay ratio between base pay and target incentive (if applicable) will be finalized at offer.


Location:

US-CO-Colorado (Remote Employees)Remote work employees may be required to be present at the closest designated Arrow office for work-related purposes, at the Company’s request and sole discretion.


Time Type:

Full time


Job Category:

Sales

EEO Statement:

Arrow is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. (Arrow EEO/AAP policy)

All Arrow job postings are for existing job vacancies. We anticipate this requisition will be open for a minimum of five days, though it may be open for a longer period of time. We encourage your prompt application.

jobs.description:
Salute is a leading provider of cutting-edge Data Center Infrastructure Services, dedicated to serving data center clients worldwide. We pride ourselves on delivering sustainable solutions, unparalleled reliability, and outstanding customer service. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Account Project Manager to join our team and drive our relationships with hyperscale clients to new heights.

Salute Benefits That Put You First

We know life doesn’t stop when work begins, that’s why we offer perks designed to support your well-being, your family, and your future:

  • Time to Recharge:Enjoy 8 company-paid holidays, 2 floating holidays, andPTO so you can rest, celebrate, and take care of what matters most.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package:Including Medical, Dental, and Vision that you can enroll in starting on Day 1. Coverage begins the first of the month following 30-days of employment.
  • Peace of Mind: The Employee Assistance Programis available to all employees, even if you do not participate in the benefits package.
  • Your financial future matters:Enjoy our employer-supported 401(K) with immediate 100% vesting, plus a 3% employer match and a 50% match on the next 2%.
  • Wellness Support:Access to HSA, mental health resources,and gym discounts—because your health matters.
  • Extra Protection & Perks:Through discounted group programs, such as legal services, home & auto insurance, pet insurance, and ID theft protection for life’s unexpected moments.

Location: Remote with 50% Travel Expectations

Hours:Monday - Friday 7am-5pm

Salary:$120,000 Annually

This role is eligible for a potential 8% annual performance-based bonus.

Position Summary

The Account Project Manager provides account-level program and project management across all client sites served by Salute Mission Critical. This is a coordination, reporting, and compliance role: the APM builds and maintains the account's operating cadence — KPI/SLA reporting, training and certification tracking, project budgeting and purchasing, QBR preparation, and MSOW compliance review — so that execution is consistent across sites and documentation is audit-ready.

Key Responsibilities

  • Program & project execution:Own schedules, scope, deliverables, action logs, and risk registers for account-level initiatives spanning multiple sites. Drive projects from intake to documented closeout.
  • KPI / SLA reporting:Maintain the consolidated account performance report. Collect and validate site-level data, surface trends, and work with Site Managers on corrective action plans where metrics trend off target.
  • Purchase request coordination: works with account vendor specialists to assemble purchase request packages per MSOW requirements.
  • MSOW compliance:Run periodic reviews against scope-of-work obligations, document findings, track them to closure, and maintain the compliance record.
  • Training & certification tracking:Maintain the account training matrix. Monitor certification currency by site and role and escalate expirations before they affect coverage.
  • QBR & reporting cadence:Build QBR materials and recurring operational reporting. Own the data narrative, not just the deck.
  • Incident follow-up:Coordinate post-incident corrective and preventive actions to closure and consolidate lessons learned across sites.
  • Stakeholder coordination:Serve as the operational coordination point between Salute Site Managers, the Account Director, and Client FSLs. Run recurring account syncs; keep decisions and actions documented and distributed.
  • Process standardization:Identify site-to-site variation in practice and drive standardized procedures, templates, and trackers across the account.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years project or program management experience, including multi-site or geographically distributed operations
  • Experience in data center, mission critical facilities, or comparable 24/7 critical-environment operations
  • Demonstrated ownership of KPI/SLA reporting and performance improvement programs
  • Experience working to a contracted scope of work (MSOW, MSA, or equivalent) in a service-provider/client environment
  • Advanced spreadsheet and reporting skills; proficiency with project tracking tools
  • Excellent written communication; able to produce client-ready reporting independently
  • Proven effectiveness working fully remote across multiple time zones with minimal supervision
  • Ability to travel to support sites as required
  • Able to satisfy client background check and site access requirements

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, CAPM, or equivalent certification
  • Prior experience on a hyperscale data center service account
  • Familiarity with CMMS platforms and facilities work management documentation (MOP/SOP/EOP, task plans)
  • Experience supporting EHS programs in a contractor environment (PTP, job safety planning)
  • Experience establishing QBR and governance cadences for an outsourced services account
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement training

Success Measures (First 12 Months)

  • One consolidated account KPI/SLA report delivered on a reliable cadence covering all four sites
  • 100% of purchase requests packaged, routed to FSL, and tracked per MSOW, with reduced cycle time from submission to approval
  • Training and certification compliance visible and current for every site
  • MSOW compliance review completed with all findings tracked to closure
  • QBR materials delivered on schedule without last-minute data gathering

Site Location:We operate a 24-hour facility where work hours (shifts) are assigned as needed to ensure job functions are performed satisfactorily, compliance is maintained, and the company operates efficiently. Certain positions, as specified in your offer letter, may require working irregular hours, such as nights, weekends, overtime, alternating shifts, and under various conditions, including outdoor work during extreme weather or in hazardous environments.

This description does not cover all duties that may be required. Employees must follow any job-related instructions and perform other duties as assigned. Successful performance requires these necessary skills, aptitudes, and abilities.

If you are a motivated and results-driven individual with a passion for data center services and a knack for building strong client relationships, we want to hear from you. Join us in revolutionizing the data center industry and apply today!

Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

The Salesforce Administrator, reporting to the Operational Service Manager, ensures the reliable operation of the Customer Relationship Management systems, coordinate upgrades and enhancements, oversees the availability and performance of the production environment across the university, and the pre-production environments. jobs.excerpt: #RunwiththePack At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.
jobs.description:
#RunwiththePack


At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.


We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.


More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.


We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

About the Position:

The Senior Incident Response Forensic Analyst is a highly technical member of Digital Forensics and Incident Response (“DFIR”) team. The Senior Forensic Analyst is responsible for conducting forensic investigations of traditional network intrusions in Active Directory environments along with Business Email Compromises (“BEC”). The Senior Analyst assists with technical initiatives that further the business while taking opportunities to mentor junior analysts.


Primary Responsibilities and Duties

Technical Competencies

  • Conduct forensic investigations for organizations that have suffered an attack from targeted threats, such as Advanced Persistent Threats, Organized Crime, and politically motivated groups, or from commodity threats such as ransomware groups.
  • Perform host forensic analysis on Windows, Linux, and Mac OS based systems.
  • Perform network analysis using a variety of tools and log sources to include firewall logs, NetFlow, and logs generated from a variety of network intrusions detection/prevention tools.
  • Assist with/conduct the forensic acquisition and analysis from Azure, Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), and Google Cloud Platform (“GCP”) environments.
  • Leverage applicable tooling to contain and eradicate a threat actor’s presence from a client’s network when responding to live intrusion events.
  • Understand the capabilities of malicious binaries and scripts through basic static and dynamic analysis efforts.
  • Make tactical recommendations for compromised client organizations.

Communication and Client Management

  • Communicate both executive and detailed level findings in verbal and written form; Present technical findings in a manner that assists external legal counsel in understanding potential regulatory implications.
  • Communicate all items relevant to the forensic investigation, in a manner that deescalates situations and presents a coherent strategy moving forward.
  • Scope new cases and lead update calls when needed.

Leadership and Initiatives

  • Stays current with developments within the DFIR field; Integrates new developments into current processes and procedures where necessary
  • Partner with internal teams to publish blogs regarding threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (“TTP), vulnerabilities,
  • Mentor junior analysts on technical and soft skills

General

  • Participate in weekday escalation and weekend/holiday on call schedules.
  • Conduct audits and peer review of incident reports.
  • Fosters information sharing and collaboration.

Key Skills

  • Analysis of disparate forensic artifacts
  • Ability to draw sound conclusions despite gaps or ambiguity with evidence
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Team mentorship and knowledge sharing

Minimum Qualifications

  • Three or more years professional experience with digital forensics and incident response or other similar cybersecurity roles
  • Ability to respond to inquiries and work beyond normal business hours, as needed
  • Advanced knowledge of host-based forensic, network analysis, and data breach response
  • Advanced knowledge of current attack vectors and trends in cybersecurity
  • Ability to identify indicators of compromise (“IOC”) from newly released exploits that have little to no community documentation
  • Experience with IR and forensic tools, such as Magnet Axiom, Encase, FTK, X-Ways, SIFT, and other open-source forensic tools
  • Experience with commercial Endpoint Detection and Response (“EDR”), network monitoring, and Security Information and Event Management (“SIEM”) tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Security, Digital Forensics, Computer Science, or other related field
  • Certifications: GCFA, GCFE, ACE, EnCE, or similar training and certification
  • Prior consulting experience
  • Prior experience presenting at industry conferences and events
  • Prior experience developing scripts and tools to analyze data
  • Prior experience with malware analysis and reverse engineering

jobs.description:
Category: Medical

Location:


Quick facts

  • Pay: ₱30,000 to ₱35,000 per month
  • Location: 100% work from home, Philippines
  • Engagement: Part-time contractor
  • Availability: Monday to Friday, on call 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM PHT, around 20 hours of work a week
  • Role: Phone-heavy patient services and medication order coordination

You'll be the friendly voice patients hear when they call an Australian gastroenterology service. Most of your day is spent on the phone, talking patients through ordering their medication, then coordinating each order between the prescribing doctor, the patient and a partner pharmacy until it arrives.

Many of our patients are older and unsure about ordering through a service instead of their local pharmacy. Your calm, clear explanation is what puts them at ease.

You'll be on call Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM PHT, ready to pick up when patients ring. Calls come in bursts, so the work adds up to around 20 hours a week. It suits someone who can run a second flexible role alongside this one and still answer the phone straight away.

What you'll be doing

  • Answer patient calls and emails warmly and clearly, explaining why medication orders go through the service rather than a usual pharmacy
  • Coordinate new and repeat medication orders between prescribing doctors, patients and the partner pharmacy, and track each one until it is complete
  • Keep accurate patient records, prescription details and repeat medication information
  • Generate payment links, follow up outstanding payments and help with monthly invoicing
  • Spot questions that need clinical input and escalate them to the right person
  • Keep email correspondence and administrative workflows organised

What you'll need

  • At least 1 year of patient-facing or healthcare phone experience, for example in a medical, dental or allied health practice, aged care, disability support, pharmacy or hospital
  • Confident, clear spoken English and a warm, patient telephone manner, including with older callers
  • Exceptional attention to detail with patient information, prescriptions and payments
  • Strong organisation and time management, with several requests on the go at once
  • Comfortable with email and Microsoft Office, and quick to learn new software
  • Reliability, discretion and a solid understanding of patient confidentiality
  • A quiet workspace, a reliable computer and headset, and a stable internet connection with a backup, so every call is clear
  • Available to answer the phone Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM PHT

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting Australian clients or an Australian healthcare practice
  • Familiarity with medical terminology, prescriptions and medication ordering
  • Experience with Genie or other medical practice management software
  • Experience with invoicing and payment platforms such as Invoice Ninja or Stripe
  • Experience coordinating with pharmacies, medical specialists or other external providers
  • Experience in a remote or largely independent administrative role

What's on offer

Offshore 24/7 has placed 500+ professionals with Australian businesses since 2008 and is rated 4.9/5 on Glassdoor and 5.0 on Google. You'll have ongoing training and coaching from a team that backs you, while working directly with an Australian healthcare service.

  • Annual rate and performance review
  • Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development
  • Regular staff events and team activities
  • Direct exposure to Australian clients and business practices

If you have healthcare or patient phone experience, speak clearly and confidently, and can be reachable 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM PHT from a quiet, reliable setup, we'd love to hear from you.

Job title:

What you'll be doing :

  • Assess the impact of policy and operational changes, identifying implications for clinical quality, training, processes, controls and service delivery.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex clinical quality, audit and assurance issues, using professional judgement to recommend appropriate action.
  • Turn assurance findings into practical improvements, working collaboratively with Clinical, Quality, Operations and Learning teams to strengthen guidance, training, CPD and supplier performance.

About this team

At PSBLTY, we’re assembling a powerhouse team of passionate, innovative, and growth-driven leaders who are committed to helping others achieve their fullest potential. Our team is not just about filling roles; it’s about creating a collective force that drives authentic growth for our client partners and within our own organization. As part of a rapidly growing company, our team members are expected to take 100% responsibility for everything they do, think strategically, make bold decisions, and act as catalysts for transformation in the financial services industry—and beyond.

This team thrives on a culture of possibility, where every member is encouraged to bring their boldest, most authentic self to work, contribute fresh ideas, and push the boundaries of what’s possible. We draw inspiration from world-class organizations that don’t just follow trends but set them. Here, you’ll have the freedom to experiment, the support to grow, and the tools to make a real impact, whatever your role.

Reporting to our Director of Fulfillment, you’ll collaborate closely with a dynamic group of growth leaders, strategists, and client success champions. Together, we’re not just building a company; we’re crafting a movement that empowers other leaders to stand out and make a difference. Join us, and you’ll be part of a team that’s dedicated to breaking new ground, both in our own growth and in the growth we create for our client partners.

What you will do

At PSBLTY, we believe that creating value is at the heart of every role. Whether someone’s a growth leader, strategist, or specialist, everybody’s contributions are key to our collective success, yours included.

As a Growth Leader, you will facilitate coaching cohorts and sessions for financial advisors, creating clarity, driving accountability, and producing measurable business and personal outcomes.

You will be responsible to:

  • Facilitate 1:1 and small group coaching cohorts that deliver clarity, value, and actionable next steps.
  • Drive client partner outcomes by setting goals, tracking progress, and celebrating measurable wins.
  • Provide program and product feedback to improve PSBLTY offerings and client experiences.
  • Ensure deliverable quality and timeliness, reviewing work outputs and keeping commitments on scope and deadlines.
  • Conduct session prep and follow-up to reinforce accountability and maximize impact.
  • Support client partner retention through proactive relationship-building and high-value interactions.
  • Identify and pursue upsell, cross-sell, upgrade, and renewal opportunities aligned with client goals.
  • Build trust that leads to referrals through consistent results and world-class service.
  • Continuously refine growth playbooks, scripts, and approaches to meet the needs of diverse client partners.
  • Participate in internal team meetings, retrospectives, and leadership syncs to improve collaboration and delivery.

While the specifics of your responsibilities are based on your role, certain expectations are universal across our entire team. In addition to your role’s responsibility, you will join everyone at The PSBLTY Co. in your responsibility to:

  • Champion our brand and culture. Be a steward of our brand values in every interaction, both internally and externally. Represent The PSBLTY Co. with integrity, passion, and authenticity, ensuring that who we are—and who you are—is reflected in all that we do.
  • Drive impact through your work. Align your efforts with our mission to help leaders and their organizations grow profits by standing out. Ensure that every task, project, or initiative you undertake moves us closer to this goal.
  • Deliver measurable results. Focus on outcomes that can be tracked and reported. Whether you’re responsible for driving revenue, increasing engagement, or improving client partner satisfaction, your work should be data-driven and results-oriented.
  • Collaborate and lead cross-functionally. Work seamlessly with other team members and departments to ensure that our projects and strategies are aligned, cohesive, and effective. Your ability to communicate and coordinate with others will be crucial to our success.
  • Innovate and refine processes. Continuously seek opportunities to improve the way we work. Whether it’s by streamlining processes, introducing new tools, or refining existing systems, your contributions should make our operations smoother and more efficient.

Embrace the PSBLTY spirit by committing to “Be 100”—100% responsible, 100% of the time, and lead with unwavering accountability in every action you take. We’re counting on you.

What you bring

We’re seeking an impact-driven individual who is eager to contribute to a company that prioritizes authentic growth and transformation.
Minimum Requirements

  • 2+ years helping people or organizations achieve meaningful growth through coaching, consulting, leadership, client success, or advisory work.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust, create accountability, and drive measurable outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication skills and a commitment to delivering a world-class client experience.

Preferred Requirements

  • 5+ years in coaching, consulting, leadership development, executive advisory, or client success roles.
  • Experience serving leaders in the wealth management industry, including financial advisors,
  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas: brand strategy, sales growth, business development, culture, leadership, or organizational effectiveness.
  • Experience guiding business owners, executives, or leadership teams through growth and transformation.
  • Experience facilitating executive-level coaching conversations that create clarity, accountability, and sustained behavioral change.
  • Track record of driving measurable client outcomes, client retention, referrals, renewals, or expansion opportunities.
  • Ability to work Eastern Time hours.

How your success will be measured

As a Growth Leader, you will steward the leadership of three primary metrics:

  • Client Partner Retention Rate – Ensuring each client completes their program and continues their engagement as either a renewal or expansion.
  • Path Completion & Outcomes – Leading client partners to measurable progress through their path milestones.
  • Referrals & Upsells – Generating new opportunities through exceptional delivery and relationship-building.

To be clear, your role will be incentivized to hit these goals. As you grow in the position, we may mutually agree that your goals must evolve to meet the changing needs of the business, too.

What we will do

At The PSBLTY Co., we believe in mutual commitment and responsibility. As much as we expect our team members to contribute to our collective success, we are equally committed—and 100% responsible—to supporting and empowering you to reach your goals. As a team, we commit to:

  • Invest in your growth. We commit to providing you with opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and leadership growth.
  • Provide clear direction and support. We will ensure you have clear goals, actionable feedback, and the resources you need to succeed in your role.
  • Foster a culture of belonging. We promise to cultivate a work environment where perspectives are valued, and where every team member feels heard, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic self to work.
  • Encourage innovation and creativity. We commit to giving you the creative freedom to explore new ideas, run experiments, and contribute innovative solutions that drive our mission forward.
  • Maintain open and honest communication. We pledge to be transparent in our communication, keeping you informed and engaged in our strategic direction and decisions.
  • Create a balanced work environment. We will prioritize your well-being by encouraging a healthy work-life balance and offering flexibility where possible.
  • Recognize and celebrate your contributions. We promise to acknowledge and reward your hard work, dedication, and the unique value you bring to our team.
  • Support your success. We are committed to being your advocates, removing obstacles in your path, and doing whatever it takes to ensure you thrive within our organization.
  • Align on purpose and values. We will consistently demonstrate our core values, ensuring that our actions as leaders align with the culture we’re building together.
  • Commit to your long-term success. We’re here for the long haul, dedicated to your personal and professional journey, and committed to helping you build a career that’s as fulfilling as it is impactful.

At The PSBLTY Co., your success is our success. We’re in this together, and we’re fully committed to creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow into the leader you’re meant to be.

About the role

This is a full-time, salaried W-2 position.

Why choose PSBLTY

At The PSBLTY Co., we’re not just in the business of coaching and consulting—we’re in the business of creating a world of leaders committed to demonstrating what’s actually possible in all areas of their lives. Our mission is to fight like hell for every leader to grow profits by standing out, empowering leaders to break free from limitations and step boldly into what they’re best in the world at. That mission starts within our own walls, where every day is an opportunity to live out our core belief: possibility exists, limitation is created.

Our team is a collective of driven, purpose-filled individuals who are committed to making a real impact—for our client partners and for each other. We’re not perfect, but we are relentlessly focused on growth, improvement, and creating an environment where everyone has the space to be their most authentic selves. Whether you’re joining us from Phoenix, Paris, Peru, or anywhere in between, you’ll find a culture that is as bold and dynamic as the leaders we serve. Inspiration will penetrate you daily.

Don’t just take our word for it—here’s what one of our growth leaders has to say: “At The PSBLTY Co., I’ve found a place where I have been more challenged than I’ve ever been boldly challenged and supported, where my ideas are valued, and where I feel truly connected to the impact we’re making. This isn’t just a job; PSBLTY is a movement, and I’m proud to be a part of it.”

We could go on about the reasons to join us, but we believe in hiring for fit above all else. If you’re passionate about pushing boundaries, making a difference, and being part of something bigger than yourself, we invite you to learn more about our culture. We’re not looking for someone to fit into a role—we’re looking for people who feel called to help us shape the future and spread possibility to the world.

Who we’re looking for

We’re seeking an impact-driven individual who is eager to contribute to a company that prioritizes authentic growth and transformation. You will thrive at The PSBLTY Co. if you:

  • Pursue impact and income. You’re driven by a desire to make a meaningful difference in the lives of others, not just by financial gain.
  • Embody our core values. You align with and are committed to upholding our culture of belonging, performance, and leadership.
  • Are a lifelong learner. You’re constantly seeking knowledge, open to new ideas, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Bring experience and innovation. You have 3+ years of experience in your field, with a strong track record of delivering results and driving growth.
  • Leverage technology for growth. You enjoy discovering and implementing new technologies to enhance our operations and drive innovation.
  • Communicate with clarity and confidence. You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and speaking, who can articulate ideas clearly and persuasively.
  • Take initiative. You’re self-motivated, proactive, and don’t wait to be told what to do—you’re always looking for ways to contribute.
  • Set and achieve goals. You’re results-oriented, focused on hitting targets, and driving both personal and team success.
  • Collaborate and adapt. You work well with others, enjoy the collaborative process, and are comfortable with the ambiguity that comes with growth and change.
  • Value systems and scalability. You embrace systems and processes that enable us to scale and improve continuously.
  • Consider yourself a leader. You’re looking for opportunities to grow in your leadership within a rapidly expanding company.
  • Support diversity and inclusion. You understand that diversity and inclusion are not just buzzwords, but essential to our mission. We’re building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.

If you typically feel underrepresented in industries like ours, know that you’re not only welcome to apply, but we actively encourage it. We’re committed to building a team that’s as diverse and inclusive as the world we want to impact.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: Why This Role Exists Dealerships run on fragmented systems: disconnected DMS platforms, siloed F&I tools, and manual workflows that slow deals and leave money on the table.
jobs.description:
Why This Role Exists

Dealerships run on fragmented systems: disconnected DMS platforms, siloed F&I tools, and manual workflows that slow deals and leave money on the table. A2Z Sync replaces that with one platform for digital retailing, desking, F&I, and e-signature, used by roughly 1,800 dealership rooftops that process $2B+ in vehicle transactions a year. We are AI-native, and we are building intelligence into every part of the deal.

We need a PM who doesn't wait to be handed requirements. You go to the dealer, find the real problem, decide what to build, write it so engineering can ship it, and prove whether it worked. Your work sets the standard for how product is done at A2Z.

Scope & Scale

  • Ownership of a product area on the A2Z platform, assigned based on business priority and your strengths: digital retailing, desking, F&I, e-signature, integrations, or new AI capabilities.
  • A cross-functional squad of engineers, a Tech Lead, and a TPM who build what you define.
  • Direct access to dealers, F&I managers, desk managers, and integration partners.
  • AI-powered features that reach dealers and car buyers in live stores.

What You'll Own

Discovery

  • You go to the source. You run dealer interviews, job shadow in stores, and read support tickets and usage data until you understand the problem better than anyone else in the room.
  • You bring evidence, not opinions. Every initiative you propose comes with the dealer problem, the data behind it, and the outcome it should move.

Decisions & Ownership

  • You own outcomes, not tickets. You make the scope, priority, and trade-off calls for your area and stand behind them.
  • You write hypotheses and define what would prove or disprove them before the work starts. You set kill criteria, run pilots with real dealers, and bring leadership a go/no-go recommendation, not a status update.
  • You push back on engineering, sales, and leadership when the evidence says to, and you change your mind when the evidence says to.

Writing

  • You write PRDs, charters, and decision documents that engineering can build from without a meeting to explain them.
  • You turn PRDs into well-structured Jira epics and stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • You put trade-offs and disagreements in writing before they become surprises in meetings.

Metrics & Outcomes

  • You define success metrics before you build: adoption, deal velocity, gross per deal, error rates, dealer NPS, revenue.
  • You measure what changed after launch and use it to decide what happens next, including stopping work that isn't paying off.
  • For AI features, you track whether they work in the real world: accuracy, latency, cost per call, and whether dealers actually use them.

Raising the Bar

  • Your PRDs, decision docs, and metrics reviews become the examples other PMs work from.

Hands-On Expectations

This is not a "write requirements and wait" role. Expect to spend real time with dealers, in design and architecture reviews with engineers, and in the data. You will spend time in dealerships. You will not spend your days in status meetings.

First 90 Days / First Year

First 90 days: Learn to run a deal on the A2Z platform well enough to demo it to a desk manager. Visit dealerships and sit with your squad. Publish a product brief for your area: the top dealer problems, the evidence behind them, the metrics you will move, and what you will stop doing.

First year: You've shipped measurable improvements in your area, including at least one AI-powered feature live in stores with results you can point to. Engineering trusts your specs. Leadership trusts your recommendations. Other PMs use your documents as their template.

Requirements

What You Bring

Must Have

  • 5+ years of product management, owning the full product lifecycle from discovery to launch to measured results.
  • Has shipped LLM-powered features to production, beyond the demo, with measured outcomes.
  • Has run structured validation: hypotheses, pilots, kill criteria, and go/no-go recommendations to an executive audience.
  • Startup experience. You have shipped with constrained resources and no playbook.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with agent orchestration, tool-use and function calling, retrieval design, and building evals and guardrails for AI features.
  • Experience working with or for automotive retail dealerships, F&I, lending, or DMS integrations.
  • Comfort in technical discussions about APIs, data models, and cloud architecture (AWS a plus).
  • Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills for your own analysis.

Tech & Tools

  • Platform: AWS (DynamoDB, EventBridge, Lambda, API Gateway), Amazon Bedrock, multi-tenant dealer data.
  • Product tooling: Jira and Confluence, Figma, product analytics.
  • Ways of working: Claude as a daily tool, Google Workspace, Slack.

How You'll Use AI

A2Z is AI-native. We use Claude every day, and we expect you to as well.

  • Ship AI features that help dealers match vehicles, structure deals, and move faster in the F&I office.
  • Define how AI features are measured in production: accuracy, latency, cost, and adoption.
  • Prototype flows quickly so dealers react to something concrete in the first conversation, not the fourth.
  • Use Claude daily for research synthesis, PRD drafting, trade-off analysis, and decision documents.

You will not be replaced by AI. You will be the PM who decides what it does for our dealers.

Benefits

Our Mission

At A2Z Sync, we replace the friction of disconnected systems with the velocity of a single platform. We integrate digital insights with in-store operations to deliver transparent transactions that bring clarity to the car buyer and increased profitability to the dealer.

How We Show Up: DRIVEN

Six principles guide how we build, sell, and support one another. Together they spell DRIVEN, the mindset that moves us forward every day.

  • Dealership Obsessed. We measure success by the dealer's wins and the trust of their buyers. If it doesn't help them sell a car today, we don't build it.
  • Relentless Ownership. No lone wolves, no pass-backs. We own outcomes from start to finish and find solutions instead of excuses.
  • Invent with Purpose. We don't chase shiny tech. We replace guesswork with intelligence and ask "so what?" before starting any project.
  • Value Every Perspective. Better Together. We check egos at the door and pull in viewpoints different from our own before deciding.
  • Evolve or Evaporate. Change is our constant. We learn faster than the competition and share lessons learned as openly as wins.
  • Now Over Next. Bias toward action. We launch fast at 80%, gather data, and improve tomorrow.

Why A2Z Sync?

We pride ourselves on cultivating a fun, casual, and collaborative workplace culture where your hard work is recognized, your contributions drive real results, and your impact is felt every day. At A2Z Sync, we're deeply committed to our employees' well-being, starting with comprehensive benefits designed to help you care for yourself and your family.

Here's what we offer:

  • Base Salary: $140,000 – $155,000, depending on experience and qualifications, plus an equity grant.
  • Employer-Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage for you and your family starting on day one.
  • Flexible Work: Denver hybrid (2 days/week in office) or fully remote anywhere in the US.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match: Build your future with our competitive matching program.
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO): Unlimited PTO and 10 paid holidays.
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Coverage: Fully employer-paid.
  • Life and AD&D Insurance: Employer-paid coverage for peace of mind.
  • Free Mental Health Support: Access to confidential therapy sessions through BetterHelp.
  • Pet Insurance Options: Affordable plans for your furry family members.
  • Identity Theft Protection: Voluntary services to safeguard your personal information.
  • Other Cool Stuff: On-site gym in Denver, great co-workers, and a stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages to keep you fueled.

jobs.description:
Senior Contract Analyst

What you will be doing:

The Senior Contract Analyst is responsible for the creation of analytic deliverables for the Member Value Enablement (“MVE”) division to support strategies to bring top value to the membership and revenue opportunities for Premier. The Senior Contract Analyst will be responsible for creating high standard, reliable analytics deliverables and executing on-time improved analytics deliverables to optimize the value of the GPO, clinical tools, and services. The Senior Contract Analyst will be responsible for assisting the Manager in the training, prioritization of tasks, complex issue resolution and troubleshooting.

The Senior Contract Analyst will work with the Director, Manager, and Contract Analysts to support the needs of the member and commercial team nationwide to ensure new technology & processes meet their needs. In addition, the Contract Analyst will be responsible for awareness and knowledge of other business groups to better serve accounts and to drive additional member engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Analysis – 80%

  • Creating high quality, member-ready analytic deliverables including complex contract categories management to support members and revenue generation

  • Identify and assist with complex issue resolution and troubleshoot data/tool issues for escalation to the Manager for resolution

  • Assist the Manager to identify any gaps in member solutions including Sourcing/Contracting, Technology and Analytics

  • Adhere to data standard and governance guidelines

  • Train and onboard new MVE staff on reports and processes

  • Follow Member Operation Plans outlining nuances for report creation

  • Maintain an understanding of all the revenue driving and value add products and services offered to the membership

  • Understand data flow, large data set review, and cleanup issues (ex: UOM)

  • Prioritize tasks and provide support on complex deliverables to ensure timely completion

  • Generate a variety of other ad-hoc analytical work products required to manage the account.

  • Conduct routine analytics required to demonstrate the value of Premier contracts and to drive contract penetration.

  • Become an expert on Supply Chain ITS tools. This includes the collection, uploading, management, and manipulation of all related data.

  • Respond to issues quickly and correctly and ensure they are resolved or escalated within the account management team

MVE Analytics Development – 20%

  • Support the development of MVE goals of enabling Premier members to realize their supply chain and clinical improvement potential, optimizing the value of the GPO, clinical tools, and services.

  • Support an evolving analytics model by providing insights about data, optimization, performance, and technology.

  • Participate in cross functional teams across Business unit’s regional operations teams as requested

  • Ability to organize large amounts of data gathered during elicitation and analysis, and to cope with rapidly changing information

  • Customer service skills (internal and external customers)

  • Analytical skills to critically evaluate the information gathered from multiple sources, reconcile conflicts, decompose high-level information into details, abstract up from low-level information into more general understanding, distinguish presented user requests from the underlying true needs and distinguish solution ideas from requirements

  • In-depth understanding and knowledge of Premier data sources

  • Ability to mentor and train less experienced staff members

  • Ability to manage and lead cross-functional team collaboration

  • Ability to prioritize member needs and provide coverage

  • Ability to troubleshoot and communicate data/tool issues

  • Organizational skills

  • Detailed oriented

  • Critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Knowledgeable of Sourcing strategy and ability to integrate with analytics

  • Ability to work independently and be self-accountable

Experience:

  • Experience in healthcare and IT environment preferred.

  • Similar analytic experience preferred.

  • The expectation is that Senior Contract Analysts will have demonstrated capable performance in a Contract Analyst role for a period of 2-3 years or will have equivalent experience for the same amount of time outside of Premier.

Education:

Application Deadline:

12/07/2026

Address:

VIRTUAL13 - HomeRes - IL

Job Family Group:

Human Resources

Plans, designs, and develops clear, engaging, compelling learning and performance-focused solutions that enhance retention and knowledge transfer. Applies design expertise to create learning, performance-focused solutions and creative strategies that achieve visible and measurable improvements to individual and group performance, development, and/or productivity and business results. Works on a variety of projects, initiatives, and platforms/mediums to support of the execution of business strategies according to required timelines and budgets and quality output standards.

  • Acts as a trusted advisor to assigned business/group.
  • Influences and negotiates to achieve business objectives.
  • Assists in the development of strategic plans.
  • Identifies emerging issues and trends to inform decision-making.
  • Supports the execution of strategic initiatives in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Conducts independent analysis and assessment to resolve strategic issues.
  • Ensures alignment between stakeholders.
  • Monitors and tracks performance, and addresses any issues.
  • Builds change management plans of varying scope and type; leads or participates in a variety of change management activities including readiness assessments, planning, stakeholder management, execution, evaluation and sustainment of initiatives.
  • Leads or participates in defining the communication plan designed to positively influence or change behaviour; develops tailored messaging; and identifies appropriate distribution channels.
  • Develops effective project plans to facilitate the building of learning programs and curriculum to close gaps identified.
  • Develops and manages a business/group program.
  • Reviews the program for effectiveness, considers industry trends and recommends enhancements; makes changes as required.
  • Develops solutions and makes recommendations based on an understanding of the business strategy and stakeholder needs.
  • Provides advice and guidance to assigned business / group on design challenges, assesses performance gaps, and recommends solutions to assigned business/group leaders on principles, programs, approaches, and mediums.
  • Designs and develops solutions that help advance human performance and drive business impact with a customer focus mindset to ensure linkages to customer experience.
  • Conducts design analysis, scopes project objectives and analyzes target audience expectations.
  • Defines learning objectives, describes tasks and activities, estimates the resource requirements, and creates detailed design structure.
  • Writes, storyboards, and edits learning and performance support interventions.
  • Ensures learning solutions are instructionally sound, and developed on time, within scope and budget.
  • Maintains external network to understand the competitive landscape, and keep abreast of industry developments and new technology solutions and trends.
  • Breaks down strategic problems, and analyses data and information to provide insights and recommendations.
  • Participates in the management of vendor relationships.
  • May network with industry contacts to gather and identify competitive insights and best practices.
  • Builds effective relationships with internal/external stakeholders.
  • Participates or acts as a lead on multiple internal projects varying in size and complexity.
  • Focus is primarily on business/group within BMO; may have broader, enterprise-wide focus.
  • Provides specialized consulting, analytical and technical support.
  • Exercises judgment to identify, diagnose, and solve problems within given rules.
  • Works independently and regularly handles non-routine situations.
  • Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.
  • Take measured risks while protecting the bank by applying our Risk Management Framework in the execution of your role, in line with our Risk Culture and within our approved Risk Appetite, making sound and risk informed decisions that align to business strategy, protect assets, and adhere to applicable policy documents (Frameworks, Policies, Standards, Procedures and Supporting documents), laws and regulations.

    Qualifications:

  • Typically between 5 - 7 years of relevant experience and post-secondary degree in related field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Adult Learning accreditation is required.
  • Knowledge of accessibility principles / practices and the implications for design and development - In-depth.
  • Knowledge of adult learning theory, instructional methodologies, technology-enabled design and learning methods - In-depth.
  • Experience in the design and development of training for multiple delivery methods.
  • Strong knowledge of web development processes and familiarity with authoring tools - In-depth.
  • Design thinking - In-depth.
  • Deep knowledge and technical proficiency gained through extensive education and business experience.
  • Verbal & written communication skills - In-depth.
  • Collaboration & team skills - In-depth.
  • Analytical and problem solving skills - In-depth.
  • Influence skills - In-depth.
