jobs.excerpt: Company: 3500 Square LLC Work Arrangement: 100% Remote Career Level: Entry-Level to Senior-Level Position Summary 3500 Square LLC is seeking talented and motivated Bilingual Network Engineers across multiple experience levels to support the design, implementation, maintenance, security, and optimization of network infrastructure.
jobs.description:
Company: 3500 Square LLC
Work Arrangement: 100% Remote
Career Level: Entry-Level to Senior-Level

Position Summary

3500 Square LLC is seeking talented and motivated Bilingual Network Engineers across multiple experience levels to support the design, implementation, maintenance, security, and optimization of network infrastructure.

This position supports the development and maintenance of reliable, secure, and scalable network solutions in alignment with program requirements and organizational objectives.

Candidates will be considered for the appropriate position level based on their education, relevant professional experience, technical qualifications, and applicable certifications.

Recent graduates and experienced network professionals are encouraged to apply.

Primary Responsibilities

Depending on the assigned position level, responsibilities may include:

  • Install, configure, test, and maintain network hardware and software.

  • Design and implement reliable, secure, and scalable network solutions.

  • Monitor network performance, availability, and connectivity.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve network-related issues.

  • Perform network maintenance, system upgrades, and infrastructure improvements.

  • Implement and maintain network security protocols.

  • Analyze network traffic and optimize system performance.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of network configurations and infrastructure changes.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support network-related projects.

  • Ensure compliance with established security standards, organizational policies, and industry best practices.

  • Support cloud networking and virtualized environments.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, as applicable.

  • Lead complex network infrastructure projects and strategic initiatives, as applicable to senior-level positions.

Education and Experience

Network Engineer I

  • Bachelor of Science (BS) degree or equivalent professional experience.

  • Less than two (2) years of relevant professional experience.

  • Entry-level candidates with no previous professional experience are encouraged to apply.

Network Engineer II

  • Bachelor of Science (BS) degree and two (2) to four (4) years of relevant professional experience; or

  • Master's degree with less than two (2) years of relevant professional experience.

Network Engineer III

  • Bachelor of Science (BS) degree and four (4) to eight (8) years of relevant professional experience; or

  • Master's degree and two (2) to six (6) years of relevant professional experience.

Network Engineer IV

  • Bachelor of Science (BS) degree and eight (8) to twelve (12) years of relevant professional experience; or

  • Master's degree and six (6) to ten (10) years of relevant professional experience.

  • May possess a doctorate in a technical domain.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Depending on the assigned position level:

  • Knowledge of network protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP.

  • Knowledge of network hardware, including routers and switches.

  • Routing and switching technologies, including OSPF, BGP, and VLANs.

  • Network monitoring and performance optimization.

  • Network troubleshooting and problem-solving.

  • Network security principles and protocols.

  • Cloud networking and virtualized environments, including AWS, Azure, and VMware.

  • Advanced networking technologies, including SD-WAN, MPLS, and Quality of Service (QoS).

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

  • Technical leadership, project management, and strategic planning skills for senior-level positions.

Professional Certifications

Preferred Certifications

  • Level I: CompTIA Network+ or CCNA.

  • Level II: CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent.

  • Level III: CCNP, CISSP, or equivalent are highly desirable.

Required Certifications – Level IV

  • CCIE, CISSP, or equivalent certification.

General Requirements

  • Must be proficient in English, both verbal and written.

  • Proficiency in Spanish preferred.

  • Proficiency in additional languages also preferred.

  • Ability to work in a fully remote environment.

  • Reliable high-speed residential internet connection through fiber, copper, or coaxial cable. Mobile phone tethering is not permitted.

  • Reliable backup power solution to maintain work continuity during power outages.

  • Dedicated, quiet, private, and confidential workspace free from distractions and interruptions.

  • Ability to comply with HIPAA, confidentiality, information security, and remote workspace requirements.

  • Professional appearance and appropriate background during video calls.

Government Security and Eligibility Requirements

  • Ability to successfully complete all required pre-employment screening and verification processes.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination.

  • Willingness to complete the required government background investigation, security questionnaire, and fingerprinting process.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Common Access Card (CAC).

  • Ability to comply with all applicable government security and contractual requirements.

Work Schedule

Work schedules and shift assignments will be based on program and operational requirements. Candidates will be asked to provide their shift and day availability during the recruitment process.

Additional Information

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable pre-employment screening, client approval, government security requirements, and program eligibility requirements.

Join 3500 Square LLC and contribute to the development of secure, reliable, and innovative technology solutions.

We Make IT Boring.

Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

Are you a talented tax professional that specializes in US individual tax services?

Would your ideal job offer a limited tax busy season?

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly (BT) as a Tax Manager- Individual Tax Services! This is an internal position that provides US individual tax services to Baker Tilly Partners, including tax preparation, planning and consulting.

This position is ideal for someone who wants to continue building their career in public accounting AND have incredible work/life balance. This position can be worked from any location - fully remote work is allowed. As one of the fastest growing firms in the nation, BT has the ability to offer you upward career trajectory, flexibility in how and where you work along with meaningful relationships with clients, teammates and leadership who truly care about you and your development.

You will enjoy this role if:

  • You enjoy being your client’s personal advisor and collaborating with a team to provide a holistic approach to their tax services.
  • You seek a leadership opportunity with a well-established practice that continues to achieve tremendous growth
  • You want to be part of a firm invested in your success by providing the resources and support to continually sharpen your technical skills and build your career now, for tomorrow
  • You prefer having a steady schedule year-round with a limited fall busy season

What you will do:

  • Provide compliance and consulting services to BT Partners
    • Perform technical review of complex individual tax returns and all supporting tax documents.
    • Lead multiple engagements that deliver proactive tax planning and strategic consulting.
    • Grow technical competence by applying technical developments to complex situations
  • Serve as the primary engagement contact for about 60 Principals
  • Invest in your professional development individually and through participation in firm wide learning and development programs
  • Support the growth and development of team members through the Baker Tilly Care and Teach philosophy, helping associates meet their professional goals

Minimum Qualifications

  • Five (5)+ years’ experience in tax return review and planning for high net worth individuals required
  • 4 year degree required
  • CPA, Law License or Enrolled Agent

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting or law, or a similar degree in business, master’s or advanced degree desirable
  • Multi-state tax compliance experience for individuals, including understanding of composite, withholding and pass-through entity tax
  • Experience providing federal tax compliance and consulting services in a professional services firm
  • Two (2)+ year of supervisory experience, mentoring and counseling associates preferred
  • Demonstrated management, analytical, organization, interpersonal, project management, communication skills
  • Highly developed CCH Axcess, PDFlyer and Microsoft Suite skills
  • Eligibility to work in the U.S. without sponsorship preferred

The pay rate ranges for this position are listed below. This range represents a good-faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation the firm expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will depend on a variety of relevant factors, including an applicant’s skills, experience, qualifications, professional certifications, work arrangements, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range, and compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. Baker Tilly offers a compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

The national pay rate range is $72,000 to $143,200

The pay range in NY, NY is $90,000 to $179,100

1043 - Data Engineer (SQL/Data Modeling/Knowledge Graphs) · Semi-Senior · Remoto · Argentina

Ubicación: Argentina
Modalidad: 100% remoto
Contratación: Relación de dependencia (full-time)
Seniority: Semi-Senior (3 a 5 años de experiencia)
Industria / Proyecto: LegalTech / Inteligencia Artificial y Gestión del Conocimiento
Zona horaria: Argentina (ART / UTC-3)
Inglés: Técnico (lectura de documentación)

Conocé Darwoft

En Darwoft desarrollamos software que genera impacto real.

Somos una compañía tecnológica latinoamericana que trabaja con empresas nacionales e internacionales, creando soluciones digitales innovadoras, escalables y orientadas al negocio.

Nuestra cultura combina excelencia técnica, colaboración, aprendizaje continuo y una fuerte orientación a las personas.

La Inteligencia Artificial forma parte de nuestra manera de innovar, desarrollar productos y resolver desafíos tecnológicos.

Si te apasiona la tecnología, disfrutás resolver problemas complejos y querés participar en proyectos donde tus decisiones técnicas generen impacto, nos encantaría conocerte.

Sobre la oportunidad

Estamos Sumando un/a Data Engineer Semi-Senior con sólidos conocimientos en modelado de datos, bases de datos relacionales y diseño de estructuras de información complejas para participar en un proyecto innovador que combina ingeniería de datos, procesamiento de lenguaje natural e Inteligencia Artificial.

El desafío consiste en construir los fundamentos de una plataforma de inteligencia legal, tributaria y regulatoria, capaz de interpretar grandes volúmenes de documentación, identificar entidades y relaciones, y transformar esa información en conocimiento estructurado.

Vas a trabajar en el diseño de modelos de datos que permitan representar documentos, conceptos, jerarquías y relaciones semánticas, contribuyendo a la evolución de un Knowledge Graph que potenciará soluciones de búsqueda inteligente y arquitecturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).

Actualmente, el proyecto se encuentra en una etapa clave de modelado e integración de información documental. El equipo trabaja con documentos estructurados, identificando tanto sus componentes documentales como las entidades y relaciones de negocio que contienen.

La arquitectura utiliza tecnologías como Neo4j, Cypher, Python, AWS y modelos de lenguaje (LLMs), con una evolución progresiva hacia soluciones más avanzadas de extracción, recuperación semántica y gobierno de datos.

No es necesario que seas especialista en Neo4j o GraphRAG. Buscamos una persona con fundamentos sólidos en ingeniería y modelado de datos, capaz de comprender problemas complejos, diseñar soluciones y adaptarse a nuevas tecnologías.

¿Cuáles serán tus principales desafíos?

  • Modelado de datos: Diseñar modelos conceptuales, lógicos y estructuras de datos que representen entidades, atributos, relaciones, jerarquías y reglas de negocio.
  • Modelado documental: Analizar documentos complejos e identificar sus componentes estructurales, como títulos, secciones, artículos, párrafos y relaciones jerárquicas.
  • Extracción de entidades: Colaborar en el diseño de procesos para identificar entidades y relaciones semánticas dentro de documentos jurídicos y regulatorios.
  • Ingeniería de datos: Diseñar y desarrollar pipelines ETL/ELT para transformar, validar y estructurar información proveniente de diferentes fuentes.
  • Knowledge Graphs: Participar en la construcción y evolución de modelos de conocimiento orientados a grafos, utilizando tecnologías como Neo4j y Cypher.
  • Gobierno de datos: Contribuir a definir modelos, convenciones y reglas que garanticen consistencia semántica entre bases de datos, servicios, APIs y otros componentes de la plataforma.
  • Integración con IA: Trabajar junto a equipos de Data Science y desarrollo en procesos de extracción asistidos por LLMs y recuperación de información.
  • Calidad y precisión: Diseñar mecanismos de validación que permitan identificar inconsistencias, preservar relaciones y mejorar la confiabilidad de los datos.
  • Evolución técnica: Investigar alternativas, evaluar herramientas y proponer soluciones para desafíos de arquitectura y modelado.
  • Colaboración: Participar activamente en mesas de trabajo técnicas, discutir decisiones de diseño y documentar las soluciones implementadas.

¿Qué buscamos?

  • Experiencia: Entre 3 y 5 años trabajando en Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Data Platform Engineering o posiciones relacionadas.
  • Modelado de datos: Experiencia sólida en diseño conceptual y lógico, modelos entidad-relación, definición de entidades, atributos, cardinalidades y relaciones.
  • Bases de datos relacionales: Buen dominio de SQL y conocimiento de normalización, integridad referencial, claves primarias, claves foráneas y restricciones.
  • Ingeniería de datos: Experiencia desarrollando procesos de ingesta, transformación, integración y validación mediante pipelines ETL/ELT.
  • Programación: Experiencia con Python para procesamiento de información, automatización o construcción de pipelines de datos.
  • Análisis de información: Capacidad para interpretar requerimientos complejos y transformarlos en modelos de datos consistentes, escalables y mantenibles.
  • Calidad de datos: Conocimiento de validaciones, consistencia, integridad y buenas prácticas de documentación.
  • Pensamiento crítico: Capacidad para analizar problemas, cuestionar supuestos, proponer alternativas y fundamentar decisiones técnicas.
  • Autonomía: Experiencia trabajando con objetivos funcionales y técnicos que requieren investigación, definición de soluciones y colaboración con distintos especialistas.
  • Adaptabilidad tecnológica: Interés y capacidad para incorporar nuevos paradigmas de modelado, bases de datos de grafos y herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial.

Será un plus si tenés experiencia en:

  • Neo4j y Cypher, especialmente modelado de grafos y consultas sobre relaciones complejas.
  • Knowledge Graphs, Property Graphs o bases de datos orientadas a grafos.
  • Procesamiento de lenguaje natural (NLP) y extracción de entidades (NER).
  • Procesamiento de documentos complejos, contratos, textos jurídicos o documentación regulatoria.
  • Ontologías, taxonomías y tecnologías semánticas como RDF, OWL, SKOS o SHACL.
  • Modelado declarativo, JSON Schema u enfoques de Ontology as Code.
  • Arquitecturas RAG, GraphRAG, embeddings y búsqueda semántica.
  • Integración de modelos de lenguaje (LLMs) en pipelines de procesamiento documental.
  • Servicios de AWS y arquitecturas de datos en la nube.
  • Frameworks como LangChain o LlamaIndex.
  • Proyectos de LegalTech, RegTech, compliance o gestión de conocimiento.

¿Qué hace interesante este desafío?

No se trata únicamente de construir pipelines o administrar bases de datos.

Vas a participar en una etapa fundamental de un producto que busca transformar información jurídica compleja en conocimiento estructurado, trazable y accesible mediante Inteligencia Artificial.

El principal desafío es lograr que la tecnología comprenda cómo se relacionan los datos, preserve el significado de la información y permita construir soluciones de consulta cada vez más precisas.

Es una oportunidad para aplicar fundamentos clásicos de ingeniería de datos y evolucionar profesionalmente hacia arquitecturas de conocimiento, NLP, grafos e IA.

¿Qué te ofrecemos en Darwoft?

  • Contratación full-time en relación de dependencia con pago en ARS.
  • Trabajo 100% remoto desde Argentina.
  • Salario competitivo.
  • Vacaciones y licencias legales.
  • Días personales adicionales al año.
  • Acceso a plataformas de capacitación y aprendizaje.
  • Clases de inglés.
  • Tarjeta de beneficios y descuentos.
  • Programas de reintegros.
  • Welcome kit.
  • Programa de referidos.
  • Regalo de cumpleaños.
  • Healthy Break.
  • Celebraciones y actividades de integración al estilo Darwoft.

¿Te interesa el desafío?

Si tenés una base sólida en modelado de datos, disfrutás resolver problemas de arquitectura y te entusiasma aplicar tus conocimientos en proyectos de Inteligencia Artificial, queremos conocerte.

jobs.description:
Titre: Analyste en gestion des menaces et des vulnérabilités

Relève de: Gestionnaire Sécurité Produits et Offensive

Le côté brillant de l'hypothèque

nesto est le chef de file du financement hypothécaire résidentiel numérique au Canada. Nous offrons aux Canadiens les taux les plus bas dès le départ, en toute transparence et sans négociation.

À propos de nous

Pionnier du financement hypothécaire en ligne au Canada, nesto transforme la façon dont les Canadiens financent leur propriété. Notre mission est d'offrir une expérience de financement immobilier positive, valorisante et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin. Les emprunteurs profitent de taux souvent plus avantageux que ceux offerts par les grandes banques, ainsi que d'une expérience hypothécaire exceptionnelle, simple et fluide, du début à la fin. Le tout est propulsé par une technologie d'intelligence artificielle de pointe. Rapide, simple et entièrement numérique, nesto a été nommé Prêteur hypothécaire de l'année par la CLA pendant trois années consécutives. Voilà le côté brillant de l'hypothèque.

Groupe Nesto

Le Groupe Nesto est le principal fournisseur de technologies hypothécaires et de solutions de financement au Canada, avec plus de 80 milliards de dollars canadiens en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux sous administration. Fort de la confiance de plusieurs des principales institutions financières du pays, le Groupe Nesto combine plus de 50 ans d'expertise hypothécaire à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives pour transformer l'avenir du financement.

Grâce à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives, nesto est devenu l'un des prêteurs hypothécaires à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, gagnant des parts de marché dans le financement résidentiel direct aux consommateurs (D2C), le réseau des courtiers hypothécaires et le financement commercial multirésidentiel. Reconnue au palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, l'entreprise continue de faire progresser le secteur grâce à l'innovation, à la technologie et à des solutions axées sur les clients.

Grâce à sa famille de marques – CMLS, nesto et Nesto Cloud –, le Groupe Nesto a pour mission de bâtir l'écosystème hypothécaire canadien de demain et de devenir un véritable chef de file canadien en technologies de financement et en services financiers.

La vie chez nesto

Chez nesto, nous avons à cœur de remettre en question le statu quo, d'offrir une meilleure expérience hypothécaire et d'aider les Canadiens à économiser sur leur hypothèque. Nous cultivons une culture de collaboration, de transparence et de créativité, où chaque membre de l'équipe est encouragé à prendre ses projets en main, à avoir un impact concret et à évoluer. Si vous souhaitez relever des défis stimulants et trouver des solutions à des enjeux importants aux côtés de collègues ambitieux, passionnés et toujours prêts à s'entraider, vous vous sentirez chez vous chez nesto.

Lieu de travail

Il s’agit d’un poste principalement en télétravail, ouvert aux candidatures partout au Canada. Vous aurez la flexibilité de travailler de la maison ou à partir de n’importe lequel de nos bureaux à l’échelle du pays.

Pourquoi nous recrutons

Les vulnérabilités sont exploitées plus rapidement que jamais. Avec l’IA, le délai entre une divulgation publique et un code d’exploitation fonctionnel est passé de quelques semaines à environ une journée, ce qui exige une veille quotidienne des failles critiques. Aujourd’hui, cette tâche s’ajoute à d’autres responsabilités en matière de sécurité. Ce nouveau poste a été créé pour qu’une personne en assume pleinement la responsabilité : repérer les vulnérabilités émergentes dans ce court laps de temps, évaluer leur impact réel pour nesto et mobiliser les bonnes équipes pour corriger l’essentiel.

Tout aussi crucial : faire le tri dans le bruit ambiant. Il est omniprésent, et nos équipes doivent consacrer leur temps uniquement à ce qui en vaut la peine. Vous serez la personne capable d’expliquer clairement ce qui est prioritaire et ce qui ne l’est pas.

Ce que vous ferez

1. Surveillance continue et validée du périmètre externe

  • Surveiller et gérer la surface d’attaque externe.
  • Tester et valider l’exploitabilité ainsi que l’accessibilité (reachability) des vulnérabilités à fort impact.
  • Remettre en question les résultats des outils : signaler les faux positifs, les constats obsolètes et les actifs mal attribués, puis intégrer ces retours pour affiner le paramétrage des outils.
  • Assurer le suivi jusqu’à la résolution complète : attribuer un responsable, suivre les SLA selon la gravité, escalader les retards et re-tester les correctifs.
  • Expliquer clairement les risques aux équipes internes et piloter la remédiation via les billets et Slack jusqu’à ce que le problème soit résolu.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie sur les correctifs – qui sont en grande partie gérés sous forme d’infrastructure en tant que code (Infrastructure as Code) – afin de contribuer directement à la solution.
  • Maintenir une vue claire de la posture de la surface d’attaque et en rendre compte à la direction : expositions ouvertes par gravité et par ancienneté, nombre de vulnérabilités exploitables validées, respect des ENT (SLA) et délai de remédiation.

2. Veille en renseignement sur les menaces

  • Assurer une veille quotidienne sur les menaces (catalogue CISA KEV, avis des fournisseurs, publication d’exploits et de preuves de concept [PoC], rapports sectoriels) pour repérer les enjeux touchant notre pile technologique et notre périmètre.
  • Faire le lien entre les informations publiques sur les vulnérabilités et l’environnement de nesto, y compris les outils open source sur lesquels nous nous appuyons, afin d’anticiper ce qui pourrait être exposé avant qu’une faille ne soit largement connue.
  • Pour chaque avis pertinent, publier un verdict rapide (exposé et exploitable ?) accompagné de preuves et d’une mesure recommandée.
  • Établir les priorités en fonction du risque réel (exploitation connue, maturité de l’exploit, exposition, criticité de l’actif), et non uniquement selon le score CVSS.
  • Déployer un processus d’intervention rapide pour les failles activement exploitées : délai jusqu’au premier verdict, notification des responsables et suivi des mesures d’atténuation.
  • Transformer les tendances récurrentes en nouvelles vérifications, listes de surveillance et données d’entrée pour la modélisation des menaces.

3. Outillage et automatisation : passer du réactif au proactif

  • Automatiser la boucle réactive : ingestion depuis Wiz, enrichissement, vérifications d’accessibilité, création de billets, notification des responsables, suivi des SLA et re-tests.
  • Utiliser des outils d’IA dans votre flux de travail quotidien pour gagner en rapidité, tout en validant systématiquement leurs résultats avant toute prise d’action.
  • Proposer des améliorations aux outils à partir des lacunes observées (couverture, faux positifs, enrichissement, rapports), en précisant pour chacune le problème, le gain et l’effort requis.
  • Détecter proactivement toute nouvelle exposition (DNS, transparence des certificats, changements dans le nuage et les déploiements) avant qu’elle ne soit balayée ou exploitée.
  • Créer des vérifications de validation réutilisables et des guides d’intervention (playbooks) utilisables par d’autres équipes.
  • Suivre et améliorer les procédures documentées afin de veiller à ce que chaque vulnérabilité soit suivie jusqu’à sa résolution, y compris les étapes courantes.
  • Rendre compte de la posture de sécurité : part des détections traitées sans intervention manuelle, délai de détection, délai jusqu’au verdict validé et taux de faux positifs.

Ce que vous apportez

  • 1 à 3 ans d’expérience en gestion des vulnérabilités, ou une connaissance équivalente des outils de sécurité offensive et défensive.
  • Expérience pratique avec les outils de gestion de la surface d’attaque et de détection des vulnérabilités (p. ex. Wiz, Nuclei/Neo ou équivalent), incluant le triage des résultats selon le risque réel et la validation de leur exploitabilité.
  • Expérience de travail en environnement d’entreprise : ouverture de billets, communication inter équipes sur Slack et suivi rigoureux jusqu’à la résolution.
  • Une compréhension suffisante de la sécurité offensive pour juger si une vulnérabilité est réellement exploitable ou s’il ne s’agit que de bruit.
  • Une approche méthodique et autonome : vous menez un processus jusqu’au bout, y compris les étapes moins stimulantes.
  • Un excellent jugement et de solides compétences en recherche, alliés à la curiosité et au souci du détail nécessaires pour repérer les angles morts.
  • Une communication claire, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit, avec les équipes techniques et non techniques.
  • Un scepticisme sain à l’égard des contenus générés par l’IA : vous les vérifiez plutôt que de les prendre pour acquis.

Atouts

  • Une formation ou une expérience en TI ou en ingénierie.
  • Des certifications telles que OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) ou OSWE (Offensive Security Web Expert), ou une certification récente en sécurité axée sur l’IA.
  • La maîtrise du français est un atout.

Ce poste pourrait vous convenir si

  • Vous aimez la structure : découvrir la vulnérabilité n’est pour vous qu’un point de départ, et vous aimez mener le dossier jusqu’à l’application du correctif.
  • Lorsque vous lisez un nouvel avis de sécurité, votre premier réflexe est de vous demander : « Qu’utilisons-nous qui pourrait être touché ? »
  • Lorsqu’un outil d’IA vous donne une réponse, votre premier réflexe est de la vérifier.
  • Vous avez la curiosité nécessaire pour suivre le rythme d’un domaine qui évolue chaque jour.
  • Vous souhaitez contribuer à résoudre les problèmes, et non seulement les signaler.

La récompense

  • Rémunération concurrentielle – Salaire compétitif, primes de rendement (le cas échéant) et reconnaissance de vos contributions.
  • Santé et bien-être – Couverture complète pour les soins médicaux, dentaires et de la vue, comptes de gestion des dépenses santé et bien-être (le cas échéant), télémédecine, programme d'aide aux employés (PAE) et soutien en santé mentale pour vous et votre famille.
  • Du temps pour refaire le plein – Vacances généreuses (4 semaines), congés mobiles et jours fériés pour vous permettre de vous ressourcer.
  • Planification de l'avenir – Cotisation de contrepartie au REER pour soutenir votre bien-être financier à long terme.
  • Soutien aux familles – Prestations complémentaires bonifiées pour les congés de maternité et parentaux.
  • Apprentissage et perfectionnement – Aide financière aux études, mentorat, formations et occasions de faire progresser votre carrière au sein du Groupe Nesto.
  • Des outils pour réussir – Technologies modernes, équipes collaboratives et toutes les ressources nécessaires pour vous dépasser.

Diversité, équité et inclusion

  • Au sein du Groupe Nesto, nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait notre force. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun se sent respecté, soutenu et habilité à réussir.
  • Nous accueillons les candidatures de personnes de tous horizons, y compris les membres des Premiers Peuples (Premières Nations, Inuit et Métis), les personnes en situation de handicap, les membres des communautés racisées, les femmes et les personnes de la communauté 2ELGBTQIA+.

Newell Brands is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® - and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Our culture is built on values in action: Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership, and Leadership. We work together to win, grow, and make a real impact—supported by a high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative environment where you can be your best, every day.

SUMMARY

International Trade & Compliance (IT&C) provides trade-related services to the business units, Newell Brands Distribution, Newell manufacturing sites and the Newell overseas distribution affiliates. The purpose of IT&C is three-fold:

  • Facilitate the timely release of goods by customs and related government agencies
  • Ensure compliance with import/export rules and regulations, globally
  • Minimize costs regarding duty spend (e.g., achieve savings)

Newell Brands relies on multiple enterprise Global Trade Management (GTM) platforms, supporting Restricted Party Screening, the Global Product Master, Free Trade Agreement qualification and Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) management. The GTM Business Analyst serves as the primary business-facing lead for the GTM user experience, support, documentation, enhancements, and release coordination. This role partners closely with Newell IT to support system integration and platform growth. Newell's trade automation footprint continues to grow, and this role is expected to grow with it.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Write, maintain and publish user guides, data entry standards and reporting processes, keeping documentation current with each new release.
  • Field, triage and resolve user questions and support requests related to GTM functionality, data and workflows; log, track and manage support tickets and vendor escalations.
  • Design and deliver end-user training sessions and onboarding materials for new and existing GTM users.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Product Designer shapes how educators and students experience CharacterStrong products, from the first sketch of an idea to a working prototype the team can test and build from. This role works across the whole product: framing problems, mapping what people are trying to get done, designing flows and interfaces, and building interactive prototypes using AI-assisted design tools. The Product Designer uses Claude as a core part of their practice, creating skills and workflows that help the whole team move faster. They also play a central role in growing and maintaining our design system so design and code stay in sync. This person is comfortable with ambiguity, takes ownership in a lean, fast-moving team, and partners closely with research, curriculum, product management, and technology to ship products that are intuitive, accessible, and a little delightful.

CharacterStrong’s Background & Mission:CharacterStrong, a FullBloom Company, is a fast-paced, tech education company that makes PreK-12 digital, social-emotional learning curricula and offers professional learning opportunities to support schools with implementation. There’s currently a team of more than 90 full-time employees and over 30 contractors and interns collaborating to bring this work to life. Our mission is to create a more loving world by equipping educators with tools to teach the critical social, emotional, and character skills necessary to foster a more empathetic, connected, and generous world. In less than 10 years, our aim is to have reached 50 million students and over 2 million educators. We were ranked by INC. as the 449th fastest-growing private company in the country.

At CharacterStrong, you will have the opportunity to positively impact education, both in the United States and internationally. CharacterStrong employees offer their innovation, dedication to excellence, and compassion to help produce transformational curricula and professional learning for educators.

CharacterStrong’s Company Values:

  • We Practice Kindness - Exercising inclusion, care, and empathy with others, balancing honesty with compassion when having courageous conversations and engaging in kindness towards self.
  • We Produce Excellence - Producing timely, quality results and consistently asking the question, “How can we make this 1% better?”
  • We Take Ownership - Taking the initiative to drive work forward, demonstrating responsibility when things do not go according to plan, and being proactive in closing identified gaps.
  • We Problem Solve - Identifying issues, analyzing for understanding, and taking action to implement the best possible solution.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with product managers and engineers to shape new initiatives: frame the problem, define what users are trying to accomplish, and turn that into flows, structure, and working prototypes.
  • Use Claude as a core design tool, building and refining Claude skills, reusable prompts, and workflows that speed up prototyping, documentation, and handoff across the team.
  • Build high-fidelity, interactive prototypes with AI-assisted code that behave like the real product, so ideas can be tested and refined before committing engineering time.
  • Contribute to and help evolve the design system with the Art Director: design components, define tokens and patterns, document usage, identify gaps, and keep design and code aligned.
  • Design for educators, administrators, and students, balancing curriculum goals with the realities of a school day.
  • Ensure designs are responsive across devices and screen sizes, and integrate accessibility principles to make products equitable for all.
  • Run lightweight user research and usability testing to validate direction, and translate findings into clear design decisions.
  • Work closely on cross-functional product engineering teams to implement design solutions and address usability challenges.
  • Communicate design decisions clearly through walkthroughs, written rationale, and annotated prototypes.

Qualifications

  • A strong portfolio showing end-to-end product design work, from problem framing and iteration to shipped outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience using Claude or similar AI tools in a design workflow, ideally including building Claude skills or structured prompts that others use.
  • Deep experience working in or building a design system, including components, tokens, documentation, and governance.
  • Proficiency in Figma.

Reddit brings people together around their interests, questions, and experiences. Our communities create rich and complex data, and we build tools that help people turn that data into reliable understanding.

The Data Science Platform team develops Rosso, Reddit’s analytics agent, and the shared tools that support analytical and scientific work across the company. About Rx Redefined

Rx Redefined is the logistics and distribution platform for physician-owned DME (Durable Medical Equipment). We are pioneering a patient-first shift in healthcare that empowers physicians to distribute, manage, and monitor the medical supplies and therapies critical to their patients. By removing administrative friction, navigating complex clinical compliance, and automating fulfillment, our platform gives practices the enterprise-grade infrastructure they need to scale. We are a well-funded, high-growth digital health company with team members distributed across the United States.

Role Summary

Rx Redefined is seeking an experienced, technically grounded Principal Product Manager to own the vision, strategy, and execution of our EMR Interoperability & Health System Integrations platform. In this role, you will serve as the core business counterpart to our Principal Architect for Interoperability. You will drive how Rx Redefined interfaces with the broader healthcare ecosystem—enabling bi-directional data flow with major ambulatory, acute, and post-acute Electronic Health Record (EHR) platforms (such as Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, athenahealth, and PointClickCare).

Unlike traditional internal workflow product management, this role is deeply external- and platform-focused. You will own the integration roadmap, define canonical clinical data translation requirements, navigate partner developer programs (e.g., Epic App Market, athenahealth Marketplace), and eliminate the manual data entry that slows down medical device ordering, clinical documentation, and patient fulfillment.

Key Responsibilities

Interoperability Roadmap & Product Strategy

  • Own the multi-quarter product roadmap for EMR/EHR connectivity, integration middleware, and clinical data ingestion across all provider specialties.
  • Define and prioritize standard integration packages (e.g., standard SMART on FHIR launch, HL7 v2 SIU/ADT/ORM/MDM interfaces, proprietary partner APIs, and clearinghouse connections).
  • Determine buy-vs-build integration strategies in partnership with engineering leadership (e.g., leveraging direct FHIR endpoints vs. middleware engines such as Redox, Datavant, or Rhapsody).

Clinical Data Harmonization & Functional Specs

  • Write comprehensive, production-ready Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), data mapping tables, and user stories translating complex clinical workflows into structured engineering deliverables.
  • Define the functional requirements for transforming inbound, unstructured, or semi-structured EMR payloads into Rx Redefined’s canonical clinical data model (orders, demographics, encounters, clinical notes, and device prescriptions).
  • Define identity resolution and patient-matching requirements (MPI) to maintain strict data integrity across external health systems and internal accounts.

EMR Ecosystem & Partner Management

  • Serve as the product liaison to major EMR developer ecosystems (Epic Partner Program / Showroom, Oracle Health Developer Program, athenahealth Marketplace).
  • Manage the functional certification, app submission, and compliance approval processes required to publish and maintain Rx Redefined integrations across commercial app exchanges.
  • Coordinate with provider practice IT teams, health system integration analysts, and third-party interface engineers during customer onboarding and interface activation.

Cross-Functional Execution & Compliance

  • Partner closely with the Principal Architect, integration engineers, and clinical operations to design reliable, scalable, and fault-tolerant interfaces.
  • Collaborate with Internal Applications Product Managers to ensure data ingested from EHRs flows seamlessly into internal order processing, billing, and supply chain tools.
  • Champion regulatory and security governance, ensuring all data exchange workflows strictly comply with HIPAA, HITECH, ONC Cures Act interoperability mandates, SOC 2 Type II, and Business Associate Agreements (BAAs).

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 7+ years of technical product management experience, with at least 4+ years dedicated specifically to healthcare interoperability, EMR/EHR integrations, or health data exchange platforms.
  • Domain Mastery: Deep, practical familiarity with healthcare data exchange standards, including FHIR (DSTU2/STU3/R4), HL7 v2.x (ADT, ORM, MDM, SIU), SMART on FHIR, and C-CDA.
  • EHR Ecosystem Fluency: Proven track record launching or managing production integrations with at least two major EHR systems (e.g., Epic, Cerner/Oracle Health, athenahealth, NextGen, eClinicalWorks, or PointClickCare).
  • Technical Depth: Ability to comfortably read API documentation, parse JSON/XML payloads, understand OAuth 2.0 / SMART launch contexts, and map database fields alongside technical architects.
  • Execution & Specification: Exceptional written communication skills with demonstrated rigor in authoring nuanced data mapping specifications, event-driven integration flows, and interface error-handling logic.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Health Informatics, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on product experience with integration engines and health-tech middleware (e.g., Redox, Datavant, Rhapsody, or Mirth Connect/NextGen Connect).
  • Experience with e-prescribing standards (NCPDP SCRIPT), clearinghouse EDI (X12 270/271, 837/835), or medical supply/DME documentation requirements.
  • Familiarity with Master Patient Index (MPI) and clinical identity resolution algorithms.
  • Prior experience at a high-growth Series B–D stage health-tech startup.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan
  • Unlimited PTO and a flexible schedule
  • Fully remote work within the United States

Resumen

Buscamos a un Cloud Integration Engineer con experiencia demostrada en despliegue e integración de tecnologías cloud open source Este rol es clave para asegurar la implementación exitosa de nuestras soluciones de infraestructura en ambientes de misión crítica, trabajando directamente con los principales operadores de telecomunicaciones en América Latina.

En este cargo tu misión será desarrollar todas las tareas necesarias, para la correcta implementación e integración de los productos comercializados por Whitestack. Estas tareas incluyen despliegue de productos Whitestack e integración de los mismos con sistemas externos sobre plataformas como Kubernetes y Openstack asegurando su correcto funcionamiento y compatibilidad con los sistemas externos del cliente.

Este rol está disponible para trabajo remoto desde las siguientes ubicaciones: México, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Uruguay y Perú.

Responsabilidades

  • Identificar y solicitar al cliente los requerimientos para el despliegue de los productos de manera oportuna.

  • Realizar testing de componentes en ambientes virtualizados.

  • Realizar pruebas de validación y troubleshooting post-despliegue.

  • Colaborar en flujos de trabajo tipo GitOps, con enfoque en automatización y buenas prácticas de ingeniería.

Requerimientos

Experiencia

Formación

Conocimientos Específicos / Requisitos Técnicos

    • Comandos básicos, manipulación de archivos, red, etc.

    • Sabe aplicar configuraciones de red

    • Experiencia con Shell scripting (Bash).

  • Kubernetes Avanzado 25%

    • Conoce el ciclo de vida de un pod, distingue entre los diferentes tipos de despliegues, sabe usar claims, volúmenes y storage classes, ha debugeado pods, sabe qué son probes, init-containers, ha desplegado con yaml y con Helm, etc.

  • Networking Intermedio 20%

    • (Interfaces/VLAN, IPTables, enrutamiento, bonding, etc)

  • Virtualización Avanzado 10%

    • Experiencia con KVM, OpenStack, o otros herramientas de virtualización

  • Ansible Avanzado 5%

    • Sabe ejecutar playbooks mediante roles, conoce la típica estructura de un rol, sabe usar inventario y diferentes variables

  • Docker Intermedio 5%

    • Conoce el ciclo de vida, uso de volúmenes, diferentes comandos para ejecutar, attachear, ver logs, etc.

  • Terraform Intermedio 5%

    • Ha desplegado IAC, sabe troubleshootear

Inglés: Intermedio (para leer/escribir documentación técnica)

Requisitos profesionales

  • Autonomía (para lograr los mejores resultados)

  • Adherencia a estándares de clase mundial

  • Apertura de aprender nuevas tecnologías

Requisitos Deseables

  • Certificaciones en Kubernetes

  • Certificaciones y/o experiencia en Openstack

  • Experiencia generando documentación técnica

  • Experiencia configurando equipos de red

  • Otros deseables:

  • DevOps

Whitestackes una empresa líder en Latinoamérica especializada en soluciones en la nube e infraestructura digital híper-escalable. Trabajamos con tecnología de código abierto y los más altos estándares de la industria para impulsar la transformación digital en toda la región. BIM/VDC Project Manager

Remote, Full-Time (up to 25% travel) Exempt Reports to: Director of VDC / Operations

About Ayoroa Simmons

Ayoroa Simmons is one of the most trusted reality capture and BIM firms in the Eastern United States, with a client roster that includes some of the largest AEC organizations in the country and the U.S. Department of Defense. For over a decade, we have delivered surveying, laser scanning, Scan to BIM, and BIM/VDC services as a fully integrated offering, giving project teams the accurate existing-conditions data they need to design, build, and manage with confidence.

With a 35+ person team and a track record on complex institutional, healthcare, and infrastructure projects, we bring the scale and precision standards that this work demands. Ayoroa Simmons is an established firm at a growth inflection point, and we're building toward the clients who need us most.

Position summary

Ayoroa Simmons is seeking a BIM/VDC Project Manager to lead model-based coordination and digital delivery across complex AEC projects, while supporting client relationships, strategic pursuits, and firm growth. The ideal candidate brings technical credibility and client-facing leadership, managing BIM/VDC execution, advising project teams, and representing the firm in pursuits.

This is a fully remote role with up to 25% travel expected.

Key responsibilities

BIM/VDC project leadership

  • Align BIM/VDC scope, schedule, budget, and staffing with overall project goals.
  • Lead BIM/VDC execution from pursuit and preconstruction through construction and closeout, including BIM Execution Plans, model coordination strategies, and deliverable schedules.
  • Serve as primary BIM/VDC point of contact for owners, design teams, contractors, trade partners, and internal staff.
  • Establish QA/QC protocols for models, documentation, and coordination milestones; identify risks early and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Support and guide Project Leads in running multidisciplinary coordination meetings, clash detection workflows, constructability reviews, and issue resolution, staying actively engaged while empowering Project Leads to own day-to-day meeting leadership.

Client relationships & pursuits

  • Build and maintain relationships with clients, contractors, design partners, and industry stakeholders; identify opportunities for new work, expanded services, and follow-on assignments.
  • Support go/no-go decisions, capture planning, proposal development, and win strategy for BIM/VDC-related opportunities.
  • Participate in client meetings, shortlist presentations, and pursuit strategy sessions; contribute technical content and value propositions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor, translating client goals into BIM/VDC scopes, work plans, and deliverables.
  • Manage assigned consultants and trade partners, including coordination of their scope, project invoicing, and billing.
  • Represent Ayoroa Simmons at industry events and conferences; partner with principals and marketing to align VDC capabilities with firm growth.

Technology, standards & process improvement

  • Develop and maintain BIM/VDC standards, templates, workflows, and best practices across projects and offices.
  • Evaluate and select BIM/VDC software, including Autodesk, Bluebeam, and comparable platforms, to advance leading industry workflows and production.
  • Drive innovation in Revit and coordination workflows, extending the firm's established leadership in scanning and reality capture; implement automation, dashboards, and emerging technologies (4D scheduling, digital twins, reality capture, prefabrication).
  • Train and mentor project teams on coordination processes, tools, and digital delivery expectations.

Team leadership & mentorship

  • Supervise, mentor, and develop BIM/VDC coordinators, specialists, and modelers.
  • Provide technical guidance to project managers, discipline leads, and field teams.
  • Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment; promote knowledge sharing across projects and markets.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field; equivalent experience welcomed.
  • 8+ years in BIM, VDC, construction technology, or digital project delivery, including 3+ years leading BIM/VDC on complex AEC projects.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting client relationships, pursuits, proposals, or presentations.
  • Advanced proficiency with Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Forma, and similar platforms.
  • Experience developing BIM Execution Plans, clash detection workflows, and model standards.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills; ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel to project sites (up to 25%)

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, commercial, higher education, infrastructure, or mission-critical sectors.
  • Established client or industry network in the Eastern U.S. AEC market.
  • Experience with 4D/5D integration, digital twins, laser scanning, reality capture, or prefabrication workflows.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, automation, scripting, or model-based analytics.
  • Experience with project scheduling (Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project).
  • Professional certifications: CM-BIM, PMP, DBIA, LEED AP, or Autodesk certification.

Key competencies

BIM/VDC technical leadership · Client relationship management · Project delivery accountability · Constructability judgment · Pursuit & proposal support · Team mentorship · Process improvement · Data-driven decision-making

Success measures

  • On-time delivery of BIM/VDC scope, milestones, and model standards.
  • Reduction in coordination issues, RFIs, rework, and field conflicts.
  • Client satisfaction, repeat work, and new opportunities identified or supported.
  • Proposal shortlist and win contributions; revenue or backlog influenced.
  • Adoption of improved VDC workflows and development of BIM/VDC team members.

Compensation & benefits

  • Performance-based bonus tied to business development outcomes
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match
  • 3 weeks PTO (120 hours), pro-rated in year one; paid holidays

About First Bus:

Are you ready to advance your career with one of the UK's leading bus operators? Join a forward-thinking company that embraces cutting-edge bus technology, from innovative mobile apps to environmentally friendly vehicles. We are passionate about delivering passenger journeys that are sustainable, comfortable, and efficient. We are at the forefront of innovation in the industry, connecting communities and shaping the future of public transport.

Location: UK based - fully remote with travel as required

Contract: Permanent, full-time

As our new Funding & Schemes Manager, you'll play a critical role in maximising revenue opportunities and ensuring our funding and reimbursement arrangements deliver long-term value for the business.


This role sits within our Commercial Delivery function, forming part of the wider Commercial team. Working closely with colleagues across Commercial, Revenue, Finance, Network Planning and Data & Analytics, you'll provide the insight and assurance needed to maximise the value of funding and revenue-support schemes across our business.

This is a unique opportunity for a commercially minded analyst who thrives on turning complex data into meaningful business insight. You'll lead the modelling, forecasting and assurance of a diverse portfolio of funding streams, encompassing government funding schemes, multi-operator arrangements and wider partnership-based revenue stream helping to shape strategic decisions at both regional and national level.

What You'll Be Doing

Drive Commercial Analysis & Financial Modelling

  • Develop and maintain sophisticated forecasting and financial models across a range of funding and reimbursement schemes.
  • Assess the financial viability, risks and opportunities associated with current and future funding arrangements.
  • Conduct scenario and sensitivity analysis to evaluate the impact of changes in fares, passenger demand, funding methodologies and operational factors.
  • Provide robust budgeting and forecasting inputs, ensuring a clear understanding of funding entitlement and expected revenue streams.
  • Produce insightful reporting, dashboards and management information that support effective decision-making.
  • Translate complex technical analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Lead Funding Data, Reporting & Assurance

  • Act as the lead contact for funding and schemes-related data submissions to local authorities, combined authorities and government partners.
  • Validate and assure commercial, operational and financial data used in funding claims and reporting.
  • Coordinate information from multiple internal teams including Commercial, Revenue, Finance, Network Planning and Data & Analytics.
  • Maintain clear audit trails and governance processes to ensure the accuracy, consistency and integrity of externally reported information.
  • Identify, investigate and resolve data quality issues and reporting anomalies.

Influence Strategy & Business Performance

  • Support the development and delivery of First Bus' funding and schemes strategy.
  • Build a national view of funding performance, opportunities, risks and dependencies.
  • Provide expert commercial guidance to Regional Commercial Leads and wider business stakeholders.
  • Help ensure concessionary, supported travel and multi-operator schemes deliver sustainable and appropriate levels of reimbursement.
  • Monitor policy developments and market changes that could impact funding arrangements and future revenue opportunities.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a commercially focused analyst with the ability to combine strong technical skills with strategic thinking.

You'll ideally have:

  • Advanced financial modelling and analytical capabilities.
  • Experience in forecasting, scenario modelling and commercial performance analysis.
  • Strong knowledge of revenue forecasting, demand analysis or elasticity modelling.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulae, Pivot Tables, Power Query and model development.
  • Experience working with large datasets and translating findings into practical business recommendations.
  • Knowledge of public-sector funding arrangements, concessions, contracts or tendered services.
  • Experience working with local authorities, transport authorities or other public-sector stakeholders.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • A strong understanding of commercial drivers, profitability and revenue performance.
  • Outstanding attention to detail with the ability to deliver accurate, auditable outputs.
  • The confidence to communicate complex analysis clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Rewards


Your health is important to us which is why we offer Simply Health & Smart Health for you and your dependents at no cost to you! This offering includes cash back benefits across optical & dental as well as virtual GP appointments, mental health support and nutrition and fitness advise. Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is on a mission to revolutionize precision medicine for the brain. We are the leading at-home EEG platform supporting clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our FDA 510(k)-cleared Waveband EEG headband and AI algorithms enable quantitative biomarker discovery and implementation. Beacon’s Clinico-EEG database contains EEG data from nearly 100,000 patients, and our cloud-native analytics platform powers large-scale RWD/RWE retrospective and predictive studies. Beacon Biosignals is changing the way that patients are treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Senior Algorithm and Machine Learning engineer!

As part of Beacon's analytics and machine learning domain, you'll work alongside fellow data scientists, neuroscientists, engineers, and clinicians to scope, build, deploy, and maintain the machine and deep learning models that analyze brain and biosignal data for advancing sleep, neurological, and psychiatric therapy development.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those who lead by example. As such, we're always seeking out new contributors whose work demonstrates innate curiosity, a bias toward simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and—most of all—a deep empathy toward colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

Beacon's work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs in Boston, New York City and Paris.

What success looks like

  • Participate in and lead the entire biosignal-based algorithm development lifecycle for medical devices including specifications and requirements gathering, data curation and labeling, development, failure-analysis, production, maintenance, and documentation.
  • Select, implement, and develop the most appropriate method for each problem, knowing when to apply deep learning techniques and when other methods are more effective.
  • Enhance our internal deep learning and machine learning tools to boost team efficiency, introduce new model architectures and algorithmic techniques, and refine the codebase to encourage reusability where needed to enable rapid experimentation.
  • Spread and improve our best practices to ensure algorithm implementations are user-friendly, well-documented, and thoroughly tested, including unit tests, comprehensive documentation, CI, and non-regression testing.
  • Present results to key stakeholders and assist them in utilizing algorithms for client engagement.
  • Support the client-facing projects to understand and shape the impact Beacon algorithms have for our customers, both for existing deployed algorithms, and future algorithm development.

What you will bring

  • You have more than 5 years of industry experience in machine learning and deep learning, particularly in health sciences or other regulated fields, with a proven track record of bringing algorithms into production.
  • You are experienced with digital signal processing (DSP) and statistics and care about using the right tool for the job, which in many cases might not be machine learning or deep learning.
  • You are proficient in using PyTorch (preferred) or other deep learning frameworks for training, developing, and deploying deep learning models.
  • You are proficient with latest Deep Learning advances (Transformer/ViT, large scale modeling, large model training, ...)
  • You follow and spread best practices in software and ML engineering, including testing, version control, code reviews, documentation, Dockerization, CI/CD, and experiment tracking.
  • You are experienced with biosignals, medical imaging data, or large time-series datasets, or are enthusiastic about learning more in the domain.
  • You thrive in a team environment, recognizing that collaboration, open communication, and continuous feedback are essential for collective success.
  • You are able to distill, discuss, and present complex technical topics in a way that is appropriate for the audience at hand, both internally and externally.
  • You are excited to participate in the entire algorithm development lifecycle, which spans scoping, data wrangling, algorithm development/experimentation, formal validation, quality/regulatory documentation, production deployment, and working with clients who might benefit from these algorithms.

The salary range is $170,000-$220,000. The base salary range for this role is determined based on past experience, specific skills and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.

jobs.excerpt: MCM helps law enforcement agencies know that every officer and every unit is ready for duty.
jobs.description:
MCM helps law enforcement agencies know that every officer and every unit is ready for duty.

platform tracks the equipment, vehicles, evidence, and records agencies depend on, so command

staff can see that the agency and each individual officer are operationally ready. The result is

risk in the field and an agency that is always audit-read

Our customers trust us with sensitive public safety data. We build to government security standards,

including GovRAMP and the CJIS Security Policy, and that work shapes our architecture, our vendor

decisions, and how we sell.

The Role

The Security and Compliance Lead owns how MCM proves it is secure: our controls, the evidence behind them, and the government frameworks our customers require. Your job is to keep our programs audit-ready, extend our SOC 2 program to federal frameworks, and prove it with evidence an assessor accepts.

Security is shared across our Technology team. The platform team builds and runs our infrastructure, identity, and detection. You set the requirements, verify the outcomes, and lead compliance, security operations, and access governance across that work. This is a hands-on role, with room to grow into people leadership as the function grows.

  • Reports to: Chief Technology Officer
  • Direct reports: None at the start
  • Location: Remote
  • Travel: Light, for occasional team, customer, or assessor meetings

What You'll Do

Earn and keep government authorization

  • Lead government cloud authorization (GovRAMP and similar programs) end to end
    • Gap assessment and remediation plan
    • Sponsoring agency
    • Selecting and supporting the independent assessor (3PAO)
    • Submission
  • Keep one policy set for SOC 2 and GovRAMP, mapped to NIST 800-53
  • Own SOC 2 Type II on a continuous basis
  • Lead CJIS Security Policy work, including CJIS security awareness training and personnel screening
  • Manage the policy lifecycle, including review cadence, staff acceptance, and exception handling
  • Own control monitoring and evidence, and support sales and product on customer security reviews

Run security operations

  • Own the detection and response program, including severity model, escalation paths, runbooks, and coverage
  • Own detection partner relationships and hold partners to their commitments
  • Own log review and monitoring requirements, and the tooling decisions behind them
  • Own remediation SLAs by severity and hold engineering to them
  • Run vulnerability management, including scanning cadence, findings triage, and follow through with engineering
  • Own recovery objectives with the platform team, and run the tabletop and recovery tests that keep them current

Govern access, vendors, and AI

  • Run periodic access reviews and act on the results
  • Run joiner, mover, and leaver processes, including removal of privileged access within policy windows
  • Test emergency access procedures on schedule and keep the evidence
  • Maintain the vendor and subprocessor inventory and run the recurring review
  • Set security and governance requirements for AI tools and AI-enabled features, including data handling, access, and vendor review
  • Build AI-driven tools that take manual work out of security and compliance, such as evidence collection, control testing, and questionnaire responses
  • Run the security awareness program

Support internal IT (secondary)

  • Own device standards, endpoint enrollment, SSO and SCIM coverage, credential recovery, and onboarding and offboarding
  • Keep internal IT automation first, with any outside partner under the same access controls as staff
  • Provide day to day support, with the platform team covering escalation
  • Manage hardware logistics, including procurement, provisioning, retrieval, and secure disposal

What You Bring

  • 7+ years in security or compliance, with at least 3 years owning a compliance program through audits
  • Government cloud authorization taken through to a decision (GovRAMP, StateRAMP, TX-RAMP, or FedRAMP), including 3PAO work; consulting counts
  • Working fluency in NIST 800-53 and the CJIS Security Policy
  • SOC 2 Type II ownership through at least one full audit cycle
  • Experience tailoring a policy library to a baseline and writing assessor-ready policy
  • Experience setting severity models, remediation SLAs, recovery objectives, and review cadences
  • Ownership of a compliance automation platform (such as Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe), including control configuration and evidence automation
  • Working knowledge of the Microsoft identity and security stack, enough to check a configuration directly
  • Comfort reading scripts, pipeline definitions, and query output to confirm what evidence proves
  • Uses AI tools in daily work (drafting policy, mapping controls, reviewing evidence), with the judgment to check the output
  • Has built AI-driven tools or automations that improve a security or compliance process
  • Hands-on practitioner who does the work directly, not only oversees it
  • Sound judgment on material risk, and willingness to defend it with the CTO

Nice to Have

  • Experience securing AI systems, including risks such as prompt injection and data leakage, and frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001
  • Experience building or maturing a security program at a growing company
  • Experience defending automated evidence when an assessor questioned it
  • Experience with public safety, state, or local government customers
  • A relevant certification such as CISSP, CISA, CCSP, or CGRC
  • People leadership experience, or a clear interest in growing into it

jobs.title: Principal Medical Economics & Actuary, Eviti | Remote | NantIQ
jobs.excerpt: NantIQ is seeking an experienced Principal Medical Economics & Actuary to join the Eviti team.
jobs.description:
NantIQ is seeking an experienced Principal Medical Economics & Actuary to join the Eviti team. In this strategic role, you will establish and validate the quantitative foundation behind Eviti's oncology utilization management solutions. You will lead the development of actuarially sound savings methodologies, pricing models, and financial risk analyses that demonstrate the value of evidence-based oncology care management to health plans. As the organization's actuarial and medical economics leader, you will work closely with Product Management, Clinical Operations, Data Science, Finance, and Account Management to ensure Eviti's savings methodologies are rigorous, transparent, and defensible. You will also serve as the trusted quantitative voice in client engagements, presenting directly to health plan actuaries, medical directors, and executive stakeholders while helping shape product strategy, pricing, and market positioning. This role is intentionally independent of Sales and Account Management. You will own Eviti's savings methodology and results, report through the Vice President, Eviti rather than commercial leadership, and hold final sign-off on any savings estimate, performance guarantee, or value claim before it is shared with a client or used in market-facing materials. The goal is savings figures that are credible and reproducible. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in healthcare actuarial science or medical economics within a payer, healthcare technology, or managed care environment, with a proven track record of building and validating medical cost savings methodologies, developing pricing and risk models, and translating complex quantitative concepts into clear, client-ready narratives. Experience with oncology utilization management, specialty care, or oncology payment models is highly desirable. This position offers the flexibility to work remotely within the United States and requires occasional travel for key client meetings.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Develop, document, validate, and continuously refine Eviti's methodology for measuring authorization-driven medical cost savings, including avoided low-value therapies, biosimilar and preferred product redirection, site-of-care optimization, dose and regimen optimization, imaging management, and denial or redirect impact. Define and consistently report both gross and net savings. Net savings should account for offsets such as the cost of the approved alternative therapy or site of care, overturned denials and appeals, resubmissions and abandoned requests that return later, and Eviti program fees, so clients see a clear bridge from gross to net and the true return on the program. Design rigorous and defensible methodologies using actuarially accepted approaches such as pre/post analyses, matched controls, trend-adjusted baselines, and sensitivity analyses that align with the Actuarial Standards of Practice, are transparent and auditable, can be reproduced consistently across clients, and withstand payer actuarial review. Produce savings estimates across the full client lifecycle: prospective estimates for prospects and new clients where client claims data is limited or unavailable (using benchmark data, anticipated utilization, and the client's prior authorization and treatment history); projected savings during implementation; and actual realized savings once claims experience emerges. Reconcile estimated to actual results and use the variance to refine the methodology. Lead the actuarial design and validation of pricing methodologies supporting PMPM, shared savings, gain-share, performance guarantees, and other value-based contracting arrangements. Model financial risk associated with client pricing structures and contractual guarantees by evaluating oncology cost trends, utilization variability, regimen mix, emerging therapies, and member population characteristics. As Eviti expands into risk-based arrangements, help design, price, and monitor them, including fees at risk, risk corridors, and partial- or full-risk oncology arrangements, with actual-to-expected experience monitoring, reserving and IBNR, and recommendations on risk limits, stop-loss, and contract terms. Analyze oncology treatment, claims, regimen, and utilization data to identify key cost drivers, emerging trends, and opportunities for improved utilization management. Partner with Clinical Operations and oncology subject matter experts to ensure economic analyses accurately reflect oncology-specific clinical considerations, including NCCN guideline concordance, biosimilar adoption, dose optimization, site-of-care economics, and evolving standards of care. Serve as the primary actuarial and medical economics representative in client meetings, presenting methodologies, validating savings results, responding to actuarial and financial questions, and building credibility with health plan leadership. Partner with Product Management and Data Science to identify platform enhancements that improve the measurement, automation, explainability, and auditability of oncology savings, including opportunities to leverage AI and advanced analytics. Support Sales and Account Management during renewals, RFP responses, client implementations, and executive presentations where financial outcomes and savings validation are key decision drivers. Review and approve all savings estimates, performance guarantees, and value claims before they are used in proposals, renewals, marketing materials, or client reporting, and escalate any methodology disagreement to the General Manager for resolution. Develop market-facing economic evidence supporting Eviti's value proposition, including methodology documentation, white papers, actuarial validation reports, conference presentations, and thought leadership materials. Provide strategic guidance to executive leadership regarding oncology economics, pricing strategy, emerging reimbursement models, and product investment decisions.

Education & Experience Requirements:

Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) or Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA), with Member of the American Academy of Actuaries (MAAA) (although candidates with extensive medical economics experience and demonstrated expertise developing payer savings methodologies will also be considered; in that case, formal actuarial opinions and certifications will be co-signed by a credentialed reviewing actuary) 8+ years of progressive experience in healthcare actuarial science, medical economics, payer analytics, managed care, or healthcare technology. Demonstrated experience developing and validating medical cost savings methodologies within utilization management, prior authorization, medical management, or healthcare claims environments. Experience producing prospective savings estimates with limited or no client claims data, and reconciling estimated savings to actual results over time. Direct experience designing pricing methodologies, including PMPM pricing, shared savings, gain-share arrangements, risk-sharing contracts, performance guarantees, or value-based payment models. Experience analyzing healthcare claims, clinical, and utilization data to evaluate medical cost trends and utilization patterns. Experience presenting complex financial analyses and methodologies to executive leadership, payer clients, actuaries, and clinical stakeholders. Oncology experience, including oncology claims, treatment regimens, specialty pharmacy, or oncology utilization management, is strongly preferred.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Strong working knowledge of actuarial methods for calculating and validating medical cost savings in a utilization management context. Clear understanding of gross versus net savings and the offsets that separate them, and the ability to explain that bridge to clients. Working knowledge of the Actuarial Standards of Practice relevant to savings and pricing work, including data quality, credibility, and actuarial communications. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering across product, clinical, data science, finance, and account management teams. Excellent communication skills, including the ability to translate complex actuarial concepts into clear, client-ready narratives and to present confidently to health plan actuaries, medical directors, and executive stakeholders. Proficiency with claims/clinical data analysis tools such as SQL, SAS, R, or Python.

Additionally beneficial skills:

Direct experience with prior authorization or utilization management platforms, such as Eviti or other oncology UM/decision-support tools. Familiarity with value-based or oncology payment models, such as OCM/EOM or clinical pathways programs. Prior consulting or client-facing advisory experience with health plans. Experience with at-risk or risk-based contracting, including experience monitoring, reserving, and risk mitigation. Experience presenting methodology to external auditors or actuarial review committees.

The salary range for applicable US-based applicants to this position is below. The specific rate will depend on the successful candidate’s qualifications, prior experience as well as geographic location.

$170,000 - $210,000 base salary plus bonus potential.
