jobs.excerpt: Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch.
jobs.description:
Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch. From strategy to technology and everywhere in between, our experts use their unique skills to advance the important missions of education, nonprofit, healthcare, and state and local government clients.

People are at the center of all we do, and that’s why we empower career growth, provide industry-leading benefits packages, encourage a flexible work environment, and foster a culture of inclusion to support the needs of our team. We share a collective passion for our mission and our people. Guided by our seven core values, The Attain Way, our vision is the foundation of our culture—to be and attain the best.

Position Overview

Attain Partners is seeking an experienced, hands-on Integration Lead to lead a team of integration developers specializing in Boomi, MuleSoft, and Workato. This individual will be responsible for integration architecture, technical development, team leadership, and successful delivery of enterprise integration solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with proven delivery leadership and extensive experience integrating enterprise applications with Salesforce. This individual must understand Salesforce beyond its APIs, with the ability to directly access and review Salesforce configuration, analyze object models, understand relationships and lookup fields, and identify integration requirements.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, requiring someone who can design integration architectures, actively develop integrations, troubleshoot technical challenges, and manage project delivery.

This is not a purely managerial or architectural position. The individual must be willing and able to remain hands-on with integration development and Salesforce configuration analysis.

Key Responsibilities

Integration Architecture & Development

  • Lead the architecture, design, development, and implementation of enterprise integrations utilizing Boomi, MuleSoft, and Workato.
  • Actively participate in hands-on integration development, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment.
  • Design scalable, secure, and reusable integration architectures across cloud-based and on-premises applications.
  • Establish integration development standards, best practices, error-handling frameworks, and reusable components.
  • Conduct technical design reviews, code reviews, and performance optimization.
  • Troubleshoot complex integration challenges and provide direct technical support to development teams.
  • Support API-led connectivity, REST/SOAP APIs, batch processing, event-driven integrations, and application-to-application connectivity.

Salesforce Integration & Technical Analysis

  • Lead the architecture, development, and troubleshooting of integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications using Boomi, MuleSoft, and Workato.
  • Demonstrate hands-on experience accessing and reviewing Salesforce configuration to understand the underlying data model, business logic, and integration requirements.
  • Analyze Salesforce standard and custom objects, fields, relationships, lookup fields, reference data, picklist values, and record types.
  • Understand Salesforce data structures, including parent-child relationships, external IDs, required fields, validation rules, and lookup dependencies.
  • Review Salesforce configuration using Setup, Object Manager, Schema Builder, SOQL, and other appropriate administrative or developer tools.
  • Translate Salesforce object models, lookup codes, field mappings, and business rules into integration designs and source-to-target mappings.
  • Identify Salesforce configuration constraints that may impact integrations, including validation rules, automation, duplicate rules, API limits, and data dependencies.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce administrators and developers to resolve integration defects, mapping issues, and data-related configuration challenges.
  • Ensure integration solutions align with Salesforce architecture, data models, and platform best practices.

Technical Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor a team of Boomi, MuleSoft, and Workato integration developers.
  • Provide day-to-day technical direction, development oversight, and hands-on support.
  • Assign development activities, manage resource capacity, and ensure technical deliverables meet project expectations.
  • Remove technical blockers and proactively resolve development challenges.
  • Drive consistency in integration architecture, coding standards, and delivery methodologies across the team.

Project & Delivery Management

  • Own technical delivery of integration projects from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Manage project timelines, technical estimates, resource assignments, and delivery budgets.
  • Monitor development progress, identify delivery risks, and implement corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with project managers, solution architects, and client stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
  • Manage technical scope, change requests, delivery quality, and overall project profitability.
  • Communicate project progress, technical risks, and delivery expectations to internal and external stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on development experience with both Boomi and MuleSoft.
  • Proven experience building and supporting integrations with Salesforce using enterprise iPaaS platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently navigate Salesforce configuration, inspect object models, review lookup relationships, understand picklist values and reference codes, and identify integration dependencies.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce Object Manager, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, custom objects, validation rules, record types, and field-level configuration.
  • Experience translating Salesforce data models and configuration into technical integration requirements, field mappings, and development specifications.
  • Experience architecting and implementing complex enterprise integration solutions using iPaaS platforms.
  • Proven experience leading and managing teams of integration developers.
  • Demonstrated ability to remain hands-on with architecture, development, debugging, and technical problem-solving while leading a team.
  • Experience managing project timelines, budgets, technical estimates, and resource allocation.
  • Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, XML, authentication, data transformations, and integration design patterns.
  • Experience integrating ERP platforms, databases, cloud services, and other enterprise applications.
  • Experience with integration deployment, environment management, CI/CD, and production support.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently make technical decisions, resolve blockers, and take accountability for delivery outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing or leading integrations using Workato.
  • Boomi Professional Developer or MuleSoft Developer certifications.
  • Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Platform Developer certifications.
  • Experience with Salesforce Education Cloud, Nonprofit Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Service Cloud.
  • Experience delivering consulting engagements across multiple clients or concurrent projects.
  • Experience supporting Higher Education, Nonprofit, or Healthcare organizations.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a technical leader who still writes code and understands Salesforce configuration firsthand.

This person should be equally comfortable designing an enterprise integration architecture, opening Boomi or MuleSoft to build and troubleshoot an integration, logging into Salesforce to inspect object relationships and lookup values, leading a team of developers, and managing project delivery against timelines and budgets.

The ideal candidate does not rely exclusively on Salesforce administrators or developers to explain how Salesforce is configured. They must have sufficient Salesforce technical knowledge to independently investigate objects, fields, relationships, reference values, and configuration dependencies to design, build, and troubleshoot integrations effectively.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical ownership, proactive problem-solving, accountability for delivery, and the ability to lead from the front rather than simply delegate technical responsibilities.

Additional Requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with clients
  • Experience supporting sales and business development
  • Position requires flexibility to travel periodically based on business and client needs

Additional Information

Attain Partners values your mental, emotional, and physical health and wellbeing. Our comprehensive benefits package starts on your first day of employment and includes benefits such as:

  • Competitive health, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA accounts, life and disability insurance, fertility and family planning benefits, and employee assistance and discount programs
  • 11 paid federal holidays and flexible unlimited time off (UTO)
  • Generous 401(k) matching with immediate vesting
  • Flexible career paths – our career tracks provide advancement, mobility, and flexibility as you continue to grow with us
  • A healthy environment where we value unique experiences, and care about everything that makes you, you.

Attain Partners is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The individual base salary for this position is unique to each candidate and will be commensurate with experience, education, and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Interested in this position but the compensation isn’t quite right? Let us know your expectations, and we’ll see if we can make it happen based on your qualifications.

$160,000—$180,000 USD

German AI Product Evaluator/ KI-Produkttester / AI Product Evaluator (Deutsch)

The Project

Productive Playhouse is building a talent pool of German speakers for an upcoming project testing and evaluating leading AI chatbots. The objective is to enhance response quality through direct user interaction with the various AI models.

Open to freelancers based outside the U.S.

This is more than one job. Apply once, and we'll keep you in mind for this project — and future ones that need your language skills.

The Details

We’re looking for independent contractor engagement (task-based - project-based).

  • Pay Rate: $20.00 USD per hour

As an AI Evaluator, you'll play a critical role in shaping and improving the next generation of Generative AI. You'll participate in structured, hands-on evaluations by interacting directly with various AI models to assess their capabilities, safety, and helpfulness. Your insights and data will directly inform model development and optimization.

Exact tasks vary by project and will be spelled out in that project's Statement of Work (SOW) before you start. Depending on the role, your work may include:

What We're Looking For

  • Native or expert-level fluency in German, as spoken in Germany.

  • 18 years of age or older
  • Hands-on experience using AI models or large language models
  • Comfortable with both written and voice-based conversation — and good at asking sharp follow-ups
  • Your own smartphone, computer, reliable internet, and comfort with web-based tools
  • Able to pass a language proficiency and technical literacy assessment
  • Responsive communicator — quick replies move you through onboarding faster
  • Able to start within 48 hours

Why PPH?

Your language skills are the whole point — and this project pays for them

Apply once, get contacted directly when a spot opens — no chasing

Work from anywhere, on your own schedule, alongside any other work you do

Clear task specs, no ongoing oversight, no micromanagement

Real project experience with a global data and language services company

Work that actually improves how AI understands your language

About Productive Playhouse

We started by teaching kids through award-winning programming. We grew into a global data and language services company trusted by clients worldwide. But the mission never changed: keep language alive.

Transcription, translation, localization, linguistic analysis, AI evaluation — it all comes back to preserving languages and the cultures they carry.

jobs.description:
About Monte Carlo

Monte Carlo is the agent trust platform that autonomously observes, fixes, and continuously improves agents and the data that powers them — so enterprises can scale trust at the speed of AI. Bayes, our AI teammate, does the work: detecting, triaging, troubleshooting, and fixing issues in AI agents and the data powering them. The result is self-improving agents that get better with every fix instead of drifting. More than 400 enterprises, including Amazon, PepsiCo, CNN, Nasdaq, and JetBlue, rely on Monte Carlo. Learn more at .

The Role

We're hiring an Applied Forward Deployed Engineer (Post-Sales) to own the technical side of every new customer from the moment the deal closes until they're live and getting value. You'll write production code in customers' Snowflake and Databricks environments, integrate Monte Carlo with their real pipelines, and become the technical advisor they call before they escalate. This isn't support and it isn't a CSM role: your metric is whether the customer is live and consuming. It's an early hire into a new function, so you'll help write the FDE playbook, not inherit one. Remote (US), with roughly 25% travel to customers.

What You'll Do

  • Own deployment from day one post-close: monitors, alerts, and integrations configured for the customer's actual environment.
  • Write production-quality Python, SQL, and API integrations tailored to customer pipelines, and clear whatever stands between a signed contract and a fully operational deployment.
  • Drive customers to consumption. You're accountable for active usage and measurable value, not just go-live.
  • Expand adoption beyond the first champion across teams, data assets, and use cases.
  • Feed what you see in the field back to Product and Engineering so it shapes the core product instead of turning into one-off work.
  • Shape the FDE playbook as an early member of the team.

What We're Looking For

  • Data platform depth. 5+ years building on Snowflake, Databricks, or a modern cloud warehouse as the person who designed and built it, not an end user. Production Python and SQL, and comfortable wiring up REST APIs in someone else's environment.
  • Post-sale ownership. You've owned technical outcomes for enterprise customers after the contract: implementation, solutions or forward deployed engineering, technical onboarding. You measure yourself on go-live and adoption.
  • Range with people. You can run a working session with a room of data engineers and brief a VP in the same week.
  • Builder in ambiguity. You've operated without a playbook and built the structure yourself. You create motion instead of waiting for direction.
  • Nice to have. dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, or Looker; data quality, pipeline monitoring, or incident response; a background in data observability or an adjacent category.

This Is Not For You If

  • You want a support queue or a defined playbook to follow.
  • You've only worked pre-sale and never owned what happens after the contract is signed.
  • Your data experience is all internal, with no customer-facing context.
  • You'd rather advise on the stack than write code in it.

Why Monte Carlo

  • We created the data observability category, and we're doing it again with agent trust — you'll build where the market is forming, not where it's settled
  • Series D, $236M raised, backed by Accel, Redpoint, Notable Capital, ICONIQ Growth, and Salesforce Ventures
  • Customers include HubSpot, Fox, Nasdaq, Toast, and Mercado Libre — your work ships to enterprises with real stakes
  • Snowflake Partner of the Year and a verified connector in Anthropic's Claude AI directory
  • Remote-first by design since day one, and recognized as a Best Workplace for it
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and a remote-first environment.

About Terzo

Every company negotiates contracts to save money. But once those contracts are signed, very few organizations know whether they're actually paying what they negotiated.

That's where Terzo comes in.

Terzo is the Enterprise AI platform that connects contracts with real world spend, helping the world's largest organizations instantly identify cost savings, financial risk, and opportunities hiding across billions of dollars in enterprise spend.

Our platform transforms millions of contracts, invoices, purchase orders, and financial records into one intelligent system that continuously answers questions like:

  • Are we paying the prices we negotiated?
  • Where are we overspending?
  • Which suppliers should we renegotiate?
  • What savings opportunities can AI uncover today?

Instead of spending months manually searching through documents and spreadsheets, Terzo gives procurement and finance teams real time answers, and AI agents that help them take action.

Our mission is simple: Help every organization save millions.

We're building enterprise software that's as intuitive as the best consumer products while solving some of the world's largest financial challenges.

At Terzo, we move fast, think big, and obsess over customer outcomes. We hire builders who take ownership, embrace ambitious goals, and want to help define the future of AI powered financial intelligence. If you're excited about building technology that saves organizations millions of dollars and changes how the world's largest companies operate, we'd love to build it with you.

The Opportunity

As a Senior/Staff Product Manager at Terzo, you'll work directly with the enterprise buyers whose problems we exist to solve. You'll sit in conversations where a single contract clause represents tens of millions of dollars of exposure. You'll help a VP of Procurement understand where their spend is leaking, and give a CFO renewal visibility they've never had before.

You'll own product strategy and execution across key areas of the Terzo platform, from AI powered workflows and analytics to the Financial Intelligence Graph and NirvanAI experiences. Internally, you'll work across engineering, design, and go to market. Externally, you'll be in the room with the people whose problems we're here to solve.

What You'll Do

  • Own product strategy and roadmap across key areas of the Terzo platform, including AI powered workflows, analytics, the Financial Intelligence Graph, and NirvanAI.
  • Translate ambiguous enterprise problems into clear, well scoped requirements and make hard prioritization calls.
  • Define how AI capabilities, graph data, and agentic workflows show up as experiences that feel simple and trustworthy to enterprise users.
  • Partner closely with engineering on platform and experience tradeoffs, and with design on user flows and AI native UX.
  • Work directly with customers to validate problems, test solutions, and measure impact.
  • Serve as the product voice in sales and pre sales conversations with CFOs, CPOs, and General Counsels.
  • Define success metrics tied to customer outcomes, adoption, and financial value, and track them after launch.
  • Drive execution end to end, from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Align stakeholders across engineering, sales, customer success, and leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of product management experience in B2B or enterprise SaaS.
  • Experience owning complex enterprise software products end to end, from concept through scaled adoption.
  • Strong technical fluency to work with engineering on system design and AI product tradeoffs, including RAG, agentic architectures, and evals.
  • Experience defining AI product requirements, including evaluation criteria, fallback behaviors, and human in the loop design.
  • Strong UX sensibility for data heavy, workflow driven products where clarity and trust matter.
  • Skilled at customer discovery, including interviews, usability sessions, and feedback loops that shape what gets built.
  • Comfortable building credibility with CFOs, CPOs, and General Counsels in customer and prospect conversations.
  • Experience in CLM, procurement, spend management, or financial operations is a plus.
  • Experience with graph data models, knowledge graphs, or structured commercial data is a plus.
  • Prior work at a high growth startup where you helped build the product function is a plus.

Ways of Working

  • High ownership mentality with accountability for outcomes, not just the roadmap.
  • Clear, structured thinking and written communication. Your specs are precise enough for engineering to start without a meeting to explain them.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity with evolving priorities.
  • Ability to influence without authority across engineering, design, and customer teams.
  • Energized by building in a fast moving environment where you test quickly, learn, and scale what works.

Why Terzo

  • Join a company building a new category in the enterprise financial AI space.
  • Work directly with Fortune 500 buyers on problems that carry real financial weight.
  • High impact role with direct influence on customer outcomes and company direction.
  • Close collaboration with senior engineering, design, and product leaders.
  • Join during a strong growth stage with meaningful equity upside.

Our Core Values

  • Find the Money: Customer results define our success. Prove the value.
  • Raise the Bar. Stay Coachable: Expect excellence. Be willing to change.
  • Own the Outcome: No one is coming. It's up to us.

Benefits & Perks

Job Description:

Title: Director, Software Engineering (Appointments)


Location: Remote Canada (EST or CST). Occasional travel within the United States and Canada.


Why This Role Exists

At Phreesia, we’re transforming the healthcare experience through intelligent technology that helps patients connect with care sooner and helps healthcare practices make the most of their schedules. Our technology supports approximately 180 million patient visits annually.


As Director, Software Engineering (Appointments), you’ll lead the engineering organization behind our Appointments and Appointment Accelerator products and shape their next stage of development. As these products evolve from workflow-driven software toward agentic experiences, you’ll guide the use of AI agents to help patients find, book, and manage appointments and help practices keep their schedules full.


You’ll lead how these agents are designed, evaluated, deployed, and operated in a regulated healthcare environment. You’ll also partner closely with Product Management, Design, QA, Security, and customer-facing teams to turn the roadmap into reliable, scalable software.


This is a leadership role focused on engineering strategy, organizational design, and developing leaders. You’ll stay close enough to the technology to challenge designs, guide architectural decisions, and make sound tradeoffs.

What You’ll Spend Your Time Doing

  • Lead, mentor, and develop engineering managers, architects, and senior individual contributors, setting clear expectations and holding leaders accountable for results.
  • Own the engineering strategy and technical roadmap for Appointments and Appointment Accelerator in partnership with Product Management.
  • Lead the design, deployment, and ongoing operation of production AI agents, including evaluation, guardrails, observability, cost management, and human-in-the-loop escalation.
  • Ensure AI features meet healthcare privacy, security, and compliance requirements, including appropriate handling of protected health information (PHI).
  • Drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted development tools, including team practices for reviewing and validating AI-generated code.
  • Enable predictable, high-quality delivery across multiple teams through planning, prioritization, and cross-team dependency management.
  • Set architectural direction with architects to ensure systems are scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective on AWS.
  • Own the reliability and scalability of background processing, messaging, and electronic medical record and practice management (EMR/PM) integrations.
  • Own production health across the domain, including incident response, escalation management, and ongoing product maintenance.
  • Establish and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, CI/CD, and technical documentation.
  • Plan and manage headcount, hiring, and budgets, including contractors and vendors, while building a strong, inclusive hiring pipeline.
  • Build team structures and career paths that support growth for managers, architects, and senior individual contributors.
  • Use delivery, quality, and operational metrics to guide investment, surface risks, and communicate progress against product and engineering goals.
  • Communicate engineering strategy, investment needs, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executive stakeholders.
  • Set goals and objectives with team members, provide ongoing feedback, and lead performance management.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You don’t need to check every box — but this role will feel energizing if you have:

  • A track record of delivering complex, customer-facing SaaS products at scale with strong operational outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success developing engineering managers, architects, and senior individual contributors.
  • Experience owning technical strategy and roadmaps in partnership with Product Management.
  • Experience managing budgets, headcount plans, contractors, and vendors.
  • Experience building, deploying, and maintaining production AI agents, either hands-on or by leading the teams responsible.
  • Experience across the full agent lifecycle, including tool and API integration, prompt and context management, evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Experience leading adoption of AI-assisted development tools and establishing practices for validating AI-generated code.
  • Experience with CI/CD, cloud-native architecture, and modern quality engineering practices.
  • The ability to explain engineering strategy and tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership and build alignment across functions.
  • A pragmatic, self-motivated leadership style and comfort working with highly distributed teams.
  • Experience with background job processing, message-based architectures, idempotency, and concurrency — preferred.
  • Experience in healthcare technology, scheduling, patient access, or EMR/PM integrations using FHIR or HL7 — a plus.
  • Experience with SMS or patient communication platforms and messaging compliance, such as TCPA — a plus.
  • 2+ years of experience applying AI agents to scheduling, conversational, or patient-facing workflows — a plus.
  • An advanced degree in a related discipline — a plus.

We Do Have A Few Requirements To Check

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • 12+ years of software engineering experience building and supporting highly distributed applications, including significant hands-on experience earlier in your career.
  • 5+ years of experience leading engineering managers and multi-team organizations.
  • Familiarity with the following technologies; hands-on depth is not required for every item:
    • Languages & Frameworks: Ruby on Rails, C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, JavaScript, React, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks.
    • AI & Agents: LLM APIs and platforms, agent frameworks and orchestration, tool calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, evaluation, and AI observability tooling.
    • AI-Assisted Engineering: Agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, MCP servers, custom skills, and agent workflows.
    • Background Processing & Messaging: Sidekiq, Redis, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, Kinesis, and NServiceBus.
    • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch.
    • Integration: RESTful APIs, OAuth2, and EMR/PM integrations using FHIR and HL7.
    • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, including EKS, SQS, and Kinesis; Docker; Kubernetes; Helm; Argo CD; and Terraform.
    • CI/CD & Testing: GitLab CI/CD, RSpec, NUnit, and automated test frameworks.
    • Observability: New Relic, Rollbar, Grafana, and Prometheus.

Where You’ll Work

This is a remote position open to candidates located in Canada (EST or CST). You’ll lead highly distributed engineering teams and collaborate closely with Product Management, Design, QA, Security, and customer-facing teams. Occasional travel within the United States and Canada is required.


Why Phreesia

Phreesia is on a mission to make healthcare more human, connected, and efficient. Our SaaS platform powers digital check-in and engagement for healthcare organizations nationwide—helping patients feel informed and providers work smarter.


Compensation & Rewards

Total Cash Compensation:

  • Total Cash Compensation for Canada-based employees range from $240k -$280k inclusive of base salary and variable incentive and is dependent on qualifications.
  • A comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your whole life — not just your work.

We’re proud to be:

  • A five-time Modern Healthcare Best Places to Work winner.
  • Recognized on the Bloomberg Gender Equality Index.
  • Deeply committed to inclusion, growth, and employee experience

The responsibilities described above are not a comprehensive list. Additional tasks may be assigned, and Phreesia reserves the right to change the scope of the role as business needs evolve.

Disclosure: This posting is to fill an existing vacancy.

Who We Are:

At Phreesia, we’re looking for smart and passionate people to help drive our mission of creating a better, more engaging healthcare experience. We’re committed to helping healthcare organizations succeed in an ever-evolving landscape by transforming the way healthcare is delivered. Our SaaS platform digitizes appointment check-in and offers tools to engage patients, improve efficiency, optimize staffing, and enhance clinical care.

Phreesia cares about our employees by providing a diverse and dynamic work environment. We’re a five-time winner of Modern Healthcare Magazine’s Best Places to Work in Healthcare award and we’ve been recognized on the Bloomberg Gender Equality Index. We are dedicated to continuously improving our employee experience by launching new programs and initiatives. If you thrive in a culture of recognition, value inclusivity, professional development, and growth opportunities, Phreesia could be a great fit!

Top-rated Employee Benefits:

  • Remote First: 100% Remote work + home office expense reimbursements+ monthly reimbursement for cell phone, internet and wellness.

  • Top of market rewards: Competitive compensation

  • Take time when you need time: Flexible PTO + company holidays

  • Top class healthcare benefits: Variety of healthcare benefits for you and your family (and your pets!) starting day one

  • Care about your families: Generous top-up for parental leave benefits

  • Support personal development: Continuing education and professional certification reimbursement

  • Connecting in person: Various offsite events and activities for team to connect and meet in person, to support team building and engagement.

  • Giveback to community: Local in-person volunteer events, and give back programs to our communities.

  • Recognition and perks: We have a company wide recognition tool (Phireworks) to celebrate milestones, recognize achievements and strengthen your bond with your teams. You can accumulate points and redeem them for a wide catalogue of items!

  • Diversity and inclusive environment: At Phreesia, all employees are encouraged to bring their authentic self to work, feel supported and perform at their best. We have a variety of Employee Resources Groups (ERGs) which bring together individuals from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and seek to foster a sense of shared community and empowerment for employees who share a common social identity, such as gender, race, ethnicity, and sexual orientation.

  • Opportunity to join an Employee Resource Group. Learn more here:

We strive to provide a diverse and inclusive environment and are an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.excerpt: The Director, Global Procurement is responsible for ATL’s global sourcing strategy, supplier performance, commercial outcomes, and supply-base risk management.
jobs.description:
The Director, Global Procurement is responsible for ATL’s global sourcing strategy, supplier performance, commercial outcomes, and supply-base risk management.


This leader develops and executes global category and supplier strategies that provide ATL with competitive cost, quality, delivery, capacity, innovation, and supply continuity. The role is accountable for strategic sourcing, negotiations, supplier selection, commercial agreements, cost reduction, supplier performance, and supply-base risk.


The Director will build a disciplined global procurement organization that leverages ATL’s worldwide spend while maintaining the supplier flexibility and responsiveness required by ATL’s manufacturing operations and customers.

As a peer member of ATL’s Supply Chain leadership structure, the Director partners closely with Global Planning/SIOP, Trade Compliance/Logistics, Operations, Quality, Engineering, Finance, Sales and site/value-stream teams.


Key Responsibilities

Global Procurement Strategy

  • Develop and execute ATL’s global procurement and strategic sourcing strategy.
  • Establish category and commodity strategies based on business requirements, spend, market conditions, supplier capabilities, and risk.
  • Leverage ATL’s global purchasing scale while addressing regional and site-specific supply requirements.
  • Develop strategic roadmaps for major spend categories and critical suppliers.
  • Identify opportunities for supplier consolidation, localization, dual sourcing, and supply-base optimization.

Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Selection

  • Establish disciplined supplier selection and sourcing processes.
  • Partner with Engineering, Quality, Operations, and Planning to establish sourcing requirements and evaluate supplier capabilities.
  • Lead commercial aspects of new supplier qualification and new-product sourcing.
  • Establish appropriate competitive bidding, supplier risk mitigation, benchmarking, and sourcing practices.
  • Ensure sourcing decisions appropriately balance cost, quality, delivery, capacity, technology, and risk.

Commercial Management & Cost

  • Lead supplier negotiations and establish commercially competitive agreements.
  • Own purchasing terms, pricing, payment terms, contractual protections, MOQ, lead-time commitments, cancellation provisions, and related commercial conditions.
  • Provide governance for supplier price increases, tariff pass-throughs and other commercial changes.
  • Develop and execute global cost-reduction strategies.
  • Own procurement performance related to PPV, negotiated savings, and cost avoidance.
  • Monitor commodity, market, and supplier cost trends and proactively address risks and opportunities.
  • Partner with Finance to establish credible sourcing savings methodologies and reporting.

Supplier Performance & Development

  • Establish a global supplier-performance management framework.
  • Maintain executive relationships with strategic and critical suppliers.
  • Lead commercial escalation when supplier performance jeopardizes ATL’s business requirements.
  • Partner with Quality, Operations and Engineering on supplier corrective actions and supplier-development initiatives.
  • Conduct regular strategic supplier business reviews covering quality, delivery, cost, capacity, service, and risk.
  • Hold suppliers accountable for commitments and drive sustainable performance improvement.

Supply-Base Risk & Continuity

  • Establish processes to identify, assess, and mitigate supplier and supply-base risks.
  • Develop strategies for single-source materials, capacity constraints, geographic concentration, supplier financial risk, and other continuity exposures.
  • Lead dual/multiple-source strategies for critical components where appropriate.
  • Secure supplier capacity and recovery commitments when supply constraints arise.
  • Partner with Supply Chain Planning to translate identified constraints into effective recovery and mitigation plans.
  • Maintain appropriate visibility to critical-tier and geographically concentrated supply risks.

Governance & Procurement Excellence

  • Establish global procurement policies, processes, controls, and approval authorities.
  • Increase visibility to global spend, supplier concentration, contractual coverage, and sourcing opportunities.
  • Build disciplined supplier segmentation and category-management practices.
  • Drive greater use of data, market intelligence, and analytics in sourcing decisions.
  • Establish standardized procurement KPIs and operating reviews.
  • Ensure procurement practices support ATL’s quality, compliance, ethical sourcing, and business requirements.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Lead, develop, and strengthen ATL’s global procurement organization.
  • Build procurement and negotiation capabilities across the organization.
  • Partner closely with Supply Chain Planning while maintaining clear separation between planning requirements and procurement execution.
  • Work collaboratively with Operations, Quality, Engineering, Finance, Commercial, and site leadership.
  • Serve as the senior procurement voice in strategic business, investment, sourcing, and supplier decisions.

Key Performance Indicators

  • PPV / realized cost savings
  • Cost-reduction pipeline
  • Supplier OTIF
  • Supplier quality performance
  • Supplier capacity and recovery performance
  • Contract coverage
  • Payment-term improvement
  • Supplier concentration and supply risk
  • Dual-source coverage for critical materials
  • Strategic supplier performance
  • Supplier-development outcomes
  • Freight Costs

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations, Finance, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Typically 10+ years of progressive procurement, strategic sourcing, or supply-chain experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
  • Experience leading procurement across multiple manufacturing locations and geographies.
  • Demonstrated experience developing category strategies, negotiating complex supplier agreements, and delivering measurable cost improvements.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing supply chains, supplier economics, sourcing strategy, and supply risk.
  • Experience managing strategic suppliers and leading supplier-performance improvement.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen.
  • Experience with ERP, sourcing, spend-analytics, and procurement systems.
  • Ability to influence across functions, sites, regions, and leadership levels.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, analytical, and change-management capabilities.

What's in it for you:

  • Competitive salary
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and HSA plans.
  • Life, AD&D, STD, LTD plans to help protect you and your loved ones.
  • Generous 401k plan with Employer Match.
  • Paid Holidays, PTO, and other leave programs to support your time off needs.

What you should know about us:

We believe there is a better way to bring medical devices to market. We use an engineer-to-engineer approach to develop custom interconnect solutions for medical devices that improve the quality of one's life'. Join us in our mission to be the leading provider of custom engineered solutions for top medical device manufacturers. ATL has operations in China, Costa Rica, Taiwan, United Kingdom and USA, plus remote staff in strategic global locations ... and we're growing!

Our Values:

Honesty: We are truthful, transparent, and fair, communicating openly and honestly; maintaining integrity by all standards

Excellence: ATL's excellence originates from our customer centric approach to business. We commit to consistently delivering superior quality products, services and results to exceed expectations

Accountability: We accept responsibility for our actions and hold each other accountable to create a collaborative environment

Respect: We approach our work with humility, recognizing the value each person brings regardless of their views and/or opinions.

Teamwork: Teamwork is essential to creating an innovative environment. Individuals with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives strengthen and improve ATL.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

We're looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to lead customer acquisition for the Property Care portfolio.

You'll own our growth engine—from acquisition strategy and media investment to forecasting, experimentation, and performance optimization. Your job is simple to describe but challenging to execute: help Property Care acquire more customers, more efficiently, while building a growth engine that scales.

You'll work across Paid Media, SEO, Analytics, Lifecycle, and Product Marketing to bring one cohesive growth strategy to life. You'll spend as much time thinking about where we should invest next quarter as you will digging into funnel performance, reviewing experiments, and solving growth challenges with the team.

This role is ideal for someone who is driven by owning outcomes, thrives in a data-rich environment, and wants to have a meaningful impact on the direction of a growing SaaS business.

We're looking for someone who has helped to build growth engines—not someone who has simply managed marketing programs.

Growth Strategy

  • Own the growth marketing strategy and integrated campaign roadmap for EverPro's Property Care portfolio.
  • Develop quarterly growth plans that drive qualified demand, pipeline creation, and revenue growth across three distinct markets and buyer segments.

Demand Generation & Conversion

  • Build and execute a continuous experimentation roadmap across acquisition channels, targeting, messaging, landing pages, and conversion.

  • Proactively investigate underperforming initiatives, challenge assumptions, and identify practical ways to improve results.

Measurement & Forecasting

  • Own growth marketing performance reporting, forecasting, and progress against MQL, pipeline, and revenue targets.
  • Monitor acquisition efficiency, lead quality, funnel conversion, and pipeline contribution to identify trends and opportunities.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations and Analytics to improve attribution, data accuracy, and visibility into marketing's revenue impact.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead integrated campaign execution across Paid Media, Web, SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Sales, and Marketing Operations.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and shared accountability for campaign performance and business outcomes.
  • Independently drive initiatives from strategy through execution, proactively resolving obstacles and maintaining momentum.

Executive Communication

  • Present growth performance, forecasts, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Translate complex performance data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Bring a proactive, data-informed perspective to business reviews, planning, and investment decisions.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:


  • 10+ years of experience B2B SaaS growth or demand generation experience, with a proven track record of delivering measurable pipeline and revenue results, not simply managing campaigns.
  • Strong analytical, forecasting, and experimentation skills, with deep understanding of multichannel acquisition, funnel conversion, attribution, and marketing ROI.

Preferred

The role

As our Security Engineer, you will find and fix security risks before attackers do, across our AWS infrastructure, our PHP application, and our growing fleet of AI agents. You will look ahead to emerging threats, especially those unique to LLMs and autonomous agents, and build defenses before they are needed.
This is a hands-on, collaborative role. You will work directly with our development and AI teams, helping them understand issues, prioritize fixes, and ship secure code. We want someone who teaches and enables, not someone who only files tickets.

What you'll do

Application security
  • Review PHP code and architecture for vulnerabilities such as injection, broken authentication, insecure deserialization, and access-control flaws.
  • Run and tune SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning (e.g., Composer packages) in our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Lead threat modeling for new features and work with developers to fix findings, with clear guidance and secure code examples.
Cloud and infrastructure security
  • Harden our AWS environment: IAM least privilege, network segmentation, encryption at rest and in transit, and secrets management.
  • Monitor and respond to findings from tools such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, and AWS Config.
  • Secure and patch Linux servers, and define hardened baselines for new infrastructure.
AI and agent security
  • Assess AI agents for risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, excessive permissions, insecure tool use, and model supply-chain issues.
  • Define guardrails for what agents can access and do, especially where PHI is involved, including logging, human-in-the-loop controls, and output validation.
  • Partner with the AI team to build security into agent design from the start, using frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
Threat management and response
  • Track emerging threats to healthcare, cloud, and AI systems, and turn that intelligence into concrete defenses.
  • Coordinate penetration tests and vulnerability management, from discovery through verified fix.
  • Help build and run our incident response plan, including tabletop exercises.
Compliance and culture
  • Support HIPAA and HITECH compliance.
  • Run secure-coding training and build security awareness across engineering.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years in security engineering, application security, or a closely related role.
  • Hands-on experience securing AWS environments, including IAM, VPC design, KMS, and AWS security services.
  • Strong Linux administration and hardening skills.
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and driving findings to resolution.
  • Working knowledge of LLM and AI agent risks, such as prompt injection, data exfiltration through tools, and over-permissioned agents.
  • Scripting or automation skills in Python, Bash, or similar.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to explain risk to developers and leadership in practical terms.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA or other regulated-data environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare IT or with EHR systems and standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
  • Prior work securing AI agents, RAG pipelines, or LLM integrations in production.
  • Infrastructure-as-code security (Terraform or CloudFormation) and container security.

What success looks like in your first year

  1. First 90 days: You have assessed our AWS, Linux, and PHP environments and our AI agent designs, and you have a prioritized risk roadmap.
  2. By six months: Automated security scanning runs in every pipeline, and developers fix critical findings quickly with your guidance.
  3. By one year: Every new AI agent passes a security review before launch, our incident response plan has been tested, and security is part of how engineering works day to day.

Details and how to apply

  • Location: Remote
  • Employment type: Full-time - Independent Contractor
  • Reports to: CTO
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

jobs.excerpt: AIR seeks a Senior Researcher for its Human and Community Development program to lead research and evaluation aimed at reducing suicide through changes in institutional policies, practices, and cultures across military, law enforcement, justice, and community settings.
jobs.description:
AIR seeks a Senior Researcher for its Human and Community Development program to lead research and evaluation aimed at reducing suicide through changes in institutional policies, practices, and cultures across military, law enforcement, justice, and community settings. The ideal candidate understands how institutions operate and work together, how their decisions affect access to support, and how changes within and across systems can reduce suicide risk and build on the strengths of the people they serve. Suicide prevention is the primary focus of this position, with related leadership in military readiness and resilience, human performance optimization, public health practice, and the prevention of community violence, youth violence, intimate partner and/or sexual violence, child maltreatment, and adverse childhood experiences (ACEs).

Candidates hired for the position may work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of our U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities:

Project & Portfolio Leadership

  • Manage day-to-day operations for large, complex research and evaluation projects or a portfolio of smaller studies as principal investigator, project director, or task lead. Align work with client expectations and AIR priorities.
  • Lead teams from planning through implementation. Set timelines and reporting procedures, assign staff, and manage risks to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.
  • Upholdresearch ethics, institutional review board (IRB) requirements, and data governance policies.

Methodological & Technical Expertise

  • Advise teams on advanced quantitative, qualitative, and mixedmethods for applied research and evaluation.
  • Define applied research problems and develop conceptual frameworks and study designs that align research questions, methods, and analytic plans. Develop and test new approaches to practical research challenges.
  • Lead data collection, including the design of interview protocols, focus group guides, and surveys. Oversee interviews, observations, focus groups, and document reviews.
  • Conduct or oversee data review, analysis, synthesis, and visualization. Use methods suited to the data and ensure integrity, reproducibility, and documentation.

Strategic & Organizational Contribution

  • Shape AIR’s prevention research portfolio by tracking funding trends and identifying emerging research needs and opportunities to reduce suicide risk through systems change in military, law enforcement, justice, and community settings.
  • Represent AIR in national working groups, advisory panels, and technical expert meetings.
  • Build staff expertise through training, workshops, and peer learning.

Client, Partner & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Keep clients, partners, and funders informed of study progress and findings through oral and written updates.
  • Translate findings into policy and practice recommendationsfor policymakers, practitioners, and community partners.
  • Represent AIR in client interactions and build relationships with military, correctional, and public health leaders and implementation partners, with attention to policy and practice context.

Dissemination & Field Leadership

  • Share findings as a subject-matter expert through peer-reviewed publications, technical reports, policy briefs, visualizations, and conference and seminar presentations to raise AIR’s profile in public health and prevention research.

Proposal Development & Business Growth

  • Lead or contribute to proposals for federal, state, foundation, and other clients, shaping study design, methods, staffing, and budgets.
  • Identify new business opportunities and cultivate partnerships that advance AIR’s mission.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Manage and mentor staff to build prevention expertise and technical skills and support career growth.
  • Coach mid-level researchers on study design, analysis, dissemination, and practical problem-solving.
  • Foster an inclusive, collaborativeteam culture.

Qualifications:

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

  • PhD in a related subject area (e.g., Sociology, Psychology, Anthropology, Public Policy, or related field) with 3+ years of relevant experience or Master’s degree with 7+ years of relevant experience.
  • Firm understanding of prevention science.
  • Ability to take big ideas and develop work plans and timelines.
  • Experience working in contract research and/or evaluation organizations.
  • Experience with data collection methodologies, including structured interviews, observations, and survey research, as well as quantitative and/or qualitative data analysis using software such as Stata, R, Excel, NVivo, and Access.
  • Experience managing project and/or task teams on research and evaluation projects.
  • Experience building and maintaining client and partner relationships, specifically across military, law enforcement, justice, and community settings.
  • Experience with business pursuit (e.g., grant and proposal writing).

Skills

  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills, with the ability to produce concise, high-level summaries and briefings.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, and client management skills.
  • Strong presentation, professional development delivery, and facilitation skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy when writing.
  • Can collaborate effectively in a virtual work environment.

jobs.description:
About Alta Advisors

Alta Advisors is a San Francisco-based strategic finance and accounting firm serving frontier technology startups. We act as embedded partners to visionary founders building technically complex, capital-intensive companies, providing fractional CFO leadership, capital raising, and operational finance.

We have helped our clients raise over $500M and support companies representing more than $2B in enterprise value, backed by leading venture capital firms.

Our clients operate across frontier technology sectors, including AI, robotics, defense, climate, hardware, and enterprise software. We help these companies navigate complex financial operations, evolving business models, and investor-grade reporting requirements.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, client-facing Controller to own accounting delivery and financial reporting for a portfolio of U.S.-based startup clients.

You will serve as the primary accounting point of contact for your assigned clients, ensuring accurate financial reporting, proactive communication, and dependable accounting delivery.

You will collaborate closely with our Director of Operational Accounting and Accounting Manager. The Accounting Manager leads month-end close execution and coordinates the accounting team, while you focus on client relationships, financial review, technical accounting matters, and overall delivery quality.

This is a senior, hands-on role requiring strong accounting judgment, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple client relationships in dynamic environments.

We are also building an AI-driven accounting operation. We are looking for someone who already uses AI tools professionally, is curious about emerging technologies, and is excited to help shape more efficient, scalable accounting workflows.

What You'll Do

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary accounting contact for assigned clients, including founders, finance leaders, and other key stakeholders.

  • Present and explain financial results, accounting issues, and recommendations in clear, practical terms.

  • Proactively manage client expectations, reporting deadlines, requests, and escalations.

  • Build trusted relationships through responsiveness, sound judgment, and consistent delivery.

Financial Reporting & Quality Control

  • Oversee the quality and timely delivery of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reporting packages.

  • Review financial statements, reconciliations, workpapers, and accounting deliverables prepared by the team.

  • Identify accounting errors, unusual balances, documentation gaps, and areas requiring investigation.

  • Collaborate with the Accounting Manager to resolve issues, maintain reporting standards, and ensure reliable close processes.

  • Maintain financial reporting and supporting documentation in an audit-ready condition.

Technical Accounting

  • Apply US GAAP principles across areas including revenue recognition, accruals, deferred revenue, leases, inventory, fixed assets, multi-entity structures, and multi-currency accounting.

  • Independently resolve routine and moderately complex accounting matters, collaborating on complex issues and escalating unusual or high-risk judgments when appropriate.

  • Support clients through financial audits, investor and lender due diligence, and accounting-related tax requests.

  • Help address accounting challenges arising from evolving business models, systems, and operational requirements.

Systems & Process Management

  • Identify system gaps, data inconsistencies, integration issues, and workflow inefficiencies affecting reporting quality.

  • Improve accounting processes, internal controls, and documentation to support accurate, scalable financial operations.

  • Collaborate with the accounting team to optimize workflows across general ledger systems and related platforms, including AP, payroll, billing, and expense management.

AI & Automation

  • Actively leverage AI tools and automation to improve accounting workflows, financial reviews, reconciliations, reporting, and documentation.

  • Identify, develop, and implement AI-driven solutions that reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase operational efficiency.

  • Continuously explore and experiment with emerging AI technologies, identifying practical applications across Alta's accounting operations.

  • Champion AI adoption within the accounting team by sharing knowledge, introducing new workflows, and helping others integrate AI into their daily work.

  • Help build an AI-native accounting practice where automation, technology, and continuous improvement are central to how services are delivered.

  • Experiment with emerging AI capabilities and help establish modern, scalable accounting practices.

Operational Excellence & Team Collaboration

  • Coordinate with the Accounting Manager on client onboarding, accounting takeovers, historical cleanups, and close-readiness initiatives.

  • Manage competing priorities across multiple client engagements while maintaining quality and deadlines.

  • Provide clear, actionable review feedback to improve accounting deliverables.

  • Contribute to process improvements, standardization, and operational scalability as Alta grows.

What Success Looks Like

  • Reliable Delivery: Clients consistently receive accurate, timely financial statements and reporting packages, supported by smooth close processes and minimal errors.

  • Trusted Client Relationships: Founders and finance leaders view you as a proactive, dependable accounting partner who anticipates issues and communicates clearly.

  • High Accounting Standards: Financial reporting is accurate, well-documented, and audit-ready, with technical issues appropriately resolved or escalated.

  • Operational Efficiency: You collaborate effectively with the Accounting Manager and accounting team to strengthen controls, streamline workflows, and improve delivery.

  • AI-Driven Improvement: You actively leverage AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve reporting quality, and help build a more scalable accounting operation.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Significant progressive accounting experience, including ownership of accounting operations, month-end close, financial reporting, and related controls.

  • Prior multi-client accounting experience in an accounting firm, outsourced accounting provider, fractional finance firm, or similar professional services environment.

  • Direct professional accounting experience with U.S.-based companies.

  • Hands-on experience with venture-backed startups, high-growth businesses, or similarly dynamic operating environments.

  • Experience serving as the primary accounting contact for clients, founders, executives, or finance leaders.

  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP, including accrual accounting, revenue recognition, deferred revenue, leases, inventory, fixed assets, multi-entity structures, and multi-currency accounting.

  • Experience reviewing financial statements, reconciliations, and accounting work prepared by other accountants.

  • Strong proficiency with QuickBooks Online or another major general ledger, Microsoft Excel, and Google Sheets.

  • Familiarity with related financial systems, such as AP, payroll, billing, spend management, and reporting platforms.

  • Practical experience using AI tools in professional workflows, with a proactive interest in adopting AI, automation, and modern accounting technologies.

  • Professional written and spoken English, with the ability to lead discussions with U.S.-based clients.

  • Based in Mexico and able to work under an independent contractor arrangement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA, Contador Público Certificado, or equivalent accounting certification.

  • Background in public accounting, Big 4, audit, accounting advisory, or outsourced operational accounting.

  • Experience serving deeptech, hardtech, applied AI, robotics, defense, climate, manufacturing, R&D-intensive, or other technically complex businesses.

  • Familiarity with SaaS, usage-based revenue, hardware sales, project accounting, services revenue, or other complex business models.

  • Experience with government contracts, grants, reimbursable cost programs, or project cost tracking.

  • Experience with accounting system implementations, complex client transitions, historical cleanups, or workflow automation.

Why Join Alta Advisors?

  • Work with innovative founders: Support companies building frontier technologies across AI, robotics, climate, hardware, and other advanced industries.

  • Meaningful client ownership: Build direct relationships with founders and finance leaders and have a visible impact on their businesses.

  • Help shape an AI-driven accounting practice: Apply modern technology and automation to improve how accounting services are delivered.

  • High-impact work: Help startups establish reliable accounting infrastructure and navigate increasingly complex financial requirements.

  • Room to grow: Join a collaborative, high-ownership team with opportunities to expand your responsibilities as Alta continues to scale.

Engagement Details

  • Engagement: Full-time independent contractor.

  • Location: Remote, based in Mexico.

  • Availability: Ability to coordinate with U.S.-based clients and Alta's team during mutually agreed meeting and collaboration windows.

  • Primary Contact: Director of Operational Accounting.

  • Compensation: Monthly contractor fee in USD, based on experience and qualifications.

  • Travel: Occasional travel may be required.

Selection Process

Our selection process includes an initial application review, online skills assessments, structured interviews, and a practical accounting assessment for finalists.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your expected monthly contractor fee in USD.

Alta Advisors considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage Mozilla’s root store: Make root store management your primary responsibility, through public review processes, and policy and audit evaluations and using certificate analysis tools, the Common CA Database (CCADB), to process root inclusions, trust changes, and removals and maintain accurate trust and revocation data.
  • Evaluate CA compliance and investigate incidents: Review certificates, CA policies, audit reports, and incident responses. Identify gaps, ask precise follow-up questions, assess corrective actions, and support informed trust decisions.

jobs.title: Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels)
jobs.excerpt: Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence in the industry for technical documentation and documentation practice.
jobs.description:
Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence in the industry for technical documentation and documentation practice. This is your chance to be a part of that, as a Technical Author at Canonical.

We are building documentation capacity at scale. We have dozens of positions available, for teams and products across the organisation, at all levels from Graduate to Senior Staff.

All applications and candidates are handled through this one entry-point.

To improve your chances of success in this application, read our advice on how to get a job at Canonical.

These are not traditional technical writer roles. As a Technical Author, you will lead the documentation efforts of a Canonical team, in engineering, business operations or another part of the company.

You will combine excellence in technical communication with subject-matter expertise and the ability to collaborate with colleagues across the organisation. Even the most junior Technical Authors will have the opportunity to develop and demonstrate technical authority, contributing to documentation practice as a first-class engineering and business discipline.

You will work with the Diátaxis approach to documentation and help elevate standards of technical writing through attention to theory and practice.

The role of a Technical Author

A product-focused Technical Author is a member of a product engineering team, typically focused on a product or family of products. In this role you'll help the team develop documentation that serves the needs of the product's users. You will have responsibility for the quality of the user experience with the product, and will contribute towards the long-term success of the project itself.

A customer-focused Technical Author works in a team such as Field Engineering, Customer Success or Support, dealing with users of complex suites of Canonical software products, sometimes deployed in custom configurations. In this role you’ll take a responsive approach to software documentation problems and develop a strong understanding of how products work together and are used in the real world.

An operations-focused Technical Author is part of a business team, for example Legal, HR or Talent. An important part of this work is to maintain internal documentation, such as employee handbooks. In this role you will help develop and improve materials that hundreds of colleagues rely on daily, and define patterns of business communication for a rapidly-growing organisation.

Some open technical author roles at Canonical

You’ll have a chance to tell us your preferred focus, and we'll work with you to find the right seniority level and team for you.

Whatever your focus, you will also be a part of Canonical's documentation practice team, that includes all the company's Technical Authors. Here, you'll be amongst other documentation experts, who collaborate to define documentation excellence and drive the development of documentation practice and theory, across the company and in the open-source software community.

Location: These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.

As a Technical Author you will

  • Create, maintain and improve software and other documentation
  • Work with your team members, to help them make effective documentation contributions
  • Influence the development of Canonical products and services, as an expert user who has important opinions about function and design
  • Engage with user communities to ensure that our documentation meets their needs
  • Encourage and support community engagement in and contribution to documentation
  • Help standardise the structure, presentation, style and language of content across products
  • Collaborate with documentation peers to advance the state of the art in documentation at Canonical
  • Challenge and advance documentation understanding and best-practice, as part of a disciplinary team

A strong candidate

  • Is an excellent collaborator and communicator
  • Cares deeply about functional written communication
  • Is a technical writer with a programmer’s mindset, or a programmer with a record of producing excellent documentation
  • Has a record of community engagement, in open-source software, documentation, research or other disciplines
  • Is sympathetic to the needs and challenges of open-source software and its communities
  • Demonstrates technical curiosity, and is fascinated by software technology and its challenges
  • Has demonstrable documentation skills, insight and enthusiasm
  • Has experience of software development contexts
  • Is familiar with: Linux, working on the command line, Git, Sphinx, reStructuredText
  • Holds a BSc/BA degree or equivalent
  • Is able to travel twice a year for up to two weeks for events

Nice-to-have skills

  • Deep technical domain knowledge
  • Open-source community leadership and management
  • User-experience, interaction or visual design

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
