The ideal candidate combines deep advisory experience across contact center, CRM, and cloud data environments with current, hands-on fluency in the LLM and Generative AI landscape, and can translate a sponsor's goals into a prioritized, defensible roadmap with a clear ROI framework. This person is comfortable speaking credibly with client IT and delivery teams about platform capability and AI model choices.

What You'll Be Doing

    Roadmap Strategy & Use Case Prioritization
  • Partner with client sponsors to define and refine AI initiative roadmaps across CCaaS, CRM, and cloud data platform investments.
  • Prioritize which AI use cases to pursue, balancing client business goals against realistic technical and data readiness.
  • Sequence roadmaps into phases that reflect dependencies, readiness, and each client's capacity to absorb change.
  • Bring relevant lessons and patterns from other engagements to sharpen roadmap decisions - functioning as a pattern-matching advisor, not a general-purpose consultant.
    • AI & LLM Technology Judgment
  • Maintain current, working knowledge of the LLM landscape - proprietary and open-source models - and the evaluation (evals) methods used to assess fit for a given use case.
  • Advise clients on balancing cost against accuracy, latency, and business need when selecting LLMs or AI services, avoiding both over-engineering and under-investment.
  • Advise on where to leverage AI capabilities already native to CCaaS/CRM platforms (e.g., built-in copilots, agent assist) versus where to build custom solutions - including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) - leveraging the client's data platform.
  • Maintain working familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and similar emerging standards for connecting AI agents and models to enterprise systems and data.
    • Business Case, ROI & Investment
  • Define success metrics and an ROI framework for AI initiatives, tying each initiative to a measurable business outcome.
  • Build or guide the use of ROI calculators and investment-justification models to support business case development for priority initiatives.
  • Work with client stakeholders to secure the investment and organizational buy-in needed to advance the roadmap.
  • Flag initiatives that are underperforming or no longer justified, and recommend where investment should be redirected.

  • Review performance of AI initiatives at agreed checkpoints (quarterly reviews, major initiative kickoffs) against the defined success metrics.

  • Facilitate structured roadmap workshops and checkpoint review sessions with client sponsors and stakeholders.
  • Participate in or advise client AI councils/governance committees, helping address cross-functional questions on AI strategy, policy, risk, and responsible use.

The role

As a Frontend Engineer at Spacelift, you’ll work directly on our product, your work will have a visible impact on how users experience the platform, combining complex technical requirements with performance, usability, and a high bar for UI quality.

React, TypeScript, Coding AI assistant (Claude Code, Cursor)

jobs.description:

Public Partnerships LLC supports individuals with disabilities or chronic illnesses and aging adults, to remain in their homes and communities and “self” direct their own long-term home care. Our role as the nation’s largest and most experienced Financial Management Service provider is to assist those eligible Medicaid recipients to choose and pay for their own support workers and services within their state-approved personalized budget. We are appointed by states and managed healthcare organizations to better serve more of their residents and members requiring long-term care and ensure the efficient use of taxpayer funded services. Our culture attracts and rewards people who are results-oriented and strive to exceed customer expectations. We desire motivated candidates who are excited to join our fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, and who want to make a difference in helping transform the lives of the consumers we serve. (learn more at www.pplfirst.com).


Position Summary


The Regulatory Intelligence Lead - Data Analytics is responsible for designing, building, and operating the data foundation of the organization's centralized regulatory tracking program. This role translates regulatory and sub-regulatory guidance into structured, searchable, and measurable data so that new and changing requirements across all programs, states, clients, and markets can be identified, categorized, assigned, and tracked through implementation.


Working alongside the Manager, Regulatory Intelligence and the Regulatory Intelligence Lead - Legal and Policy, this role owns the taxonomy, data model, tracking tools, workflows, and reporting that give Compliance, Operations, Account Management, Government Relations, Program Integrity, and Privacy a single, reliable view of what is required of the organization and how effectively those requirements are being met.

This is an individual contributor leadership role. The Regulatory Lead provides subject-matter leadership and direction on analytics workstreams but does not manage people.


Key Responsibilities


Centralized Regulatory Tracking Infrastructure

  • Design and maintain the data model, taxonomy, and metadata standards for the centralized inventory of regulatory requirements and sub-regulatory guidance (e.g., statutes, regulations, state directives, bulletins, program manuals, policy issuances, and contractual requirements), including attributes such as program, state, client, source authority, effective date, applicability, and business owner
  • Configure and administer the tools and repository that support regulatory intake, assessment, assignment, and implementation tracking, in partnership with IT and Information Security
  • Build and maintain requirement-to-process, requirement-to-control, and requirement-to-owner crosswalks as structured data that can be searched, filtered, and reported on
  • Establish data quality standards, validation routines, and version control to keep the repository complete, current, and audit-ready
  • Evaluate and, where appropriate, implement automation (e.g., source monitoring, change detection, alerting, and AI-enabled summarization) consistent with enterprise data governance and AI governance requirements

Analytics, Reporting, and Insights

  • Develop dashboards, KPIs, and reporting for leadership and for executive and board-level audiences covering regulatory change volume, cycle times from issuance through assessment and implementation, open and overdue items, and ownership gaps
  • Analyze regulatory change data to identify trends across states, programs, and agencies, and to anticipate operational workload, implementation risk, and resourcing needs
  • Perform coverage and gap analyses comparing the requirement inventory to policies, procedures, controls, and training to identify requirements that are unmapped or unowned
  • Support audits, readiness reviews, and state or client inquiries by producing accurate and timely data pulls, evidence, and traceability reports
  • Measure the effectiveness of regulatory implementation activities and recommend process improvements based on the data

Process Design and Operational Integration

  • Develop standardized, scalable workflows for regulatory monitoring, intake, triage, assessment, communication, and implementation tracking
  • Partner with Operations, Account Management, Government Relations, Compliance, Program Integrity, Privacy, Quality, and Client Services to embed regulatory data and workflows into business processes
  • Collaborate with the Regulatory Lead, Legal and Policy to translate legal interpretations and applicability determinations into structured fields, business rules, and routing logic
  • Document processes and data definitions, and train stakeholders on the use of tracking tools and reports
  • Support the Manager, Regulatory Intelligence in establishing governance, roles, and decision rights for the regulatory tracking program

Required Skills:

  • Advanced data analysis skills, including data modeling, querying (e.g., SQL), and spreadsheet analysis, with proficiency in business intelligence and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI or Tableau)
  • Experience designing taxonomies, data dictionaries, or structured repositories for large volumes of unstructured documents and content
  • Experience configuring or administering workflow, GRC, or issue and case management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Archer, SharePoint/Power Platform, or similar)
  • Ability to read regulatory and sub-regulatory text well enough to structure it accurately, and to recognize when an interpretation question should be escalated
  • Working knowledge of consumer-directed services, Medicaid, and state-funded long-term services and supports programs, and of how FMS/FI operations function
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into clear narratives and recommendations for non-technical audiences
  • Ability to design scalable processes, tools, and governance structures that sustain data quality over time
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration abilities

Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor's degree required. A degree in data analytics, statistics, information systems, health informatics, business, public administration, or a related field is preferred.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics, including at least 3 years supporting regulatory compliance, program integrity, risk, or audit functions – required
  • Experience working within a Financial Management Services (FMS) or Fiscal Intermediary (FI) organization – required
  • Demonstrated experience building dashboards, KPIs, and executive-level reporting – required
  • Experience designing and implementing centralized tracking, inventory, or repository solutions (e.g., regulatory change management, policy management, or contract obligation tracking) – required
  • Experience with Medicaid, LTSS/HCBS, or consumer-directed program requirements and state agency program guidance – preferred
  • Experience applying workflow automation or AI-enabled tools to document monitoring, classification, or summarization – preferred
  • Relevant certification (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, CBAP, or CHC) – preferred

Working Conditions:

  • Remote Work: Home-based; must have a reliable internet connection and a professional workspace
  • Physical Demands: Standard office environment involving extended periods of computer use

Supervisory Responsibility (If applicable):

  • This position does not have direct reports. The Regulatory Lead provides subject-matter leadership, workstream direction, and guidance to cross-functional partners in support of the Regulatory Intelligence program, but does not hire, supervise, or evaluate personnel.

Compensation: $80,000-$85,000

This role is eligible for a base salary within the posted range. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including skills, experience, and geographic location. Compensation may vary for positions based in high cost-of-labor markets.

jobs.description:
About MarketOne
MarketOne International is a global provider of B2B marketing services, helping enterprise companies identify new prospects, build demand generation programs, and convert pipeline to revenue. We deliver across EMEA, Asia Pacific, and the Americas, serving many of the world’s largest companies. We are the partner clients trust most when the stakes and the targets are highest.
Our clients are Fortune 1000 leaders in aviation, manufacturing, and software. Their products are technical and their sales cycles are long, so content has to earn the attention of buyers who are difficult to reach.

About the Role
The Content Strategist owns B2B content strategy for our clients’ programs: planning the content and creative that carries them, writing a good deal of it, and overseeing the content production team that makes the rest.
This is a role for someone senior in their craft who still wants to be in the work. You decide what gets made and why, then either write it yourself or brief whoever does. You will build client brand messaging alongside our strategists rather than receiving it finished, and you will present your thinking to client stakeholders and defend it. The work spans demand generation and account-based marketing programs for enterprise technology and industrial clients.

Responsibilities
Messaging and brand
  • Work with our strategy team on client brand messaging and own the language itself, down to how a claim is phrased and whether it survives being carried across every channel.
  • Build messaging frameworks, copy frameworks, and tone of voice guidance a wider team can write from, so the tenth person to write for a client sounds like the first.
  • Learn each client’s brand guidelines properly and keep our output inside them. Where a guideline is costing performance, bring the evidence and say so.
Writing and creative delivery
  • Produce a significant share of the B2B copywriting yourself, across long-form content, campaign copy, email, and landing pages.
  • Turn a brief into something people actually read, in subject matter that is rarely simple.
  • Write creative briefs that in-house writers and freelancers can work from. Most weak work traces back to a weak brief.
  • Hold the quality bar on what ships: factual accuracy, brand compliance, technical and format correctness, accessibility, and rights clearance.
Content strategy and planning
  • Own editorial strategy and content planning for client programs, connecting brand to demand: what gets made, for which audience and stage, in which format, and what it is expected to do.
  • Translate a client’s proposition and buying group needs into a content set that holds up across email, advertising, landing pages, long-form content, and sales outreach.
  • Check what already exists and can be reused or adapted before commissioning anything new.
  • Contribute content requirements to scoping: volumes, versioning, and the assumptions an estimate rests on.
Content production oversight
  • Oversee the content production team and the freelance and studio network that delivers alongside them.
  • Keep production moving to the dates committed. Content sits upstream of campaign launch, and a late asset moves someone else’s date.
  • Own version control and the record of what shipped, in which variant, on which date.
  • Build for reuse through modular content and templates, so later versions cost a fraction of the first.
Performance
  • Be answerable for how the content performed, not just for getting it out of the door.

Company Overview

Our client makes inspection software for property managers. It has a mobile field app, a web dashboard, reports and integrations, plus an AI that turns a spoken walkthrough into a report. The app captures geotagged photos, video and voice offline and syncs later.

The founder started the company in 2014, after trying to capture thousands of photos fast during mass move-outs in a college town. It's bootstrapped and profitable, and it grows through direct sales, referrals and partnerships. The team is fully remote and writes things down, and the CEO sets priorities with you directly.

Your Role

As Product Specialist, you'll own the path from a customer's problem to a tested release and its written notes. You'll write requirements, test features by hand, and keep engineering work on dates through clear follow-up.

You'll report to the Head of Product Engineering and work with Support, Customer Success, Marketing and the CEO. This is an individual contributor seat with no direct reports. The role is fully remote, with overlap with Pacific hours.

Success means engineers build from your requirements and their questions are about edge cases. Every roadmap item you follow has an owner, a date and a written decision. Within 6 to 12 months, you run the whole path from customer problem to release notes on your own.

You'll

  • Talk with customers and read Support trends to find where workflows break
  • Write requirements with edge cases for engineering to build from
  • Test each feature on a phone, from capture and offline sync to the final report
  • Send findings to engineering as steps, expected result and actual result
  • Trace repeated support tickets to their root cause, then confirm the fix stopped them
  • Prepare releases with Marketing and Support and check draft notes against the feature
  • Ask engineering for dates, check progress and raise risks as soon as you see them
  • Use AI to summarize customer feedback and draft first versions of requirements

You Bring

  • 3+ years in SaaS product, product ops, program or project management, QA, or implementation
  • Hands-on testing of a mobile or web product, and writing up what broke
  • Written requirements, specs or user stories with edge cases that developers built from
  • Daily use of AI tools for real work, with something you built and can demo
  • Clear written English for a US team
  • A tracker you kept current across several teams, chasing late items yourself
  • Self-direction in a small remote team with little process
  • Availability for Pacific hours

Bonus Points

  • Time in property management, field service or inspections
  • Release notes, help articles or FAQs you wrote for customers
  • A prototype you built with an AI coding tool
  • Testing a mobile app that captures offline and syncs later

What's Offered

  • Compensation based on experience and where you're based. Share your target range and we'll go from there.

Interview Process

1️⃣ First call: 30 minutes with us at atomic✳HR on what you have built, working terms and what you want next.
2️⃣ Practical exercise: you analyze a workflow and write the requirements for it, the same work the seat does each week. It shows how you find edge cases and how clearly you write for an engineer.
3️⃣ Team interview: a conversation with team members on how you would work across customers, Support, Marketing and engineering, and how you follow up when work stalls.
4️⃣ Conversation with the Head of Product Engineering: your future manager, on how you would work with engineering as it moves toward services, how you hold delivery to dates, and how you write down decisions.

Product Designer, Product (Remote)

Full-Time, Remote / Salary, Exempt

Includes Exceptional Benefits, Flexible PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity

At Steno, we’re growing fast and transforming the litigation technology industry with best-in-class court reporting, modern solutions that add value for lawyers, and an exceptional client experience. We partner with law firms to simplify complex workflows, deliver reliable outcomes and case insights, and revolutionize a traditionally outdated space while we expand across the country.

Steno has experienced rapid growth and market adoption since its release in early 2019, and we're now ready to bring on additional design talent. Great products start with great design and people who care about the details. In this role, you'll own the design of a core product area at Steno, working closely with product and engineering to deliver measurable results.

Who are you?

We're looking for a Product Designer who thrives on solving problems inside an existing, complex system. You'll take features from problem framing through implementation, working within Steno's design system and product surfaces to deliver seamless, intuitive experiences for our users.

At Steno, we build products by deeply understanding our users' pain points first. We want a designer who works the same way: someone who digs into the real problem before jumping to a solution, designs within real constraints, and cares about the details that matter. You move quickly, explain your decisions and trade-offs, and follow your work through to make sure it ships the way you designed it.

You have deep expertise in visual and interaction design, and you're comfortable building on someone else's design system rather than starting from a blank canvas. Exceptional communication skills are a must, along with a hospitality mindset that leads with empathy, and the ability to stay steady under pressure.

On a regular basis you will:

  • Own the design of your product area end-to-end, framing problems alongside product managers and carrying them through to pixel-level polish while balancing vision, craft, speed, and business needs
  • Partner directly with product and engineering from planning through execution, shaping what gets built, not just how it looks
  • Build working prototypes by leveraging AI tools to test ideas and validate direction
  • Validate that what ships matches what was designed, and catch any downstream effects a change might have elsewhere in the product
  • Contribute to the broader design system while advocating for accessibility and inclusive user experiences
  • Create new patterns that are intuitive, practical, and consistent, evolving Steno's design system intentionally as we scale
  • Use data, research, and feedback to iterate on existing features and identify new opportunities for improvement
  • Contribute to design culture across the org by collaborating, presenting work, and sharing feedback with other designers

You'll thrive here if:

  • You have 4+ years of experience in product design, ideally including work on complex, workflow-heavy SaaS products
  • You're skilled in Figma and use AI prototyping tools to explore and test ideas quickly
  • You understand AI's strengths and limits well enough to make sound design decisions
  • You've designed within an existing product and design system, and you know when to follow a pattern and when to evolve it
  • You have experience partnering closely with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, and beyond) to drive complex features from concept through implementation
  • You have exceptional problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail, with a track record of bringing clarity to ambiguous problems
  • You have strong visual and interaction design skills, and you know which details matter
  • You explain design decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About Kadince Kadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote (must live in the USA) software company founded in 2013.
jobs.description:
About Kadince

Kadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote (must live in the USA) software company founded in 2013. In a nutshell, we build tools to help compliance and marketing professionals at financial institutions do their jobs more efficiently.

Kadince has been profitable for several years (we’re fans of making more than we spend). We’re bootstrapped, which means we don’t have investors. So our owners answer to no one. And they aren’t just giving us commands from their vacation homes waiting to cash their next check. They’re fellow team members and in the trenches with us.

Why We’re Hiring

After our team members, our customers are our most important focus. As our customer base grows, so does our team. We’re dedicated to giving each customer the best experience possible, which means having enough people to take care of all their needs. We’re growing quickly and so are the needs of our customers. That’s why we’re increasing the size of our customer team.

Who We Want to Hire

To be a Kadince Customer Success Specialist you don’t need a ton of experience with customer support or with Kadince. We’re willing to train the right applicant and teach you what you need to know. You just need to be excited to learn a new software and teach others how to use it. You should be able to learn quickly and strive to know our software inside and out.

Our Customer Success Specialists are the front line in Kadince support. You’ll help customers with bugs and any problems they may have. You’ll be part of the implementation process and help new Kadince customers learn how to use the software.

You’re a compassionate person with a lot of empathy. Change doesn’t scare you. In fact, change excites you. You’re a self-starter and don’t need every moment of your day to be planned for you. You’re not afraid of feedback or accountability and you love to learn from your team members.

You have a desire to continually improve your listening and teaching skills. We love giving team members opportunities to improve their skills, whether through online courses, workshops, or learning from others.

Our vision, mission, and core values should resonate with you. That’ll be crucial to your success and happiness if you join the Kadince team.

Our Vision and Mission

Our vision and mission aren’t something we hung on the office wall and forgot about. Seriously, we don’t have an office, let alone a wall to hang them on. But our vision, mission, and core values sit on the desks of each of our team members. And we discuss them regularly in our meetings. Your goals and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) will be developed to ensure you’re working to help us achieve our vision and mission.

Our vision and mission are what get us up each morning. They, in addition to our core values, help us make decisions.

Vision - Setting the standard for operating a great software company.

We’re big fans of author Jim Collins and his best-selling book, Good to Great (bonus points if you’ve read it). While there are lots of good software companies out there, we want to be one of the great ones.

The first word of our vision is also significant. To go “high school English class” on you, the present participle “setting” illustrates that we’re not looking to set the standard and then be done, but that the standard is always moving and we’re always chasing it. We continually stop to recognize the awesome things we’ve done and then look for ways to do them even better.

Mission - Building the best software for compliance and marketing professionals at financial institutions.

As Jim Collins taught in his Hedgehog Concept (told you we think he’s great—pun intended), great companies need to determine what they can be the best at in the world and focus on that. There are so many things we could solve as a software company, but we’ve found what we think we can be the best in the world at and we stick to it every day.

Our Core Values

Our core values remind us who we are. They also guide us in the decisions we make. They’re listed in order of importance. If we have a question when making a decision about people, for example, we look to the core value above it to make our decision.

  1. Integrity - We’re honest with ourselves and others.
  2. People - We understand that people are the foundation of Kadince and we act accordingly.
  3. Care - We love what we do and do it consistently and intentionally to the best of our abilities.
  4. Remarkability - We provide remarkable experiences to all who come into contact with Kadince.
  5. Growth - We accept yesterday and improve today.

What a Day in the Life of a Customer Success Specialist Looks Like

You start your day by reviewing your calendar and double-checking the blocks you’ve scheduled for various tasks (you’re a calendar ninja, after all). Then you dive straight into Intercom (our in-app chat feature) to see if any customers have responded to you since yesterday. There are a few messages, so you dig into their questions and provide some helpful answers.

Throughout the day, you respond to customer needs through email, quick calls, screen shares, and more. When a customer lets you know that their workflow isn’t running, you dive into their account to determine whether it’s a bug or they just need some more training. Look at that; it’s a bug! You screen record your findings and send it over to the development team. They do their magic (seriously, how do they do it?), and you end the session with one happy customer.

When you realize that a customer just needs a quick training, you hop on a call and get them squared away. When another customer needs a longer, more in-depth training session, you encourage them to schedule a meeting with the Kadince team. Any time you come across a bug, you do some digging and get as much information as possible over to the development team. The more information you provide, the faster the developers can cast that spell and get it fixed. You let the customer know how long it will take to resolve, and they thank you for your quick response.

With each customer interaction, you go above and beyond to show that you CARE. Your goal is to thoroughly review each question/concern and take it as far as you can. Loose ends are not your cup of tea! This requires attention to detail and a genuine desire to be helpful.

For lunch, you decide to pack a sandwich and take your dog to the park. He runs around and gets all his energy out so you don’t have to worry about entertaining him for the rest of the day. Or, if you’re more of a cat person, you pat your cat on the head and head out for a quick run.

After lunch, you talk to more customers, as well as your team members. You notice that one of your fellow Customer Success Specialists has been really on top of it today, so you give them a shoutout in Slack and thank them for being so awesome. Many of your team members respond to your shoutout with party emojis, hearts, and a giphy you can’t stop watching.

You finish up your day by looking at tomorrow and planning around your customers’ needs and team meetings. You take one last look at your email and incoming customer requests to ensure there is nothing urgent. Coast is clear! You close your laptop and your office door.

When and Where You’d Work and What You’d Work On

Kadince is a principle-based company, which means we focus on principles, not policies. You’ll work with your leader, MacKeely Morris, each week to review your goals/KPI and what you’ve been working on. You’ll meet regularly with the Customer Success team to learn, keep projects on track, and ensure that goals/KPIs are being reached.

As a Customer Success Specialist, you’ll also work regularly with bank and credit union professionals around the country. While we aren’t super particular about when and where you work, you’ll need to work around the schedules of other team members and our customers to ensure that goals stay on track and nothing falls through the cracks. Overall, your schedule needs to help you achieve our vision and mission and demonstrate our core values. After all, this is a full-time job, and we treat it that way!

At Kadince, work won’t tie you down to one location. You’ll have the flexibility to work remotely and even change locations from time to time. Want to spend a few weeks somewhere new—maybe exploring a different state or another country? That’s totally possible, as long as it’s approved by HR ahead of time to make sure everything’s good from a legal and tax standpoint. Just make sure that wherever you plan to work has a reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps download and 1-2 Mbps upload (as if you would go anywhere without it anyway).

Who You’d Be Working With

We have over 50 team members (which makes us really happy since Kadince was started by two people in their basements). If hired, you’ll probably work with each team member in one way or another. Some of the people you’ll work with most frequently are:

Holly is the Lead Senior Customer Success Specialist, so she helps train our new CSSs and works with customers to ensure they are taken care of. Holly lives in Minnesota and is a dedicated Vikings and Twins fan. Holly loves fashion and always tries to support local boutiques, but she’s also outdoorsy and sleeps best in a tent when it’s raining. If Holly could do anything, she’d be a detective. Maybe she’d finally figure out who’s been stealing all of Jared’s jokes…(Holly’s coming for you, Brady.)

Emma is a Customer Success Specialist from Huntsville, Alabama. She loves to mountain bike, garden, read, run, and hike. She must be pretty accident prone, though. She’s broken her nose three times! Emma used to be an assistant wedding planner, and boy does she have some stories! She’s currently working her way through visiting every national park on the U.S., and we’re all here cheering her on.

Ben is a Senior Customer Success Specialist, so he’s on the front line working with customers and helping with bugs, general questions, onboarding, and training. Ben loves sports and is a die-hard Los Angeles Dodgers fan (he watches over 162 games a year!). If he could do anything in the world, he would take a 3–6 month trip with his family touring the entire country.

Benefits

Since we’re a remote company, we don’t offer office snacks and ping pong tables. But if you’re a fan of “core benefits” that bring great rewards and peace of mind, you’ll like what we have to offer. Competitive pay, 401(k) matching, generous paid leave, insurance (medical, dental, vision, life, short-term disability), and a flex spending account. Yeah, it’s pretty great...

And we love to spoil our team. We celebrate big events with you, like birthdays and work anniversaries, so you can expect some pretty fun gifts. We recently sent some high-quality lip balm to each team member so we could all play a prank on Scott, our Director of Product. We’re fun like that. And each year we give every team member the final week of the year off (we like to spread holiday cheer).

How to Apply

Applicants who stand out are those who are interested in working for Kadince, not just applying for as many positions as possible or trying to keep unemployment benefits. We’ve seen it all. No kidding, we once had someone ask us in an interview what the name of our company is. Needless to say, we could tell that person wasn’t really passionate about joining our team.

When applying to Kadince, please send us PDFs of your resume and cover letter. The cover letter is your opportunity to tell us why you would be a great fit for the position, but should be no longer than 300 words. Take advantage of this time. Seriously, sell yourself!

Thank you for your interest in Kadince. We look forward to reviewing your application.

This position is open to candidates living in AL, AK, AZ, AR, CT, DE, FL, GA, HI, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MN, MS, MO, NE, NV, NH, NM, NC, ND, OH, OK, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA, WV, WI, and WY.

Kadince, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

Salary: $40,000-$65,000

You will bring strong software development skills and deep test automation expertise, and you will spend most of your time making sure every capability is covered by a strong automated testing framework.

The team builds with an AI-assisted pipeline across the full software development lifecycle. You will check the quality of AI-generated code and tests, build component, integration and performance test suites, and promote test-driven development across several product workstreams. You will work closely with full-stack engineers, architects and product teams on WFM forecasting, staffing and configuration management. You may also join scoping, UX and solution design discussions.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and evolve the test automation framework, and make sure every new capability is connected to it.
  • Review and strengthen unit tests generated by AI, and catch weak or low-quality AI output before it reaches production.
  • Build and maintain automated component, integration, contract, API, end-to-end and regression test suites for Java/Spring Boot microservices and React front ends.
  • Design and run performance and load tests to confirm scalability, throughput and response times at peak contact-center volumes.
  • Promote and coach test-driven development (TDD) practices across engineering workstreams.
  • Set up and maintain quality gates in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Build observability into test and release processes so problems are found early.
  • Join code reviews and give clear, technically grounded feedback to engineers and on AI-generated changes.

Product Marketing Manager, Legal

Intapp (NASDAQ: INTA) is the leading AI platform for investment and professional services firms, helping them grow, manage risk, and run profitably. We recently launched Intapp Celeste, an AI native agentic platform purpose built to automate firm workflows while enforcing professional compliance and confidentiality standards. Intapp DealCloud is our deal and relationship management foundation, established and deeply embedded in how firms work.

You will own Legal go-to-market execution for Celeste and DealCloud, in step with the strategy and priorities set by the Director of Product Marketing, who is accountable for the overall Celeste and DealCloud go-to-market. That means standing up the new Celeste motion for law firms while extending the proven DealCloud foundation and bringing the two together into one clear set of offerings that sellers can take to market. Expect the pace and ambiguity of an early-stage motion, backed by the distribution, client relationships, and data advantages of a public enterprise software company.

You will work where product strategy, positioning, and field enablement meet: turning platform capability into a repeatable Legal solutions motion, and turning field signal back into sharper positioning, packaging, and product decisions. You will partner closely with PMMs representing other products solid into our Legal solution, Product, Sales, Marketing, and Enablement, and you will report to the Director of Product Marketing for Celeste and DealCloud.

What you will do

As a Product Marketing Manager, Legal (Celeste and DealCloud), you can expect to:


  • Own positioning, messaging, and narrative for Celeste and DealCloud in Legal. Translate platform capabilities into value stories for the workflows law firms run every day, test those stories with buyers, and evolve the message as the product and market develop. Build the competitive story for how Intapp wins.
  • Take packaging and pricing to market. Partner with Product, Pricing, and Sales on packages, tiers, and commercial constructs for DealCloud with Celeste, including usage-based mechanics where they apply, with field-ready talk tracks, guardrails, and objection handling that reinforce cost predictability and business value.
  • Build the Legal seller motion. Own the qualification frameworks and pre-qualification questions that tell sellers what to sell, to whom, when, and when to bring in specialist teams.
  • Drive Legal field assets. Deliver pitch decks, demo narratives, seller guides, and competitive positioning from launch through sustained adoption, keep them current as packaging and the market evolve, and support Enablement on field activation.
  • Run the field feedback loop. Capture objections, win/loss patterns, and adoption signals from live client conversations, and channel them into positioning, packaging, pricing, and roadmap decisions. Partner with Product and Engineering so buyer feedback and competitive dynamics shape priorities.
  • Orchestrate Legal launches end to end. Own the marketing strategy and readiness across Product, Pricing, Sales, Marketing, and post-sales. Define and track the metrics that show go-to-market effectiveness and business impact, then act on what they tell you.
  • Build market credibility. Work with Industry Marketing, which owns deep thought leadership, and with analyst relations to turn customer success stories, ROI analyses, and real-world proof points into evidence that Legal buyers trust.
  • Stay connected to the wider pod. Align with the Celeste platform product marketing lead on cross industry positioning and commercial model design, with Financial Services solutions marketing on shared DealCloud and Celeste constructs, and with Demand Generation and Enablement on campaigns and training.

What you will need

Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team. To apply for this Product Marketing Manager, Legal (Celeste and DealCloud) role, you will ideally have:


  • 6+ years in B2B product marketing, solutions marketing, or a related go-to-market role in enterprise software, including ownership of go-to-market for an AI, data, or platform product, not just its messaging. We are open to candidates from product, strategy, or other GTM backgrounds with strong product marketing instincts.
  • A builder's mindset. You have launched a new product, offer, or motion from zero to one, or inside an established business, iterated it weekly on field feedback, and are comfortable shipping before the playbook feels finished.
  • Experience launching AI experiences. You have taken an AI-native product or feature to market, from early adoption and trust-building through positioning that helps buyers understand and adopt agentic or generative capabilities.
  • Familiarity with relationship and deal management solutions. You understand CRM, business development, or similar platforms and how they fit into the day-to-day workflows of the people who use them. Familiarity with law firms, legal tech, or professional services is a plus. This role needs solution-level fluency, not a published industry voice.
  • Exceptional storytelling for technical products. You can turn an agentic AI platform and its commercial model into a clear, confident narrative for senior buyers and for sellers.
  • Experience taking packaging and pricing to the field. You have launched or evolved tiers, bundles, or usage-based models, and you know how to arm sellers to handle pricing objections without discounting the story.
  • A client- and field-centric launch record. You build a listening loop into every launch, combining quantitative signals (win/loss, usage, adoption) with qualitative feedback from sellers and clients, and turn what you hear into sharper positioning, packaging, and product decisions.
  • Strong business acumen and problem solving. You can break down ambiguous market problems and translate analysis into action.
  • Cross functional leadership without direct authority across Product, Pricing, Sales, and Marketing, in an environment where priorities shift fast.
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

What you will gain at Intapp

At Intapp, you'll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You'll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that's connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. We'll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork.

Here, you will have the opportunity to:


  • Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.
  • Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.
  • Support What Matters Most: Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Scientist, Bioanalytical Portfolio

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will serve as the technical subject matter expert for outsourced methods and is responsible for ensure adequate method validation and optimal method performance at CROs.


The Bioanalytical Portfolio Scientist is responsible for oversight of the outsourced bioanalytical phases of studies governed by applicable GLP/GCP principles. Individuals in this role will provide scientific and technical oversight of bioanalytical activities (including pharmacokinetic [PK] and toxicokinetic [TK] analyses) performed by external contract research organizations (CROs), ensuring adherence to validated methods, data integrity standards, and alignment with study protocols and regulatory requirements.


The ideal candidate will have a strong background of method development, validation, and troubleshooting in quantitative ligand-binding assays (LBA) and/or LC-MS bioanalysis, combined with excellent communication skills. This role is well suited for scientists who seek to learn more about externalized work and who thrive working with others in a collaborative manner.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Provides scientific and technical oversight for the transfer, validation, and execution for pharmacokinetic (PK) assays, ensuring adherence to sponsor requirements and current regulatory guidance on bioanalytical assays (e.g. FDA, ICH, EMEA, NMPA).

  • Leads the transfer and validation of PK assays at external CROs using ligand-binding, ELISA, ECL, LC-MS/MS and hybrid methodologies.

  • Collaborates closely with internal bioanalytical subject matter experts to understand critical attributes of the PK method to ensure successful assay transfer and validation.

  • Monitors assay performance over time and provide input for troubleshooting and continuous improvement efforts.

  • Accountable for method lifecycle management, including review of method validation plans, protocols, reports, and qualification/bridging of reagents and reference material.

  • Reviews analytical data, method protocol, validation/sample analysis plans, reports, and other study documentation for scientific accuracy and consistency with GLP/GCP documentation standards and current regulatory guidance.

  • Works with cross functional partners from CROs to navigate issue resolution and escalation utilizing the governance structure.

  • Provides subject matter expertise during supplier evaluation and monitoring activities.

  • Follows and contributes to guidance documents and SOPs.

  • Supports regulatory activities.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The scientific leader we seek is a collaborative and results-driven professional with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree


OR


Master’s degree and 2 years of bioanalytical assay development, validation, and bioanalysis experience.


OR


Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of bioanalytical assay development, validation, and bioanalysis experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experienced in working with CROs.

  • Project and people management.

  • Process management and planning skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Collaborates, negotiates and persuades others, both internally and externally.

  • Openly promotes cooperation across the organization.

  • Project and issue management skills.

  • Drives for results; delivers processes and outcomes of the highest quality.

  • Consistently communicates in a manner that is appropriate to the situation.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Strong project management experience

  • Fluency in English, both in written and oral communication.

  • Demonstrated expertise in PK assay development, validation, and troubleshooting for LBA, LC-MS or hybrid assays.

  • Knowledgeable on current relevant regulatory guidance/regulations (e.g. FDA, ICH, EMEA, NMPA).

What you can expect from us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.

jobs.description:
Position: Senior Accountant

Open to: Newly qualified CA and CPA (freshers)

Location: Remote (India)

Shift: US Shift (4:00 PM to 1:30 AM IST)

Company: CredibleCFO LLC

Employment Type: Full-Time

About CredibleCFO

CredibleCFO is a cloud accounting and finance firm serving small and medium-sized businesses across the United States. We provide bookkeeping, accounting, financial reporting, CFO advisory, tax support and business process improvement using modern cloud accounting platforms.

We are weaving AI into how we deliver bookkeeping, accounting and financial reporting, and we expect our accountants to work that way too: using AI tools daily, and knowing exactly where their own judgment still has to sit on top.

Who this role is for

This is a fresher opening for qualified accountants. If you have just cleared CA or CPA, this is a first post-qualification role, not a role that expects years of US accounting behind you. Your articleship or equivalent training is the experience we are looking for.

  • No post-qualification experience is required.
  • You will own real client work from early on, with review and mentoring from a Controller.
  • You will learn US GAAP as it is actually applied, not as exam theory.

What you will do

Accounts Payable

  • Process vendor bills end to end: intake, coding to the correct GL account, routing for approval and preparing payment runs.
  • Work in AP automation tooling such as Bill.com and keep it reconciled to the general ledger in QuickBooks Online.
  • Chase overdue bills and reconcile vendor statements where balances disagree.
  • Help maintain the vendor master, including W-9 collection and annual 1099 preparation.

Accounts Receivable

  • Raise customer invoices, including invoicing against purchase orders for clients who sell through retail distributors and wholesale channels.
  • Apply customer receipts accurately and keep unapplied cash at zero.
  • Prepare the weekly AR aging report and support collections follow-up.
  • Prepare credit memos for shortships, deductions and chargebacks, and help trace what caused them.

General Ledger and month-end close

  • Clear bank and credit card feeds weekly and complete monthly bank and credit card reconciliations.
  • Post accrual, prepaid and inventory adjustment entries with supporting workpapers.
  • Reconcile AP, AR and inventory subledgers to the general ledger each period.
  • Work through the month-end close checklist and keep the evidence trail behind each balance sheet account.
  • Prepare monthly financial statements for review, and investigate variances before they are asked about.

AI and automation

  • Use AI tools in day-to-day work: document and receipt extraction, transaction categorization, reconciliation assistance and first-draft commentary.
  • Check AI-assisted output before it goes anywhere. Every number that reaches a client must be traceable to source, whatever produced the first draft.
  • Flag the repetitive parts of your own workflow that should become automations.

What we will teach you

  • US GAAP in practice across a portfolio of real US businesses.
  • QuickBooks Online to a professional standard, plus exposure to Xero, Zoho Books and Odoo.
  • AP automation (Bill.com) and purchase-order driven billing through retail-distributor and EDI portals.
  • How a month-end close is actually run, reviewed and signed off.
  • Working directly with US-based clients and presenting your own numbers.

Required qualifications

  • CA or CPA qualified, including candidates whose final results are awaited.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or a related field.
  • Strong accounting fundamentals: double entry, accruals, reconciliations and the structure of financial statements.
  • Working Excel skills, including lookups and pivot tables.
  • Clear written and spoken English, enough to correspond with US clients directly.
  • Willing and able to work the US shift, 4:00 PM to 1:30 AM IST.

Nice to have

  • Articleship or training with exposure to US, UK or other offshore accounting work.
  • Any hands-on time in QuickBooks Online, Xero or Zoho Books.
  • Exposure to AP automation, payroll or sales-tax work.
  • Having used an AI assistant to change how a task actually gets done.

What we look for in the first year

  • Accuracy first: work that comes back from review with few corrections.
  • Closes delivered on time, with reconciliations genuinely tied out.
  • Questions asked early rather than assumptions buried in the ledger.
  • Steady growth in the number of clients you can carry independently.

Compensation and benefits

Salary: Based on qualification and performance in the selection process.

  • Structured training and mentoring from Controllers and senior staff
  • Exposure to US businesses across multiple industries
  • Clear progression path as you take on more client ownership
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Professional development support

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

jobs.excerpt: About Us Every physical product you touch starts with raw materials.
jobs.description:
About Us

Every physical product you touch starts with raw materials. The soap you wash your hands with, the laptop you're looking at right now, and even the concrete sidewalk under your feet all depend on chemicals, materials, and ingredients that someone has to find, qualify, and buy.That's a $6T industry. Most of it still runs on spreadsheets, phone calls, and trade shows.

Valdera is the leading AI platform for chemicals and raw materials. Our agents help procurement teams find savings, reduce supply risk, and source from qualified suppliers. We also help suppliers find and win the right customers.

We work with some of the largest manufacturers in the world, including market leaders in pharma, personal care, beauty, and industrials. Many of them spend $1B to $10B each on raw materials. They rely on Valdera as their source of truth and to run big workflows end to end.
Index Ventures led our $15M Series A, and we're growing fast.

Why Recruiters Join Us

  • Hiring is our top goal for 2027. Hiring drives our next stage of growth. You'll get significant time with founders, top-tier AI recruiting tools, and a sizable budget.
  • Top talent attracts top talent. Candidates meet our exceptional team and want to work with them. New hires often tell us they joined because of the people they met.
  • Our leaders recruit with you. Leaders and employees source, sell, and hold a high bar in every interview loop.
  • Big untapped networks. Our founders, team, and investors have deep networks that need to be tapped. You'll turn those warm relationships into high-quality pipeline instead of relying on cold outreach alone.
  • Competitive comp. Our offers win. We benchmark them at the top quartile of the market for our stage.
  • Career growth. You'll report directly to a founder and build the recruiting function from the ground up with their support.

Role Description

We're hiring our first Recruiter to grow the team that takes Valdera to its next stage. Every hire shapes our culture. That makes this one of the most important roles at the company.

You'll partner with the founders and with leaders across engineering, product, sales, and operations. You'll know where we're headed and who we need to get there. Then you'll find those people and close them.

Sourcing is the heart of the job. You'll build a deep top of funnel and use AI to reach great people before they start looking.

Role Responsibilities

  • Build & convert the top of funnel. Sourcing is a top priority. Build a deep pipeline of top candidates across engineering, product, and GTM, and attract them to Valdera.
  • Multiply yourself with AI. Use AI to find, rank, and reach top candidates at scale. Choose the best tools and agents to support scheduling and interview notes. One recruiter should do the work of a team.
  • Turn our network into pipeline. Work the networks of our founders, team, and investors. Run a referral program people actually use.
  • High ownership. Run searches from kickoff to signed offer. Scope roles, source, screen, run interview loops, and close candidates.
  • Hire from IC through director. Recruit top ICs, managers, and directors across every team.
  • Tailor the pitch to each role. Pitch Valdera to enterprise AEs, PMs, or engineers on what each cares about most.
  • Keep raising the bar. Calibrate hiring managers. Sharpen interview loops and scorecards. Drive fast, well-calibrated decisions.
  • Run hiring on data. Track pipeline health, time to hire, source quality, and offer acceptance. Use the data to improve how we hire.
  • Own offers and paperwork. Draft offers, run background checks and E-Verify, and hand off cleanly to onboarding through our PEO.
  • Build our employer brand. Shape how Valdera shows up on our careers page, job posts, and LinkedIn. Every candidate should leave impressed, hired or not.

Experience & Qualifications

  • You have 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting, ideally at a fast-growing startup.
  • You've hired at multiple levels from top ICs to directors, across engineering, product, or GTM.
  • You've been part of early-stage companies and helped build exceptional teams there.
  • You're an exceptional sourcer. You've built deep pipelines of passive candidates.
  • You bring a strong network of top go-to-market, product, or engineering talent (whichever areas you've focused on).
  • You use AI tools every day and have built workflows that significantly multiply your output.
  • You motivate candidates on mission, team, and product, so offers never hinge on comp alone.
  • You know compensation strategy well and can structure creative, winning offers.
  • You communicate concisely, clearly, warmly, and directly with candidates and executives

Salary Range:

  • Total compensation of $140K to $220K.
  • Meaningful equity.
  • The final offer depends on skills, experience, and location.

Benefits:

Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. Full time employees are eligible for premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance coverage. You will be provided a more detailed breakdown of your options prior to joining Valdera.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:

Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.
Please note that Valdera uses E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

The Clinical Site Payments Associate Manager for the ANZ-SEA region will be responsible for global portfolio activities, offering specialized support and assistance to investigative sites, Global Clinical Operations, and other departments involved in the planning, execution, tracking, and management of global clinical trial payments. · Provide excellent customer service and ensure timely resolution of site issues.

· Oversee the maintenance and updates of payment tracking information in Smartsheet and/or Power BI.

· Manage the team’s setup and maintenance of financial files throughout the study, including payment documentation, investigator financial files, and amendments, in accordance with ALCOA+C guidelines.

· Collaborate with the team to reconcile all study payments routinely and provide financial reports to clients as needed.

· Develop and facilitate training on investigator payments, acting as the Subject Matter Expert for Clinical Site Payments to global business partners and stakeholders.

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Senior Distinguished Engineer, AI Safety & SecurityAbout Trellix Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era.
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Senior Distinguished Engineer, AI Safety & Security

About Trellix 
Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at .

Role Overview:

Office of the CTO · Reports to the Chief Technology Officer · US Remote

Make AI safe to trust at machine speed

AI now writes software, triages alerts, and acts inside networks. Attackers have noticed. They plant instructions in public code to hijack AI coding agents, steal AI credentials at scale, and run agents that move through networks faster than any human team. Governments are planning for superintelligence across their missions. Every company that builds with AI now carries this risk, and a security company must carry it best.
Trellix is investing to set that standard. We are looking for the engineer who will define how Trellix builds with AI and how our AI earns customer trust. This is one of the most senior technical roles at Trellix.

Why Trellix

  • AI at the core. Trellix Wise™, our agentic security platform, went from concept to general availability in about three months, and AI-assisted engineering now runs across our development teams. You will secure both at scale.
  • Trust is the product. Governments and regulated industries run Trellix on-prem and air-gapped. They need AI they can audit, contain, and explain. You will make that possible.
  • A front-row view of the adversary. Our Advanced Research Center tracks the attackers now turning AI against defenders. Your controls will meet real threats, not hypotheticals.

What you will build

AI-native engineering, with evidence

  • Set the guardrails for AI coding agents: execution boundaries, repository and credential scope, human approval gates, and complete audit trails.
  • Require validation before trust: evaluation suites every new model or agent must pass before it touches production code.
  • Govern our own agentic workforce with identity, least privilege, and spending limits for every AI agent we run.
  • Prove with data that AI makes us faster and better, and retire what does not.

Secure by default

  • Make the safe option the default across our build systems, pipelines, and software supply chain.
  • Shorten release cycles while lowering defect and vulnerability rates.

AI safety and security in Trellix products

  • Set the architecture standard for AI in Trellix products, including Trellix Wise™: data handling, purpose limitation, privacy, model isolation, tool-use controls, and kill switches.
  • Red-team our AI before attackers do: prompt injection, tool abuse, data and model poisoning, credential theft, and agent escape.
  • Keep models swappable, so customers can choose cloud, on-prem, or air-gapped without losing protection.
  • Shape our products for protecting customers' own AI agents and models.

Frontier questions you will own

  • How do you prove an AI agent did only what it was allowed to do?
  • How do you trust a new model before it touches production?
  • What does least privilege mean for an agent that writes its own tools?
  • How do controls hold when adversaries run models as capable as ours?
  • How do we give customers and regulators audit-grade evidence for decisions an AI made?

How you will work

  • Report to the CTO and work alongside the Chief Architect and Trellix's senior distinguished engineers.
  • Set standards that every engineering team adopts, and build the shared controls that make them easy to follow.
  • Align Trellix AI governance with emerging standards such as ISO/IEC 42001, and help shape industry and government standards for AI security.
  • Explain our controls and their results to executives, boards, customers, and external assessors. Patent and publish where it advances the field.

About you

  • 15+ years of engineering, including principal, fellow, or chief architect roles in security, privacy, or large-scale infrastructure.
  • Built enforcement controls at scale, such as privacy, purpose limitation, or access control, and proved they work.
  • Hands-on with AI coding agents and LLM pipelines, and clear about how they fail.
  • Working knowledge of AI threat frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.
  • A record of changing how a large engineering organization ships: release cadence, build systems, and secure defaults.
  • Writes clearly for executives, boards, and assessors. Patents preferred. B.S. in engineering or computer science, or equivalent experience.

Base Pay Range: $200K-250K. Actual base pay within this range will depend on varying circumstances, including the work location, individual qualifications, company budget and other operational business needs. Compensation may also include annual bonuses and long-term incentives, subject to various metrics and company policy.

Company Benefits and Perks:

We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

  • Retirement Plans

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage

  • Paid Time Off

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Support for Community Involvement

We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

Our Commitment to You:


At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.


Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process.


Trellix also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Trellix will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process.


If you have questions or believe you may have encountered fraudulent activity related to Trellix recruiting, please contact us .

  • Design and evolve complex software architectures for client projects.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Flodesk is recognized in the Inc 5000 as one of the world's fastest-growing email marketing companies, built to help entrepreneurs sell online and design emails that people love to get. We're committed to giving small businesses simple and intuitive tools that help them grow, nurture, and monetize their email list.

We’re a remote-first company headquartered in San Francisco with a globally distributed team, including in-person hubs in Da Nang (Vietnam), Barcelona (Spain), and Menlo Park (California). Our team reflects the diversity and creativity of the people we serve. Join our mission to level the playing field for small business owners through good design.

About the role

We’re looking for an AI-native Staff Product Designer with exceptional visual taste. You’ll shape how small business owners create emails, forms, checkouts, and more in Flodesk. You’ll use AI in your everyday design work and make changes directly in the product codebase to get the experience right.

You’ll work Pacific hours alongside product leadership, with time each morning to share work with our design team in Europe. As decisions take shape later in the day, you’ll bring the team’s perspective into the conversation and share the reasoning with Design and Engineering teammates in Europe and Vietnam.

What you’ll do

  • Mentor designers through critique and help the team turn successful design decisions into patterns others can use

  • Exceptional visual taste and a portfolio that shows it. Your choices in typography, layout, and interaction make complex tools feel simple and give the product a distinctive point of view
  • Experience leading complex product design work from the first member conversation through release (preferably at a B2B SaaS). You can show a decision you shaped, how you brought others along, and what changed for the people using the product

jobs.description:
Viatris Pharmaceuticals S.L.

Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.

Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

Our impact is evident in the awards and accolades we are achieving as an employer of choice and on behalf of our patients worldwide.

Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Omnichannel Data Engineer role will make an impact:

The Omnichannel Data Engineer supports the engineering, integration, operation, quality, and analytical enablement of customer data across Viatris' global omnichannel ecosystem. The role combines hands-on data engineering with data operations and stewardship responsibilities to ensure accurate, compliant, and activation-ready customer data across SFID, CRM, SFMC, Viatris Connect, and Azure Data Lake.

This role is designed for a hands-on data engineer who combines data analysis, process discipline, and technical problem-solving to support day-to-day data operations and data engineering needs. The role contributes to data quality monitoring, reporting, consent and identity data maintenance, manual and bulk data processing, issue triage, and the development of analytical or automation solutions that improve data reliability and omnichannel readiness. Unlike a management role, this position focuses on execution, investigation, support, and continuous improvement within established governance and operating models.

Key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Build or maintain data pipelines, analytical datasets, and automation solutions using Azure Data Lake and governed source-platform data to support omnichannel segmentation, quality controls, and reporting.
  • Design, develop, and support data engineering use cases such as dynamic segmentation, custom integrations, customer deduplication, data reconciliation, and intelligent value-mapping improvements.
  • Develop and maintain automated data-quality and reconciliation controls while monitoring anomalies, duplicates, mapping gaps, integration issues, and automation failures.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data flows across SFID, CRM, SFMC, APIs, registrations, and Azure Data Lake, performing root-cause analysis and supporting remediation.
  • Execute or support manual data operations in SFID, including insert, update, opt-out handling, bulk uploads, merge preparation, validation support, and record maintenance in line with approved processes and country requirements.
  • Contribute to the creation or maintenance of repeatable reports, dashboards, and operational insights that improve visibility into platform performance, country usage, and data quality trends.
  • Support data quality monitoring and operational checks across identity, consent, registration, and integration processes, helping identify anomalies, duplicates, mapping gaps, reconciliation issues, and automation failures.
  • Support controlled vocabulary, mapping, and normalization activities that improve cross-country consistency for profession, specialty, state, and other key identity attributes.
  • Assist with data correction, random post-load checks, file validation, and governed bulk import processes to ensure data completeness, consistency, and compliance.
  • Support duplicate analysis and contact merge activities by preparing records, validating outputs, and helping maintain a clean and linkable customer master.
  • Work with product, business, analytics, and technical teams to translate omnichannel requirements into scalable data, integration, and automation solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and automate recurring data operations, improving scalability and reliability while reducing unnecessary manual effort.

The minimum qualifications for this role are:


  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with structured and relational datasets
  • Ability to work with structured datasets, reporting tools, and governed business processes
  • Understanding of data quality, data operations, and root-cause investigation
  • Automation-oriented mindset, with the ability to identify where repetitive operational activities can be improved or automated.
  • Experience with data engineering, automation, and cloud data environments, preferably Azure Data Lake, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI.
  • Ability to work within regulated, process-driven environments with strong compliance expectations
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across business and technical teams
  • Ability to balance operational support with continuous improvement activities
  • Ability to work effectively across business and technical teams in a regulated environment.
  • Graduated from reputable universities with a related bachelor’s degree
  • Excellent command of both written and spoken English
  • Experience in a multinational pharmaceutical company in a similar position is preferred.
  • Experience with Salesforce environments, Azure Data Lake, Power BI/Fabric, customer data platforms, customer identity, bulk data handling, data reconciliation, and omnichannel analytics is preferred.
  • Exposure to matching, deduplication, value mapping, or marketing/customer engagement data processes is advantageous.
